title: LIGO 重力波觀測站
summary: 以漢福德與利文斯頓兩座 4 km 的 Advanced LIGO 干涉儀為對象，從應變 h = ΔL/L 與 1064 nm 雷射的相位讀出出發，推導臂腔精細度、循環功率、鍍膜熱雜訊、四重擺隔振、散粒雜訊振幅譜密度與壓縮光的效果，再以光子校正器、雜訊預算、鎖定流程與觀測運行交接把 10⁻²³/√Hz 等級的靈敏度做成可驗證的工程。
summaryEn: Using the two 4 km Advanced LIGO interferometers at Hanford and Livingston, this course starts from strain h = ΔL/L and phase readout with a 1064 nm laser, derives arm-cavity finesse, recycled power, coating thermal noise, quadruple-pendulum isolation, the shot-noise amplitude spectral density and the gain from squeezed light, then turns a sensitivity of order 10⁻²³/√Hz into verifiable engineering through photon calibrators, noise budgets, lock acquisition and observing-run handoff.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 100 Hz 雜訊預算練習（教學假設）：量子雜訊以第 5 單元的 3.7×10⁻²⁴/√Hz 為起點，3 dB 壓縮後為 2.6×10⁻²⁴；鍍膜布朗雜訊 3.2×10⁻²⁴；懸吊熱雜訊 0.5×10⁻²⁴；技術雜訊（雷射、控制、散射光）合計 1.0×10⁻²⁴。總雜訊 = √(2.6² + 3.2² + 0.5² + 1.0²)×10⁻²⁴ = √18.25×10⁻²⁴ ≈ 4.3×10⁻²⁴/√Hz；若無壓縮則 √(3.7² + 3.2² + 0.5² + 1.0²) = √25.2 ≈ 5.0×10⁻²⁴。對一個峰值應變 10⁻²¹、有效頻寬約 100 Hz 的雙黑洞合併訊號，粗估訊噪比 SNR ≈ h/(ASD×√Δf) = 10⁻²¹/(4.3×10⁻²⁴×10) ≈ 23，無壓縮時約 20。這說明壓縮光在此頻段帶來約 15% 的訊噪比提升，但鍍膜熱雜訊才是下一個要攻克的主導項。數值為教學假設，不代表任何觀測運行的實際曲線。
workedExample.textEn: Noise-budget exercise at 100 Hz (teaching assumptions): start from the quantum noise of unit 5, 3.7×10⁻²⁴/√Hz, reduced to 2.6×10⁻²⁴ by 3 dB of squeezing; coating Brownian noise 3.2×10⁻²⁴; suspension thermal noise 0.5×10⁻²⁴; technical noise (laser, control, scattered light) 1.0×10⁻²⁴ in total. Total noise = √(2.6² + 3.2² + 0.5² + 1.0²)×10⁻²⁴ = √18.25×10⁻²⁴ ≈ 4.3×10⁻²⁴/√Hz; without squeezing √(3.7² + 3.2² + 0.5² + 1.0²) = √25.2 ≈ 5.0×10⁻²⁴. For a binary-black-hole merger with peak strain 10⁻²¹ and an effective bandwidth of about 100 Hz, a rough signal-to-noise ratio is SNR ≈ h/(ASD×√Δf) = 10⁻²¹/(4.3×10⁻²⁴×10) ≈ 23, or about 20 without squeezing. Squeezing therefore buys about 15% in this band, while coating thermal noise is the dominant term to attack next. Values are teaching assumptions, not the actual curve of any observing run.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「應變、臂長與麥克森相位讀出」與「臂腔精細度、腔極點與循環功率」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Strain, arm length and Michelson phase readout" and "Arm-cavity finesse, cavity pole and recycled power": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 應變、臂長與麥克森相位讀出：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Strain, arm length and Michelson phase readout: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「4 km 臂與暗紋輸出埠」如何決定LIGO 重力波觀測站的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “4 km arms and the dark-fringe output port” determines the key performance of “LIGO gravitational-wave observatories”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 重力波以應變 h 拉伸一條臂並壓縮另一條，臂長變化 ΔL = h·L/2 的差值在兩臂間為 h·L，所以臂越長訊號越大，LIGO 選擇 4 km 是場地、真空成本與訊號之間的折衷。干涉儀以 1064 nm 的 Nd:YAG 雷射從分光鏡送入兩臂，回程光在輸出埠以接近暗紋的狀態干涉，微小的臂長差轉成輸出光功率的變化；DC 讀出法刻意保留約 10 pm 的偏移量，讓訊號與載波在光電二極體上線性混合。整個系統的邊界是：真空中的四面測試質量定義了臂長，其餘一切都是為了讓這四面鏡子只受重力波推動。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「4 km 臂與暗紋輸出埠」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A gravitational wave stretches one arm and squeezes the other with strain h, giving a differential arm-length change of h·L, so longer arms mean larger signals; LIGO's 4 km is a compromise between site, vacuum cost and signal. A 1064 nm Nd:YAG laser is split at the beam splitter into the two arms, the returning beams interfere near a dark fringe at the output port and a tiny arm-length difference becomes a change in output power; DC readout deliberately keeps an offset of about 10 pm so that signal and carrier mix linearly on the photodiode. The system boundary is that four test masses in vacuum define the arm lengths, and everything else exists to make those four mirrors move only under gravitational waves. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “4 km arms and the dark-fringe output port”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：h = ΔL/L。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: h = ΔL/L.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「重力波會讓雷射波長跟著拉伸，所以干涉儀量不到任何東西。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A gravitational wave stretches the laser wavelength too, so the interferometer cannot measure anything." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「4 km 臂與暗紋輸出埠」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “4 km arms and the dark-fringe output port”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 應變、臂長與麥克森相位讀出
knowledge.titleEn: Strain, arm length and Michelson phase readout
knowledge.text: 重力波以應變 h 拉伸一條臂並壓縮另一條，臂長變化 ΔL = h·L/2 的差值在兩臂間為 h·L，所以臂越長訊號越大，LIGO 選擇 4 km 是場地、真空成本與訊號之間的折衷。干涉儀以 1064 nm 的 Nd:YAG 雷射從分光鏡送入兩臂，回程光在輸出埠以接近暗紋的狀態干涉，微小的臂長差轉成輸出光功率的變化；DC 讀出法刻意保留約 10 pm 的偏移量，讓訊號與載波在光電二極體上線性混合。
knowledge.textEn: A gravitational wave stretches one arm and squeezes the other with strain h, giving a differential arm-length change of h·L, so longer arms mean larger signals; LIGO's 4 km is a compromise between site, vacuum cost and signal. A 1064 nm Nd:YAG laser is split at the beam splitter into the two arms, the returning beams interfere near a dark fringe at the output port and a tiny arm-length difference becomes a change in output power; DC readout deliberately keeps an offset of about 10 pm so that signal and carrier mix linearly on the photodiode.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：重力波會讓雷射波長跟著拉伸，所以干涉儀量不到任何東西。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A gravitational wave stretches the laser wavelength too, so the interferometer cannot measure anything. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「應變、臂長與麥克森相位讀出」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Strain, arm length and Michelson phase readout" is correct?
options: 重力波會讓雷射波長跟著拉伸，所以干涉儀量不到任何東西。
重力波以應變 h 拉伸一條臂並壓縮另一條，臂長變化 ΔL = h·L/2 的差值在兩臂間為 h·L，所以臂越長訊號越大，LIGO 選擇 4 km 是場地、真空成本與訊號之間的折衷。
精細度越高越好，可以無限提高靈敏度。
optionsEn: A gravitational wave stretches the laser wavelength too, so the interferometer cannot measure anything.
A gravitational wave stretches one arm and squeezes the other with strain h, giving a differential arm-length change of h·L, so longer arms mean larger signals.
Higher finesse is always better and raises sensitivity without limit.
quiz.explanation: 重力波以應變 h 拉伸一條臂並壓縮另一條，臂長變化 ΔL = h·L/2 的差值在兩臂間為 h·L，所以臂越長訊號越大，LIGO 選擇 4 km 是場地、真空成本與訊號之間的折衷。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A gravitational wave stretches one arm and squeezes the other with strain h, giving a differential arm-length change of h·L, so longer arms mean larger signals; LIGO's 4 km is a compromise between site, vacuum cost and signal. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 應變、臂長與麥克森相位讀出：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Strain, arm length and Michelson phase readout: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「4 km 臂與暗紋輸出埠」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “4 km arms and the dark-fringe output port” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：h = ΔL/L。對 h = 10⁻²¹ 與 L = 4000 m，差動臂長變化 ΔL = 4×10⁻¹⁸ m，約為質子直徑的四千分之一。單純麥克森的輸出相位差 Δφ = 4π·ΔL/λ = 4π×4×10⁻¹⁸/1.064×10⁻⁶ ≈ 4.7×10⁻¹¹ rad；加上臂腔約 2F/π ≈ 286 次等效往返後約 1.3×10⁻⁸ rad，仍需以 kW 級功率的光子統計才能讀出。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: h = ΔL/L. For h = 10⁻²¹ and L = 4000 m the differential arm change is ΔL = 4×10⁻¹⁸ m, about one four-thousandth of a proton diameter. A simple Michelson gives an output phase difference Δφ = 4π·ΔL/λ = 4π×4×10⁻¹⁸/1.064×10⁻⁶ ≈ 4.7×10⁻¹¹ rad; with the arm cavities' roughly 2F/π ≈ 286 effective round trips it is about 1.3×10⁻⁸ rad, still readable only with the photon statistics of kilowatt-class power. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以已知振幅的測試質量驅動（例如光子校正器施加的 10⁻¹⁹ 等級應變）注入訊號，確認輸出埠光功率的變化與 h·L 及讀出鏈的轉換函數一致；比較漢福德與利文斯頓兩站對同一注入模板的響應，兩者的振幅校正應在 10% 內一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Inject a known test-mass drive, such as a strain of order 10⁻¹⁹ applied with the photon calibrator, and confirm that the output-port power change matches h·L and the readout-chain transfer function; compare the responses of Hanford and Livingston to the same injection template, whose amplitude calibrations should agree within 10%.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: h = ΔL/L。對 h = 10⁻²¹ 與 L = 4000 m，差動臂長變化 ΔL = 4×10⁻¹⁸ m，約為質子直徑的四千分之一。單純麥克森的輸出相位差 Δφ = 4π·ΔL/λ = 4π×4×10⁻¹⁸/1.064×10⁻⁶ ≈ 4.7×10⁻¹¹ rad；加上臂腔約 2F/π ≈ 286 次等效往返後約 1.3×10⁻⁸ rad，仍需以 kW 級功率的光子統計才能讀出。
knowledge.textEn: h = ΔL/L. For h = 10⁻²¹ and L = 4000 m the differential arm change is ΔL = 4×10⁻¹⁸ m, about one four-thousandth of a proton diameter. A simple Michelson gives an output phase difference Δφ = 4π·ΔL/λ = 4π×4×10⁻¹⁸/1.064×10⁻⁶ ≈ 4.7×10⁻¹¹ rad; with the arm cavities' roughly 2F/π ≈ 286 effective round trips it is about 1.3×10⁻⁸ rad, still readable only with the photon statistics of kilowatt-class power.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「應變、臂長與麥克森相位讀出」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Strain, arm length and Michelson phase readout", which statement holds?
options: 只要把干涉儀建在安靜的地方，就不需要複雜的隔振。
靈敏度曲線本身就是雜訊預算，不需要逐項分解。
h = ΔL/L。
optionsEn: Building the interferometer somewhere quiet removes the need for complex isolation.
The sensitivity curve is the noise budget; no term-by-term breakdown is needed.
h = ΔL/L.
quiz.explanation: h = ΔL/L。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: h = ΔL/L. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 應變、臂長與麥克森相位讀出：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Strain, arm length and Michelson phase readout: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「4 km 臂與暗紋輸出埠」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “4 km arms and the dark-fringe output port” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以已知振幅的測試質量驅動（例如光子校正器施加的 10⁻¹⁹ 等級應變）注入訊號，確認輸出埠光功率的變化與 h·L 及讀出鏈的轉換函數一致；比較漢福德與利文斯頓兩站對同一注入模板的響應，兩者的振幅校正應在 10% 內一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Inject a known test-mass drive, such as a strain of order 10⁻¹⁹ applied with the photon calibrator, and confirm that the output-port power change matches h·L and the readout-chain transfer function; compare the responses of Hanford and Livingston to the same injection template, whose amplitude calibrations should agree within 10%. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若輸出埠不在設計的暗紋偏移量上（例如偏移漂到 30 pm），載波功率過大使散粒雜訊與雷射強度雜訊同時上升，應變靈敏度在 100 Hz 附近劣化數十個百分比，而且訊號對臂長的線性關係也變差。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the output port drifts off the designed dark-fringe offset (for example to 30 pm), the excess carrier power raises both shot noise and laser-intensity coupling, strain sensitivity near 100 Hz degrades by tens of percent and the signal's linearity with arm length also suffers.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以已知振幅的測試質量驅動（例如光子校正器施加的 10⁻¹⁹ 等級應變）注入訊號，確認輸出埠光功率的變化與 h·L 及讀出鏈的轉換函數一致；比較漢福德與利文斯頓兩站對同一注入模板的響應，兩者的振幅校正應在 10% 內一致。
knowledge.textEn: Inject a known test-mass drive, such as a strain of order 10⁻¹⁹ applied with the photon calibrator, and confirm that the output-port power change matches h·L and the readout-chain transfer function; compare the responses of Hanford and Livingston to the same injection template, whose amplitude calibrations should agree within 10%.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「應變、臂長與麥克森相位讀出」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Strain, arm length and Michelson phase readout"?
options: 以已知振幅的測試質量驅動（例如光子校正器施加的 10⁻¹⁹ 等級應變）注入訊號，確認輸出埠光功率的變化與 h·L 及讀出鏈的轉換函數一致。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
鎖定只要把鏡子固定不動就行了。
optionsEn: Inject a known test-mass drive, such as a strain of order 10⁻¹⁹ applied with the photon calibrator, and confirm that the output-port power change matches h·L and the readout-chain transfer function.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Locking just means holding the mirrors still.
quiz.explanation: 以已知振幅的測試質量驅動（例如光子校正器施加的 10⁻¹⁹ 等級應變）注入訊號，確認輸出埠光功率的變化與 h·L 及讀出鏈的轉換函數一致；比較漢福德與利文斯頓兩站對同一注入模板的響應，兩者的振幅校正應在 10% 內一致。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。

steps.title: 應變、臂長與麥克森相位讀出：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Strain, arm length and Michelson phase readout: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「4 km 臂與暗紋輸出埠」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “4 km arms and the dark-fringe output port” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若輸出埠不在設計的暗紋偏移量上（例如偏移漂到 30 pm），載波功率過大使散粒雜訊與雷射強度雜訊同時上升，應變靈敏度在 100 Hz 附近劣化數十個百分比，而且訊號對臂長的線性關係也變差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the output port drifts off the designed dark-fringe offset (for example to 30 pm), the excess carrier power raises both shot noise and laser-intensity coupling, strain sensitivity near 100 Hz degrades by tens of percent and the signal's linearity with arm length also suffers. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：整個系統的邊界是：真空中的四面測試質量定義了臂長，其餘一切都是為了讓這四面鏡子只受重力波推動。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The system boundary is that four test masses in vacuum define the arm lengths, and everything else exists to make those four mirrors move only under gravitational waves.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「重力波會讓雷射波長跟著拉伸，所以干涉儀量不到任何東西。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A gravitational wave stretches the laser wavelength too, so the interferometer cannot measure anything." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 臂腔精細度、腔極點與循環功率：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Arm-cavity finesse, cavity pole and recycled power: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「Fabry–Pérot 臂腔與功率循環鏡」如何決定LIGO 重力波觀測站的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fabry–Pérot arm cavities and the power-recycling mirror” determines the key performance of “LIGO gravitational-wave observatories”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 每條臂由輸入測試質量（ITM，透射率約 1.4%）與末端測試質量（ETM，透射率數 ppm）組成 Fabry–Pérot 腔，光在腔內共振來回，使臂長變化造成的相位被放大約 2F/π 倍，但高於腔極點頻率的訊號會被平均掉。功率循環鏡把從暗紋輸出埠「反射」回雷射方向的光再送回干涉儀，使分光鏡處的功率提高數十倍；訊號循環鏡則調整輸出埠的頻率響應。這三層共振把 50 到 125 W 的入射功率轉成臂內數百 kW 的循環功率，代價是熱透鏡、輻射壓與鎖定的困難。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Fabry–Pérot 臂腔與功率循環鏡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each arm is a Fabry–Pérot cavity formed by the input test mass (ITM, transmission about 1.4%) and the end test mass (ETM, transmission of a few ppm); light resonates back and forth so the phase from an arm-length change is amplified by about 2F/π, while signals above the cavity-pole frequency are averaged away. The power-recycling mirror returns light that the dark output port reflects toward the laser back into the interferometer, raising the beam-splitter power tens of times, and the signal-recycling mirror shapes the frequency response at the output port. These three layers of resonance convert 50 to 125 W of input into hundreds of kilowatts circulating in the arms, at the price of thermal lensing, radiation pressure and difficult lock acquisition. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Fabry–Pérot arm cavities and the power-recycling mirror”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：精細度 F ≈ 2π/(T_ITM + 損耗) ≈ 2π/0.014 ≈ 450，等效往返 2F/π ≈ 286 次。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Finesse F ≈ 2π/(T_ITM + losses) ≈ 2π/0.014 ≈ 450, giving 2F/π ≈ 286 effective round trips.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「精細度越高越好，可以無限提高靈敏度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Higher finesse is always better and raises sensitivity without limit." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「Fabry–Pérot 臂腔與功率循環鏡」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Fabry–Pérot arm cavities and the power-recycling mirror”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 臂腔精細度、腔極點與循環功率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Arm-cavity finesse, cavity pole and recycled power: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「Fabry–Pérot 臂腔與功率循環鏡」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fabry–Pérot arm cavities and the power-recycling mirror” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：精細度 F ≈ 2π/(T_ITM + 損耗) ≈ 2π/0.014 ≈ 450，等效往返 2F/π ≈ 286 次。腔極點 f_p = c/(4·L·F) = 3×10⁸/(4×4000×450) ≈ 42 Hz。功率：50 W 入射 × 功率循環增益 40 = 2 kW 在分光鏡，每臂 1 kW，臂腔增益 ≈ 4/T_ITM ≈ 286，臂內功率 ≈ 286 kW；125 W 入射時約 715 kW，接近 750 kW 的設計值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Finesse F ≈ 2π/(T_ITM + losses) ≈ 2π/0.014 ≈ 450, giving 2F/π ≈ 286 effective round trips. The cavity pole is f_p = c/(4·L·F) = 3×10⁸/(4×4000×450) ≈ 42 Hz. Power: 50 W input × power-recycling gain 40 = 2 kW at the beam splitter, 1 kW per arm, arm-cavity gain ≈ 4/T_ITM ≈ 286, so about 286 kW in each arm; with 125 W input it is about 715 kW, near the 750 kW design value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量臂腔的衰盪時間（ring-down）：關閉輸入光後透射功率以 τ_s = L·F/(π·c) 衰減，從 τ_s 反推 F 並與 T_ITM 的鍍膜規格比較；以 ETM 透射光與 ITM 透射光的功率監視器估算臂內功率，再用頻率響應量測（掃頻注入）確認腔極點落在 42 Hz 附近。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the arm-cavity ring-down: after the input light is blocked the transmitted power decays with τ_s = L·F/(π·c), from which F is inferred and compared with the ITM coating specification; estimate arm power from the ETM and ITM transmission power monitors, and confirm with a swept-sine frequency-response measurement that the cavity pole lies near 42 Hz.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

Power: 50 W input × power-recycling gain 40 = 2 kW at the beam splitter, 1 kW per arm, arm-cavity gain ≈ 4/T_ITM ≈ 286, so about 286 kW in each arm; with 125 W input it is about 715 kW, near the 750 kW design value.

steps.title: 臂腔精細度、腔極點與循環功率：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Arm-cavity finesse, cavity pole and recycled power: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「Fabry–Pérot 臂腔與功率循環鏡」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Fabry–Pérot arm cavities and the power-recycling mirror” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 量臂腔的衰盪時間（ring-down）：關閉輸入光後透射功率以 τ_s = L·F/(π·c) 衰減，從 τ_s 反推 F 並與 T_ITM 的鍍膜規格比較；以 ETM 透射光與 ITM 透射光的功率監視器估算臂內功率，再用頻率響應量測（掃頻注入）確認腔極點落在 42 Hz 附近。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the arm-cavity ring-down: after the input light is blocked the transmitted power decays with τ_s = L·F/(π·c), from which F is inferred and compared with the ITM coating specification; estimate arm power from the ETM and ITM transmission power monitors, and confirm with a swept-sine frequency-response measurement that the cavity pole lies near 42 Hz. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：某面測試質量的鍍膜出現點缺陷使散射損耗增加 50 ppm，臂腔精細度與功率循環增益一起下降，臂內功率掉到一半；若把靈敏度損失歸咎於雷射，會錯過鏡面更換的時機。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A point defect in one test-mass coating adding 50 ppm of scatter lowers both the arm finesse and the power-recycling gain, halving the arm power; blaming the laser for the sensitivity loss misses the moment to replace the mirror.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 量臂腔的衰盪時間（ring-down）：關閉輸入光後透射功率以 τ_s = L·F/(π·c) 衰減，從 τ_s 反推 F 並與 T_ITM 的鍍膜規格比較；以 ETM 透射光與 ITM 透射光的功率監視器估算臂內功率，再用頻率響應量測（掃頻注入）確認腔極點落在 42 Hz 附近。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the arm-cavity ring-down: after the input light is blocked the transmitted power decays with τ_s = L·F/(π·c), from which F is inferred and compared with the ITM coating specification; estimate arm power from the ETM and ITM transmission power monitors, and confirm with a swept-sine frequency-response measurement that the cavity pole lies near 42 Hz.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「臂腔精細度、腔極點與循環功率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Arm-cavity finesse, cavity pole and recycled power"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
量臂腔的衰盪時間（ring-down）：關閉輸入光後透射功率以 τ_s = L·F/(π·c) 衰減，從 τ_s 反推 F 並與 T_ITM 的鍍膜規格比較。
只要一站靈敏度夠高，就能單獨確認重力波事件。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Measure the arm-cavity ring-down: after the input light is blocked the transmitted power decays with τ_s = L·F/(π·c), from which F is inferred and compared with the ITM coating specification.
One sufficiently sensitive site can confirm a gravitational-wave event on its own.
quiz.explanation: 量臂腔的衰盪時間（ring-down）：關閉輸入光後透射功率以 τ_s = L·F/(π·c) 衰減，從 τ_s 反推 F 並與 T_ITM 的鍍膜規格比較；以 ETM 透射光與 ITM 透射光的功率監視器估算臂內功率，再用頻率響應量測（掃頻注入）確認腔極點落在 42 Hz 附近。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure the arm-cavity ring-down: after the input light is blocked the transmitted power decays with τ_s = L·F/(π·c), from which F is inferred and compared with the ITM coating specification; estimate arm power from the ETM and ITM transmission power monitors, and confirm with a swept-sine frequency-response measurement that the cavity pole lies near 42 Hz. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 臂腔精細度、腔極點與循環功率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Arm-cavity finesse, cavity pole and recycled power: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「Fabry–Pérot 臂腔與功率循環鏡」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Fabry–Pérot arm cavities and the power-recycling mirror” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 某面測試質量的鍍膜出現點缺陷使散射損耗增加 50 ppm，臂腔精細度與功率循環增益一起下降，臂內功率掉到一半；若把靈敏度損失歸咎於雷射，會錯過鏡面更換的時機。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A point defect in one test-mass coating adding 50 ppm of scatter lowers both the arm finesse and the power-recycling gain, halving the arm power; blaming the laser for the sensitivity loss misses the moment to replace the mirror. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這三層共振把 50 到 125 W 的入射功率轉成臂內數百 kW 的循環功率，代價是熱透鏡、輻射壓與鎖定的困難。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: These three layers of resonance convert 50 to 125 W of input into hundreds of kilowatts circulating in the arms, at the price of thermal lensing, radiation pressure and difficult lock acquisition.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「精細度越高越好，可以無限提高靈敏度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Higher finesse is always better and raises sensitivity without limit." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「測試質量、鍍膜與布朗熱雜訊」與「四重擺、熔融石英纖維與地震隔離」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Test masses, coatings and Brownian thermal noise" and "Quadruple pendulum, fused-silica fibres and seismic isolation": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 測試質量、鍍膜與布朗熱雜訊：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Test masses, coatings and Brownian thermal noise: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「40 kg 熔融石英測試質量與多層鍍膜」如何決定LIGO 重力波觀測站的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “40 kg fused-silica test masses and multilayer coatings” determines the key performance of “LIGO gravitational-wave observatories”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: Advanced LIGO 的四面測試質量各重 40 kg、直徑 34 cm、厚 20 cm，由低吸收的熔融石英製成，正面鍍上數十層 SiO₂ 與摻鈦 Ta₂O₅ 的四分之一波長堆疊，反射率只讓每五百萬個光子穿透一個，吸收低於 1 ppm。鍍膜材料的機械損耗 φ 在室溫下透過漲落耗散定理產生布朗熱雜訊，使鏡面在雷射光斑範圍內隨機起伏，這是 50 到 500 Hz 最重要的雜訊之一；加大光斑半徑 w 與降低 φ 是僅有的兩條路。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「40 kg 熔融石英測試質量與多層鍍膜」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Advanced LIGO's four test masses each weigh 40 kg, measure 34 cm across and 20 cm thick, and are made of low-absorption fused silica; their front faces carry tens of quarter-wave layers of SiO₂ and titania-doped Ta₂O₅ that let only one photon in five million through and absorb below 1 ppm. The mechanical loss φ of the coating materials produces Brownian thermal noise at room temperature through the fluctuation-dissipation theorem, making the surface fluctuate randomly within the laser spot; it is among the most important noises between 50 and 500 Hz, and enlarging the spot radius w or lowering φ are the only two remedies. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “40 kg fused-silica test masses and multilayer coatings”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：鍍膜布朗雜訊的近似式 S_x(f) ≈ (2k_BT/(π²f))·(d/w²)·(φ_c/Y)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: An approximate coating Brownian noise is S_x(f) ≈ (2k_BT/(π²f))·(d/w²)·(φ_c/Y).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鏡面只要拋得夠光滑，熱雜訊就不存在。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A mirror polished smoothly enough has no thermal noise." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「40 kg 熔融石英測試質量與多層鍍膜」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “40 kg fused-silica test masses and multilayer coatings”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

The mechanical loss φ of the coating materials produces Brownian thermal noise at room temperature through the fluctuation-dissipation theorem, making the surface fluctuate randomly within the laser spot; it is among the most important noises between 50 and 500 Hz, and enlarging the spot radius w or lowering φ are the only two remedies.

knowledge.text: 誤解：鏡面只要拋得夠光滑，熱雜訊就不存在。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「測試質量、鍍膜與布朗熱雜訊」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Test masses, coatings and Brownian thermal noise" is correct?

optionsEn: Advanced LIGO's four test masses each weigh 40 kg, measure 34 cm across and 20 cm thick, and are made of low-absorption fused silica.

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 測試質量、鍍膜與布朗熱雜訊：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Test masses, coatings and Brownian thermal noise: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「40 kg 熔融石英測試質量與多層鍍膜」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “40 kg fused-silica test masses and multilayer coatings” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：鍍膜布朗雜訊的近似式 S_x(f) ≈ (2k_BT/(π²f))·(d/w²)·(φ_c/Y)。取 T = 295 K（k_BT = 4.07×10⁻²¹ J）、鍍膜厚度 d = 6 µm、光斑半徑 w = 6.2 cm、φ_c = 2.3×10⁻⁴、Y = 72 GPa、f = 100 Hz：S_x ≈ 8.25×10⁻²⁴×1.56×10⁻³×3.19×10⁻¹⁵ ≈ 4.1×10⁻⁴¹ m²/Hz，單鏡 √S_x ≈ 6.4×10⁻²¹ m/√Hz；四面鏡子不相關相加 ×2，除以 L = 4000 m 得 h_coat ≈ 3.2×10⁻²⁴/√Hz，隨 f^(−1/2) 下降。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: An approximate coating Brownian noise is S_x(f) ≈ (2k_BT/(π²f))·(d/w²)·(φ_c/Y). With T = 295 K (k_BT = 4.07×10⁻²¹ J), coating thickness d = 6 µm, spot radius w = 6.2 cm, φ_c = 2.3×10⁻⁴, Y = 72 GPa and f = 100 Hz: S_x ≈ 8.25×10⁻²⁴×1.56×10⁻³×3.19×10⁻¹⁵ ≈ 4.1×10⁻⁴¹ m²/Hz, so one mirror gives √S_x ≈ 6.4×10⁻²¹ m/√Hz; four uncorrelated mirrors multiply by 2, and dividing by L = 4000 m gives h_coat ≈ 3.2×10⁻²⁴/√Hz, falling as f^(−1/2). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在鍍膜樣品上以衰盪法量機械損耗 φ_c（懸掛薄片或節點支撐的圓盤，記錄各模態的 Q 值），以光熱共路干涉量吸收，並以散射儀量總積分散射；把量得的 φ_c 代入熱雜訊公式，與干涉儀實測雜訊曲線在 100–300 Hz 的平台比較，差異應在 20% 內。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the coating mechanical loss φ_c on witness samples by ring-down (suspended thin disks or nodally supported disks, recording the Q of each mode), measure absorption with photothermal common-path interferometry and total integrated scatter with a scatterometer; insert the measured φ_c into the thermal-noise formula and compare with the interferometer's measured noise plateau at 100–300 Hz, expecting agreement within 20%.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 鍍膜布朗雜訊的近似式 S_x(f) ≈ (2k_BT/(π²f))·(d/w²)·(φ_c/Y)。取 T = 295 K（k_BT = 4.07×10⁻²¹ J）、鍍膜厚度 d = 6 µm、光斑半徑 w = 6.2 cm、φ_c = 2.3×10⁻⁴、Y = 72 GPa、f = 100 Hz：S_x ≈ 8.25×10⁻²⁴×1.56×10⁻³×3.19×10⁻¹⁵ ≈ 4.1×10⁻⁴¹ m²/Hz，單鏡 √S_x ≈ 6.4×10⁻²¹ m/√Hz；四面鏡子不相關相加 ×2，除以 L = 4000 m 得 h_coat ≈ 3.2×10⁻²⁴/√Hz，隨 f^(−1/2) 下降。
knowledge.textEn: An approximate coating Brownian noise is S_x(f) ≈ (2k_BT/(π²f))·(d/w²)·(φ_c/Y). With T = 295 K (k_BT = 4.07×10⁻²¹ J), coating thickness d = 6 µm, spot radius w = 6.2 cm, φ_c = 2.3×10⁻⁴, Y = 72 GPa and f = 100 Hz: S_x ≈ 8.25×10⁻²⁴×1.56×10⁻³×3.19×10⁻¹⁵ ≈ 4.1×10⁻⁴¹ m²/Hz, so one mirror gives √S_x ≈ 6.4×10⁻²¹ m/√Hz; four uncorrelated mirrors multiply by 2, and dividing by L = 4000 m gives h_coat ≈ 3.2×10⁻²⁴/√Hz, falling as f^(−1/2).

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「測試質量、鍍膜與布朗熱雜訊」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Test masses, coatings and Brownian thermal noise", which statement holds?
options: 靈敏度曲線本身就是雜訊預算，不需要逐項分解。
鍍膜布朗雜訊的近似式 S_x(f) ≈ (2k_BT/(π²f))·(d/w²)·(φ_c/Y)。

steps.title: 測試質量、鍍膜與布朗熱雜訊：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Test masses, coatings and Brownian thermal noise: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「40 kg 熔融石英測試質量與多層鍍膜」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “40 kg fused-silica test masses and multilayer coatings” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在鍍膜樣品上以衰盪法量機械損耗 φ_c（懸掛薄片或節點支撐的圓盤，記錄各模態的 Q 值），以光熱共路干涉量吸收，並以散射儀量總積分散射；把量得的 φ_c 代入熱雜訊公式，與干涉儀實測雜訊曲線在 100–300 Hz 的平台比較，差異應在 20% 內。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the coating mechanical loss φ_c on witness samples by ring-down (suspended thin disks or nodally supported disks, recording the Q of each mode), measure absorption with photothermal common-path interferometry and total integrated scatter with a scatterometer; insert the measured φ_c into the thermal-noise formula and compare with the interferometer's measured noise plateau at 100–300 Hz, expecting agreement within 20%. steps.title: 四重擺、熔融石英纖維與地震隔離：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Quadruple pendulum, fused-silica fibres and seismic isolation: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「四重擺懸吊與主動隔振平台」如何決定LIGO 重力波觀測站的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Quadruple-pendulum suspension and active isolation platform” determines the key performance of “LIGO gravitational-wave observatories”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 每面測試質量掛在四級擺的最下層：上兩級為金屬質量，下兩級為熔融石英，最下一級以四根直徑約 400 µm 的熔融石英纖維與倒數第二級焊成單體懸吊，避免金屬絲的摩擦損耗。每一級擺在共振頻率以上提供 1/f² 的隔離，四級合起來約 1/f⁸；擺的上方還有主動隔振平台（ISI），以地震計與慣性感測器回授抵消地面與潮汐的低頻運動。這套組合把地面微米等級的震動在 10 Hz 以上壓到 10⁻¹⁹ m 以下，使測試質量成為近乎自由的慣性質量。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「四重擺懸吊與主動隔振平台」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each test mass hangs at the bottom of a four-stage pendulum: the top two stages are metal, the lower two fused silica, and the final stage is welded to the penultimate mass through four fused-silica fibres about 400 µm in diameter, forming a monolithic suspension that avoids the frictional loss of metal wires. Each stage isolates as 1/f² above its resonance, so four stages give roughly 1/f⁸; above the pendulum an active isolation platform (ISI) uses seismometers and inertial sensors in feedback to cancel low-frequency ground and tidal motion. Together they reduce micrometre-scale ground vibration to below 10⁻¹⁹ m above 10 Hz, making the test mass an almost free inertial mass. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Quadruple-pendulum suspension and active isolation platform”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：四級擺在共振頻率 f₀ 以上的傳遞率近似 (f₀/f)⁸：f₀ = 0.6 Hz、f = 10 Hz 時 (0.06)⁸ ≈ 1.7×10⁻¹⁰。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The transmissibility of a four-stage pendulum above its resonance f₀ is roughly (f₀/f)⁸: with f₀ = 0.6 Hz and f = 10 Hz, (0.06)⁸ ≈ 1.7×10⁻¹⁰.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要把干涉儀建在安靜的地方，就不需要複雜的隔振。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Building the interferometer somewhere quiet removes the need for complex isolation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「四重擺懸吊與主動隔振平台」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 四重擺、熔融石英纖維與地震隔離：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Quadruple pendulum, fused-silica fibres and seismic isolation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「四重擺懸吊與主動隔振平台」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Quadruple-pendulum suspension and active isolation platform” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：四級擺在共振頻率 f₀ 以上的傳遞率近似 (f₀/f)⁸：f₀ = 0.6 Hz、f = 10 Hz 時 (0.06)⁸ ≈ 1.7×10⁻¹⁰。安靜站址地面在 10 Hz 約 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz，主動平台再衰減 10³ 倍至 10⁻¹² m/√Hz，經四級擺後約 1.7×10⁻²² m/√Hz，對應 h ≈ 4×10⁻²⁶/√Hz，遠低於 10 Hz 處約 10⁻²³ 的設計靈敏度，因此低頻真正的限制是懸吊熱雜訊與控制雜訊。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The transmissibility of a four-stage pendulum above its resonance f₀ is roughly (f₀/f)⁸: with f₀ = 0.6 Hz and f = 10 Hz, (0.06)⁸ ≈ 1.7×10⁻¹⁰. Ground motion at a quiet site is about 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz at 10 Hz, the active platform attenuates a further 10³ to 10⁻¹² m/√Hz, and after the quad about 1.7×10⁻²² m/√Hz remains, corresponding to h ≈ 4×10⁻²⁶/√Hz, far below the design sensitivity of about 10⁻²³ at 10 Hz; the real low-frequency limits are therefore suspension thermal and control noise. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在懸吊測試架上以位移感測器與電磁致動器量每一級的傳遞函數，確認共振頻率與高頻滾降斜率；在干涉儀中把地面地震計訊號與差動臂長訊號做相干分析，10 Hz 以上的相干性應接近零，否則表示某級被短路（例如纜線或擋塊接觸）。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On the suspension test stand measure each stage's transfer function with displacement sensors and electromagnetic actuators, confirming resonance frequencies and the high-frequency roll-off slope; in the interferometer compute the coherence between ground seismometers and the differential arm signal, which should be near zero above 10 Hz, otherwise a stage is shorted, for example by a cable or an earthquake stop touching.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

The transmissibility of a four-stage pendulum above its resonance f₀ is roughly (f₀/f)⁸: with f₀ = 0.6 Hz and f = 10 Hz, (0.06)⁸ ≈ 1.7×10⁻¹⁰.
quiz.explanation: 四級擺在共振頻率 f₀ 以上的傳遞率近似 (f₀/f)⁸：f₀ = 0.6 Hz、f = 10 Hz 時 (0.06)⁸ ≈ 1.7×10⁻¹⁰。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The transmissibility of a four-stage pendulum above its resonance f₀ is roughly (f₀/f)⁸: with f₀ = 0.6 Hz and f = 10 Hz, (0.06)⁸ ≈ 1.7×10⁻¹⁰. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 四重擺、熔融石英纖維與地震隔離：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Quadruple pendulum, fused-silica fibres and seismic isolation: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「四重擺懸吊與主動隔振平台」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Quadruple-pendulum suspension and active isolation platform” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在懸吊測試架上以位移感測器與電磁致動器量每一級的傳遞函數，確認共振頻率與高頻滾降斜率；在干涉儀中把地面地震計訊號與差動臂長訊號做相干分析，10 Hz 以上的相干性應接近零，否則表示某級被短路（例如纜線或擋塊接觸）。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: On the suspension test stand measure each stage's transfer function with displacement sensors and electromagnetic actuators, confirming resonance frequencies and the high-frequency roll-off slope; in the interferometer compute the coherence between ground seismometers and the differential arm signal, which should be near zero above 10 Hz, otherwise a stage is shorted, for example by a cable or an earthquake stop touching. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：一根石英纖維在焊點附近有微裂紋時，纖維的損耗角上升並在小提琴模態（約 500 Hz）附近產生尖峰，最終可能斷裂使鏡子落到擋塊上；斷裂前的徵兆是模態 Q 值下降，必須由懸吊的共振監測發現。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A micro-crack near the weld of one silica fibre raises its loss angle and produces peaks near the violin modes around 500 Hz, and the fibre may eventually break and drop the mirror onto its stops; the precursor is a falling modal Q that only the suspension resonance monitor can catch.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

steps.instruction: 一根石英纖維在焊點附近有微裂紋時，纖維的損耗角上升並在小提琴模態（約 500 Hz）附近產生尖峰，最終可能斷裂使鏡子落到擋塊上；斷裂前的徵兆是模態 Q 值下降，必須由懸吊的共振監測發現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要把干涉儀建在安靜的地方，就不需要複雜的隔振。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「散粒雜訊振幅譜密度與壓縮光」與「絕對校正與雜訊預算」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Shot-noise amplitude spectral density and squeezed light" and "Absolute calibration and the noise budget": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 散粒雜訊振幅譜密度與壓縮光：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Shot-noise amplitude spectral density and squeezed light: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「輸出光電二極體與 300 m 濾波腔」如何決定LIGO 重力波觀測站的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Output photodiode and the 300 m filter cavity” determines the key performance of “LIGO gravitational-wave observatories”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 輸出埠的光子到達是泊松過程，功率起伏換算成等效的臂長雜訊，就是散粒雜訊；它與功率的平方根成反比，而臂腔極點以上的訊號響應下降，使散粒雜訊的等效應變在高頻隨頻率上升。LIGO 從 O3 起把壓縮真空態從輸出埠注入，把量子相位起伏壓低數 dB；O4 加入 300 m 的濾波腔產生頻率相依的壓縮，使低頻的輻射壓雜訊不因壓縮而惡化。散粒雜訊與輻射壓雜訊合稱量子雜訊，是靈敏度曲線在 100 Hz 以上的主要邊界。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「輸出光電二極體與 300 m 濾波腔」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Photon arrivals at the output port form a Poisson process, and the power fluctuation expressed as equivalent arm-length noise is shot noise; it scales inversely with the square root of power, and because the signal response falls above the arm-cavity pole, the equivalent strain noise rises with frequency. Since O3 LIGO injects a squeezed vacuum into the output port, reducing the quantum phase fluctuation by several dB; O4 added a 300 m filter cavity for frequency-dependent squeezing so that low-frequency radiation-pressure noise is not worsened by the squeezing. Shot and radiation-pressure noise together form quantum noise, the main boundary of the sensitivity curve above 100 Hz. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Output photodiode and the 300 m filter cavity”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：單純麥克森的散粒雜訊應變 h_shot = √(ħcλ/(2π·P_bs))/L：P_bs = 2 kW 時 √(2.68×10⁻³⁶) ≈ 1.64×10⁻¹⁸ m/√Hz，除以 4000 m 得 4.1×10⁻²²/√Hz。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The shot-noise strain of a simple Michelson is h_shot = √(ħcλ/(2π·P_bs))/L: with P_bs = 2 kW, √(2.68×10⁻³⁶) ≈ 1.64×10⁻¹⁸ m/√Hz, which over 4000 m is 4.1×10⁻²²/√Hz.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「散粒雜訊是偵測器電子雜訊，換更好的光電二極體就能消除。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Shot noise is detector electronic noise that a better photodiode removes." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「輸出光電二極體與 300 m 濾波腔」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Output photodiode and the 300 m filter cavity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 散粒雜訊振幅譜密度與壓縮光
knowledge.titleEn: Shot-noise amplitude spectral density and squeezed light
knowledge.text: 輸出埠的光子到達是泊松過程，功率起伏換算成等效的臂長雜訊，就是散粒雜訊；它與功率的平方根成反比，而臂腔極點以上的訊號響應下降，使散粒雜訊的等效應變在高頻隨頻率上升。LIGO 從 O3 起把壓縮真空態從輸出埠注入，把量子相位起伏壓低數 dB；O4 加入 300 m 的濾波腔產生頻率相依的壓縮，使低頻的輻射壓雜訊不因壓縮而惡化。
knowledge.textEn: Photon arrivals at the output port form a Poisson process, and the power fluctuation expressed as equivalent arm-length noise is shot noise; it scales inversely with the square root of power, and because the signal response falls above the arm-cavity pole, the equivalent strain noise rises with frequency. Since O3 LIGO injects a squeezed vacuum into the output port, reducing the quantum phase fluctuation by several dB; O4 added a 300 m filter cavity for frequency-dependent squeezing so that low-frequency radiation-pressure noise is not worsened by the squeezing.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：散粒雜訊是偵測器電子雜訊，換更好的光電二極體就能消除。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Shot noise is detector electronic noise that a better photodiode removes. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「散粒雜訊振幅譜密度與壓縮光」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Shot-noise amplitude spectral density and squeezed light" is correct?
options: 散粒雜訊是偵測器電子雜訊，換更好的光電二極體就能消除。
靈敏度曲線本身就是雜訊預算，不需要逐項分解。
輸出埠的光子到達是泊松過程，功率起伏換算成等效的臂長雜訊，就是散粒雜訊。
optionsEn: Shot noise is detector electronic noise that a better photodiode removes.
The sensitivity curve is the noise budget; no term-by-term breakdown is needed.
Photon arrivals at the output port form a Poisson process, and the power fluctuation expressed as equivalent arm-length noise is shot noise.
quiz.explanation: 輸出埠的光子到達是泊松過程，功率起伏換算成等效的臂長雜訊，就是散粒雜訊；它與功率的平方根成反比，而臂腔極點以上的訊號響應下降，使散粒雜訊的等效應變在高頻隨頻率上升。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Photon arrivals at the output port form a Poisson process, and the power fluctuation expressed as equivalent arm-length noise is shot noise; it scales inversely with the square root of power, and because the signal response falls above the arm-cavity pole, the equivalent strain noise rises with frequency. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 散粒雜訊振幅譜密度與壓縮光：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Shot-noise amplitude spectral density and squeezed light: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「輸出光電二極體與 300 m 濾波腔」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Output photodiode and the 300 m filter cavity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：單純麥克森的散粒雜訊應變 h_shot = √(ħcλ/(2π·P_bs))/L：P_bs = 2 kW 時 √(2.68×10⁻³⁶) ≈ 1.64×10⁻¹⁸ m/√Hz，除以 4000 m 得 4.1×10⁻²²/√Hz。臂腔把它除以 2F/π ≈ 286，低頻約 1.4×10⁻²⁴/√Hz；100 Hz 時乘以 √(1 + (100/42)²) ≈ 2.6 得約 3.7×10⁻²⁴/√Hz。3 dB 壓縮再乘 10^(−3/20) ≈ 0.71 得 2.6×10⁻²⁴，6 dB 則為 1.9×10⁻²⁴。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The shot-noise strain of a simple Michelson is h_shot = √(ħcλ/(2π·P_bs))/L: with P_bs = 2 kW, √(2.68×10⁻³⁶) ≈ 1.64×10⁻¹⁸ m/√Hz, which over 4000 m is 4.1×10⁻²²/√Hz. The arm cavities divide this by 2F/π ≈ 286 to about 1.4×10⁻²⁴/√Hz at low frequency; at 100 Hz multiply by √(1 + (100/42)²) ≈ 2.6 for about 3.7×10⁻²⁴/√Hz. Squeezing by 3 dB multiplies by 10^(−3/20) ≈ 0.71 for 2.6×10⁻²⁴, and 6 dB gives 1.9×10⁻²⁴. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在壓縮光開與關兩種狀態下各量一段靈敏度曲線，1 kHz 附近的雜訊比應等於壓縮量（dB）；再改變入射功率（例如 25 W 與 50 W）確認高頻雜訊按 1/√P 變化，低頻（20–40 Hz）則觀察輻射壓雜訊是否隨功率上升，驗證濾波腔的旋轉角度設定正確。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure sensitivity curves with the squeezer on and off; the noise ratio near 1 kHz should equal the squeezing level in dB.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: The shot-noise strain of a simple Michelson is h_shot = √(ħcλ/(2π·P_bs))/L: with P_bs = 2 kW, √(2.68×10⁻³⁶) ≈ 1.64×10⁻¹⁸ m/√Hz, which over 4000 m is 4.1×10⁻²²/√Hz. The arm cavities divide this by 2F/π ≈ 286 to about 1.4×10⁻²⁴/√Hz at low frequency; at 100 Hz multiply by √(1 + (100/42)²) ≈ 2.6 for about 3.7×10⁻²⁴/√Hz. Squeezing by 3 dB multiplies by 10^(−3/20) ≈ 0.71 for 2.6×10⁻²⁴, and 6 dB gives 1.9×10⁻²⁴.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界

steps.title: 散粒雜訊振幅譜密度與壓縮光：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Shot-noise amplitude spectral density and squeezed light: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「輸出光電二極體與 300 m 濾波腔」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Output photodiode and the 300 m filter cavity” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在壓縮光開與關兩種狀態下各量一段靈敏度曲線，1 kHz 附近的雜訊比應等於壓縮量（dB）；再改變入射功率（例如 25 W 與 50 W）確認高頻雜訊按 1/√P 變化，低頻（20–40 Hz）則觀察輻射壓雜訊是否隨功率上升，驗證濾波腔的旋轉角度設定正確。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure sensitivity curves with the squeezer on and off; the noise ratio near 1 kHz should equal the squeezing level in dB. Then change the input power (for example 25 W and 50 W) to confirm that high-frequency noise scales as 1/√P, and watch whether radiation-pressure noise at 20–40 Hz rises with power, verifying that the filter-cavity rotation angle is set correctly. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：輸出鏈的光學損耗從 10% 升到 30%（例如法拉第隔離器退化或模式匹配變差）時，壓縮態被真空態稀釋，原本 6 dB 的壓縮只剩 2 dB，高頻靈敏度明顯退步，而單看雷射功率與鎖定狀態都正常。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If optical loss in the output chain rises from 10% to 30%, for example from a degraded Faraday isolator or worse mode matching, the squeezed state is diluted by vacuum, 6 dB of squeezing collapses to 2 dB and high-frequency sensitivity visibly regresses while laser power and lock status look normal.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

steps.title: 散粒雜訊振幅譜密度與壓縮光：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Shot-noise amplitude spectral density and squeezed light: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「輸出光電二極體與 300 m 濾波腔」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Output photodiode and the 300 m filter cavity” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 輸出鏈的光學損耗從 10% 升到 30%（例如法拉第隔離器退化或模式匹配變差）時，壓縮態被真空態稀釋，原本 6 dB 的壓縮只剩 2 dB，高頻靈敏度明顯退步，而單看雷射功率與鎖定狀態都正常。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Shot noise is detector electronic noise that a better photodiode removes." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 絕對校正與雜訊預算：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Absolute calibration and the noise budget: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「光子校正器與雜訊預算曲線」如何決定LIGO 重力波觀測站的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Photon calibrator and noise-budget curves” determines the key performance of “LIGO gravitational-wave observatories”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 應變資料要有絕對刻度，LIGO 以光子校正器（Pcal）把一束功率調變的輔助雷射打在 ETM 上，用輻射壓產生已知的力，功率以可追溯到國家標準實驗室的功率計量測，使應變校正的不確定度達到百分之一等級；校正線連續注入，讓時間相依的讀出鏈增益可以即時追蹤。雜訊預算則把量子、鍍膜與懸吊熱雜訊、地震、牛頓、雷射頻率與強度、散射光與控制雜訊逐項以模型或注入量測估算，與實測靈敏度曲線相減，剩下的「未解釋雜訊」是調試的優先目標。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「光子校正器與雜訊預算曲線」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Strain data need an absolute scale, so LIGO uses the photon calibrator (Pcal): a power-modulated auxiliary laser hits the ETM and its radiation pressure applies a known force, with the power measured by meters traceable to national metrology laboratories, bringing strain calibration uncertainty to the percent level; calibration lines are injected continuously so that time-dependent readout gains can be tracked. The noise budget estimates quantum, coating and suspension thermal, seismic, Newtonian, laser frequency and intensity, scattered-light and control noise term by term from models or injections, subtracts them from the measured curve, and the remaining unexplained noise becomes the commissioning priority. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Photon calibrator and noise-budget curves”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：光子校正器的力 F = 2P·cosθ/c：P = 1 W、入射角 θ ≈ 9° 時 F ≈ 2×0.99/3×10⁸ ≈ 6.6×10⁻⁹ N。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The photon-calibrator force is F = 2P·cosθ/c: with P = 1 W and incidence angle θ ≈ 9°, F ≈ 2×0.99/3×10⁸ ≈ 6.6×10⁻⁹ N.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「靈敏度曲線本身就是雜訊預算，不需要逐項分解。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The sensitivity curve is the noise budget; no term-by-term breakdown is needed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「光子校正器與雜訊預算曲線」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 絕對校正與雜訊預算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Absolute calibration and the noise budget: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「光子校正器與雜訊預算曲線」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Photon calibrator and noise-budget curves” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：光子校正器的力 F = 2P·cosθ/c：P = 1 W、入射角 θ ≈ 9° 時 F ≈ 2×0.99/3×10⁸ ≈ 6.6×10⁻⁹ N。40 kg 自由質量在 100 Hz 的位移 x = F/(M·(2πf)²) = 6.6×10⁻⁹/(40×3.95×10⁵) ≈ 4.2×10⁻¹⁶ m，對應 h = x/L ≈ 1.0×10⁻¹⁹。功率計 0.5% 的不確定度直接成為應變尺度的 0.5%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The photon-calibrator force is F = 2P·cosθ/c: with P = 1 W and incidence angle θ ≈ 9°, F ≈ 2×0.99/3×10⁸ ≈ 6.6×10⁻⁹ N. A 40 kg free mass moves x = F/(M·(2πf)²) = 6.6×10⁻⁹/(40×3.95×10⁵) ≈ 4.2×10⁻¹⁶ m at 100 Hz, corresponding to h = x/L ≈ 1.0×10⁻¹⁹. A 0.5% uncertainty in the power meter becomes directly 0.5% in the strain scale. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以兩種獨立方法交叉校正：光子校正器與以雷射波長為尺的「自由擺」法（以已知的鏡子驅動在低頻掃過條紋），兩者在 100 Hz 的應變刻度應一致於 2% 內；雜訊預算則逐項做注入（例如強度雜訊注入後量耦合係數）並確認各項以均方和疊加後與實測曲線相差不超過 20%。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Cross-check with two independent methods: the photon calibrator and the free-swinging-Michelson method that uses the laser wavelength as a ruler by sweeping fringes with a known mirror drive; their strain scales at 100 Hz should agree within 2%.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 光子校正器的力 F = 2P·cosθ/c：P = 1 W、入射角 θ ≈ 9° 時 F ≈ 2×0.99/3×10⁸ ≈ 6.6×10⁻⁹ N。40 kg 自由質量在 100 Hz 的位移 x = F/(M·(2πf)²) = 6.6×10⁻⁹/(40×3.95×10⁵) ≈ 4.2×10⁻¹⁶ m，對應 h = x/L ≈ 1.0×10⁻¹⁹。功率計 0.5% 的不確定度直接成為應變尺度的 0.5%。
knowledge.textEn: The photon-calibrator force is F = 2P·cosθ/c: with P = 1 W and incidence angle θ ≈ 9°, F ≈ 2×0.99/3×10⁸ ≈ 6.6×10⁻⁹ N. A 40 kg free mass moves x = F/(M·(2πf)²) = 6.6×10⁻⁹/(40×3.95×10⁵) ≈ 4.2×10⁻¹⁶ m at 100 Hz, corresponding to h = x/L ≈ 1.0×10⁻¹⁹. A 0.5% uncertainty in the power meter becomes directly 0.5% in the strain scale.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「絕對校正與雜訊預算」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Absolute calibration and the noise budget", which statement holds?
options: 重力波會讓雷射波長跟著拉伸，所以干涉儀量不到任何東西。
光子校正器的力 F = 2P·cosθ/c：P = 1 W、入射角 θ ≈ 9° 時 F ≈ 2×0.99/3×10⁸ ≈ 6.6×10⁻⁹ N。
鏡面只要拋得夠光滑，熱雜訊就不存在。
optionsEn: A gravitational wave stretches the laser wavelength too, so the interferometer cannot measure anything.
The photon-calibrator force is F = 2P·cosθ/c: with P = 1 W and incidence angle θ ≈ 9°, F ≈ 2×0.99/3×10⁸ ≈ 6.6×10⁻⁹ N.
A mirror polished smoothly enough has no thermal noise.
quiz.explanation: 光子校正器的力 F = 2P·cosθ/c：P = 1 W、入射角 θ ≈ 9° 時 F ≈ 2×0.99/3×10⁸ ≈ 6.6×10⁻⁹ N。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The photon-calibrator force is F = 2P·cosθ/c: with P = 1 W and incidence angle θ ≈ 9°, F ≈ 2×0.99/3×10⁸ ≈ 6.6×10⁻⁹ N. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 絕對校正與雜訊預算：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Absolute calibration and the noise budget: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「光子校正器與雜訊預算曲線」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Photon calibrator and noise-budget curves” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以兩種獨立方法交叉校正：光子校正器與以雷射波長為尺的「自由擺」法（以已知的鏡子驅動在低頻掃過條紋），兩者在 100 Hz 的應變刻度應一致於 2% 內；雜訊預算則逐項做注入（例如強度雜訊注入後量耦合係數）並確認各項以均方和疊加後與實測曲線相差不超過 20%。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Cross-check with two independent methods: the photon calibrator and the free-swinging-Michelson method that uses the laser wavelength as a ruler by sweeping fringes with a known mirror drive; their strain scales at 100 Hz should agree within 2%. For the noise budget inject each term (for example measure the coupling after an intensity-noise injection) and confirm that the quadrature sum of all terms matches the measured curve within 20%. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：光子校正器光束未對準 ETM 的指定位置，輻射壓除了平移還激發鏡面的鼓面模態與傾斜，校正線的響應偏離自由質量模型，整段觀測資料的振幅校正出現數個百分比的系統誤差，波源距離的推算也跟著偏移。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the photon-calibrator beams are misaligned from their designated positions on the ETM, the radiation pressure excites drumhead modes and tilt in addition to translation, the calibration-line response departs from the free-mass model, the amplitude calibration of the whole data segment carries a systematic error of several percent and inferred source distances shift with it.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

For the noise budget inject each term (for example measure the coupling after an intensity-noise injection) and confirm that the quadrature sum of all terms matches the measured curve within 20%.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.explanationEn: Cross-check with two independent methods: the photon calibrator and the free-swinging-Michelson method that uses the laser wavelength as a ruler by sweeping fringes with a known mirror drive; their strain scales at 100 Hz should agree within 2%. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 絕對校正與雜訊預算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Absolute calibration and the noise budget: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「光子校正器與雜訊預算曲線」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Photon calibrator and noise-budget curves” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 光子校正器光束未對準 ETM 的指定位置，輻射壓除了平移還激發鏡面的鼓面模態與傾斜，校正線的響應偏離自由質量模型，整段觀測資料的振幅校正出現數個百分比的系統誤差，波源距離的推算也跟著偏移。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the photon-calibrator beams are misaligned from their designated positions on the ETM, the radiation pressure excites drumhead modes and tilt in addition to translation, the calibration-line response departs from the free-mass model, the amplitude calibration of the whole data segment carries a systematic error of several percent and inferred source distances shift with it. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：雜訊預算則把量子、鍍膜與懸吊熱雜訊、地震、牛頓、雷射頻率與強度、散射光與控制雜訊逐項以模型或注入量測估算，與實測靈敏度曲線相減，剩下的「未解釋雜訊」是調試的優先目標。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The noise budget estimates quantum, coating and suspension thermal, seismic, Newtonian, laser frequency and intensity, scattered-light and control noise term by term from models or injections, subtracts them from the measured curve, and the remaining unexplained noise becomes the commissioning priority.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「靈敏度曲線本身就是雜訊預算，不需要逐項分解。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The sensitivity curve is the noise budget; no term-by-term breakdown is needed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.questionEn: When "Absolute calibration and the noise budget" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鎖定獲取與長度／對準控制」與「觀測運行整備、資料品質與工程交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Lock acquisition and length and alignment control" and "Run readiness, data quality and engineering handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鎖定獲取與長度／對準控制：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Lock acquisition and length and alignment control: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「臂長穩定系統（532 nm）與長度控制迴路」如何決定LIGO 重力波觀測站的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Arm-length stabilisation (532 nm) and length-control loops” determines the key performance of “LIGO gravitational-wave observatories”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 干涉儀有五個長度自由度（兩臂共模與差模、麥克森、功率循環腔、訊號循環腔）與數十個角度自由度，都要同時鎖在共振點上才能工作。高精細度臂腔的共振寬度只有約 1 nm，自由擺動的鏡子以微米每秒的速度掃過它，紅外光來不及建立共振，因此先用 532 nm 的倍頻光經臂長穩定系統（ALS）把臂長鎖到數奈米內，再切換到紅外鎖定、逐步提高功率。鎖定後由 Pound–Drever–Hall 式的射頻感測與波前感測器提供誤差訊號，數位控制系統以每秒 16384 次的速率驅動懸吊各級的致動器。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「臂長穩定系統（532 nm）與長度控制迴路」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The interferometer has five length degrees of freedom (common and differential arm, Michelson, power-recycling and signal-recycling cavities) and tens of angular ones, all of which must sit on resonance simultaneously. A high-finesse arm resonance is only about 1 nm wide and a freely swinging mirror sweeps through it at micrometres per second, too fast for the infrared light to build up, so 532 nm frequency-doubled light through the arm-length stabilisation system (ALS) first holds the arms within a few nanometres, after which the infrared lock is handed over and the power raised in steps. Once locked, Pound–Drever–Hall-type radio-frequency sensing and wavefront sensors provide error signals, and the digital control system drives the suspension actuators at 16384 samples per second. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Arm-length stabilisation (532 nm) and length-control loops”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The arm linewidth expressed in length is λ/(2F) = 1.064×10⁻⁶/900 ≈ 1.2 nm and the storage time τ_s = 2LF/(πc) = 2×4000×450/(π×3×10⁸) ≈ 3.8 ms.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鎖定只要把鏡子固定不動就行了。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Locking just means holding the mirrors still." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「臂長穩定系統（532 nm）與長度控制迴路」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Arm-length stabilisation (532 nm) and length-control loops”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「鎖定獲取與長度／對準控制」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Lock acquisition and length and alignment control" is correct?
options: 鎖定只要把鏡子固定不動就行了。

steps.title: 鎖定獲取與長度／對準控制：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lock acquisition and length and alignment control: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「臂長穩定系統（532 nm）與長度控制迴路」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Arm-length stabilisation (532 nm) and length-control loops” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：臂腔線寬以長度表示為 λ/(2F) = 1.064×10⁻⁶/900 ≈ 1.2 nm；儲存時間 τ_s = 2LF/(πc) = 2×4000×450/(π×3×10⁸) ≈ 3.8 ms。鏡子穿越線寬的速度若超過約 1.2 nm/3.8 ms ≈ 0.3 µm/s，腔內功率來不及建立；自由擺動的測試質量速度約 1 µm/s，所以必須先用 ALS 把相對速度壓到 0.1 µm/s 以下。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The arm linewidth expressed in length is λ/(2F) = 1.064×10⁻⁶/900 ≈ 1.2 nm and the storage time τ_s = 2LF/(πc) = 2×4000×450/(π×3×10⁸) ≈ 3.8 ms. If the mirror crosses the linewidth faster than about 1.2 nm/3.8 ms ≈ 0.3 µm/s the intracavity power cannot build up; a freely swinging test mass moves at about 1 µm/s, so the ALS must first bring the relative velocity below 0.1 µm/s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：記錄每次鎖定獲取的各步驟時間與失敗點，統計臂長在 ALS 階段的殘餘 RMS（應為奈米級）與紅外切換時的功率建立曲線；對每個長度迴路量開迴路轉移函數，確認單位增益頻率與相位裕度（例如差模迴路約 50–100 Hz、相位裕度大於 30°），並在觀測前存檔。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Log the timing of each lock-acquisition step and its failure points, and record the residual arm-length RMS during the ALS stage (nanometre level) and the power build-up curve at the infrared handover; measure the open-loop transfer function of every length loop, confirming unity-gain frequency and phase margin (for example about 50–100 Hz and more than 30° for the differential loop), and archive them before the run.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 臂腔線寬以長度表示為 λ/(2F) = 1.064×10⁻⁶/900 ≈ 1.2 nm；儲存時間 τ_s = 2LF/(πc) = 2×4000×450/(π×3×10⁸) ≈ 3.8 ms。鏡子穿越線寬的速度若超過約 1.2 nm/3.8 ms ≈ 0.3 µm/s，腔內功率來不及建立；自由擺動的測試質量速度約 1 µm/s，所以必須先用 ALS 把相對速度壓到 0.1 µm/s 以下。
knowledge.textEn: The arm linewidth expressed in length is λ/(2F) = 1.064×10⁻⁶/900 ≈ 1.2 nm and the storage time τ_s = 2LF/(πc) = 2×4000×450/(π×3×10⁸) ≈ 3.8 ms. If the mirror crosses the linewidth faster than about 1.2 nm/3.8 ms ≈ 0.3 µm/s the intracavity power cannot build up; a freely swinging test mass moves at about 1 µm/s, so the ALS must first bring the relative velocity below 0.1 µm/s.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。

steps.title: 鎖定獲取與長度／對準控制：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lock acquisition and length and alignment control: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「臂長穩定系統（532 nm）與長度控制迴路」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Arm-length stabilisation (532 nm) and length-control loops” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 記錄每次鎖定獲取的各步驟時間與失敗點，統計臂長在 ALS 階段的殘餘 RMS（應為奈米級）與紅外切換時的功率建立曲線；對每個長度迴路量開迴路轉移函數，確認單位增益頻率與相位裕度（例如差模迴路約 50–100 Hz、相位裕度大於 30°），並在觀測前存檔。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Log the timing of each lock-acquisition step and its failure points, and record the residual arm-length RMS during the ALS stage (nanometre level) and the power build-up curve at the infrared handover; measure the open-loop transfer function of every length loop, confirming unity-gain frequency and phase margin (for example about 50–100 Hz and more than 30° for the differential loop), and archive them before the run. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：輔助雷射的倍頻光功率下降一半時，ALS 的誤差訊號訊噪比不足，臂長殘餘從 1 nm 升到數 nm，紅外切換屢屢失敗，干涉儀整夜無法鎖定；若值班人員只重複嘗試而不查綠光功率，會損失整個觀測夜。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: When the frequency-doubled auxiliary laser power halves, the ALS error signal lacks signal-to-noise, the residual arm length grows from 1 nm to several nanometres, the infrared handover fails repeatedly and the interferometer cannot lock all night; an operator who simply retries without checking the green power loses the whole observing night.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鎖定獲取與長度／對準控制」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

quiz.explanationEn: Log the timing of each lock-acquisition step and its failure points, and record the residual arm-length RMS during the ALS stage (nanometre level) and the power build-up curve at the infrared handover; measure the open-loop transfer function of every length loop, confirming unity-gain frequency and phase margin (for example about 50–100 Hz and more than 30° for the differential loop), and archive them before the run. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 鎖定獲取與長度／對準控制：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Lock acquisition and length and alignment control: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「臂長穩定系統（532 nm）與長度控制迴路」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Arm-length stabilisation (532 nm) and length-control loops” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 輔助雷射的倍頻光功率下降一半時，ALS 的誤差訊號訊噪比不足，臂長殘餘從 1 nm 升到數 nm，紅外切換屢屢失敗，干涉儀整夜無法鎖定；若值班人員只重複嘗試而不查綠光功率，會損失整個觀測夜。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: When the frequency-doubled auxiliary laser power halves, the ALS error signal lacks signal-to-noise, the residual arm length grows from 1 nm to several nanometres, the infrared handover fails repeatedly and the interferometer cannot lock all night; an operator who simply retries without checking the green power loses the whole observing night. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：鎖定後由 Pound–Drever–Hall 式的射頻感測與波前感測器提供誤差訊號，數位控制系統以每秒 16384 次的速率驅動懸吊各級的致動器。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Once locked, Pound–Drever–Hall-type radio-frequency sensing and wavefront sensors provide error signals, and the digital control system drives the suspension actuators at 16384 samples per second.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鎖定只要把鏡子固定不動就行了。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Locking just means holding the mirrors still." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。

quiz.question: 在「鎖定獲取與長度／對準控制」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

輔助雷射的倍頻光功率下降一半時，ALS 的誤差訊號訊噪比不足，臂長殘餘從 1 nm 升到數 nm，紅外切換屢屢失敗，干涉儀整夜無法鎖定。

steps.title: 觀測運行整備、資料品質與工程交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Run readiness, data quality and engineering handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「觀測運行交接文件與雙站符合」如何決定LIGO 重力波觀測站的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Observing-run handoff record and two-site coincidence” determines the key performance of “LIGO gravitational-wave observatories”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 一次觀測運行的交接包含：校正模型與不確定度、各頻段的雜訊預算、鎖定與重鎖程序、環境監測（地震計、麥克風、磁力計）通道清單、資料品質旗標定義，以及兩站的時間同步（GPS 對時至微秒以內）。偵測器的科學價值以雙中子星可探測距離（BNS range）與工作週期（duty cycle）量化，兩站同時運作才能壓低假警報率並做到天區定位；因此工程交接的目標不是單站的最佳靈敏度，而是網路的穩定與可重現性。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「觀測運行交接文件與雙站符合」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The handoff for an observing run includes the calibration model and its uncertainty, the noise budget per frequency band, lock and relock procedures, the list of environmental channels (seismometers, microphones, magnetometers), data-quality flag definitions and the time synchronisation of the two sites (GPS to better than a microsecond). A detector's scientific value is quantified by the binary-neutron-star range and the duty cycle, and both sites must run together to suppress false alarms and localise sources on the sky; the goal of the engineering handoff is therefore not one site's best sensitivity but the stability and reproducibility of the network. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Observing-run handoff record and two-site coincidence”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：可探測體積隨距離的三次方：BNS range 從 130 Mpc 提高到 160 Mpc，事件率乘以 (160/130)³ ≈ 1.86；靈敏度每改善 10%，事件率約增加 33%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Detectable volume scales as the cube of range: raising the BNS range from 130 Mpc to 160 Mpc multiplies the event rate by (160/130)³ ≈ 1.86, and every 10% improvement in sensitivity adds about 33% more events.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要一站靈敏度夠高，就能單獨確認重力波事件。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One sufficiently sensitive site can confirm a gravitational-wave event on its own." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「觀測運行交接文件與雙站符合」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Observing-run handoff record and two-site coincidence”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.
