steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「觀測運行交接文件與雙站符合」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Observing-run handoff record and two-site coincidence” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：可探測體積隨距離的三次方：BNS range 從 130 Mpc 提高到 160 Mpc，事件率乘以 (160/130)³ ≈ 1.86；靈敏度每改善 10%，事件率約增加 33%。兩站各 75% 的工作週期若彼此獨立，雙站同時運作的時間比例為 0.75² ≈ 0.56，因此工作週期的提升與靈敏度同等重要。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Detectable volume scales as the cube of range: raising the BNS range from 130 Mpc to 160 Mpc multiplies the event rate by (160/130)³ ≈ 1.86, and every 10% improvement in sensitivity adds about 33% more events. With independent duty cycles of 75% at each site, both run together only 0.75² ≈ 0.56 of the time, so duty-cycle gains matter as much as sensitivity. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：運行前做硬體注入：在兩站同時注入已知波形，確認離線分析管線以正確的時間差、振幅與相位回復訊號；統計一週的 BNS range、工作週期與每個資料品質旗標移除的時間比例，寫入交接紀錄並與上一次運行比較，任何退步都要有對應的工程單據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before the run perform hardware injections: inject a known waveform at both sites simultaneously and confirm that the offline analysis pipelines recover it with the correct time delay, amplitude and phase; over one week tabulate the BNS range, duty cycle and the fraction of time removed by each data-quality flag, enter them in the handoff record and compare with the previous run, with an engineering ticket for every regression.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.text: 可探測體積隨距離的三次方：BNS range 從 130 Mpc 提高到 160 Mpc，事件率乘以 (160/130)³ ≈ 1.86；靈敏度每改善 10%，事件率約增加 33%。兩站各 75% 的工作週期若彼此獨立，雙站同時運作的時間比例為 0.75² ≈ 0.56，因此工作週期的提升與靈敏度同等重要。
knowledge.textEn: Detectable volume scales as the cube of range: raising the BNS range from 130 Mpc to 160 Mpc multiplies the event rate by (160/130)³ ≈ 1.86, and every 10% improvement in sensitivity adds about 33% more events. With independent duty cycles of 75% at each site, both run together only 0.75² ≈ 0.56 of the time, so duty-cycle gains matter as much as sensitivity.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「觀測運行整備、資料品質與工程交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Run readiness, data quality and engineering handoff", which statement holds?
options: 可探測體積隨距離的三次方：BNS range 從 130 Mpc 提高到 160 Mpc，事件率乘以 (160/130)³ ≈ 1.86。
鏡面只要拋得夠光滑，熱雜訊就不存在。
散粒雜訊是偵測器電子雜訊，換更好的光電二極體就能消除。
optionsEn: Detectable volume scales as the cube of range: raising the BNS range from 130 Mpc to 160 Mpc multiplies the event rate by (160/130)³ ≈ 1.86, and every 10% improvement in sensitivity adds about 33% more events.
A mirror polished smoothly enough has no thermal noise.
Shot noise is detector electronic noise that a better photodiode removes.
quiz.explanation: 可探測體積隨距離的三次方：BNS range 從 130 Mpc 提高到 160 Mpc，事件率乘以 (160/130)³ ≈ 1.86；靈敏度每改善 10%，事件率約增加 33%。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.title: 觀測運行整備、資料品質與工程交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Run readiness, data quality and engineering handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「觀測運行交接文件與雙站符合」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Observing-run handoff record and two-site coincidence” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 運行前做硬體注入：在兩站同時注入已知波形，確認離線分析管線以正確的時間差、振幅與相位回復訊號；統計一週的 BNS range、工作週期與每個資料品質旗標移除的時間比例，寫入交接紀錄並與上一次運行比較，任何退步都要有對應的工程單據。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before the run perform hardware injections: inject a known waveform at both sites simultaneously and confirm that the offline analysis pipelines recover it with the correct time delay, amplitude and phase; over one week tabulate the BNS range, duty cycle and the fraction of time removed by each data-quality flag, enter them in the handoff record and compare with the previous run, with an engineering ticket for every regression. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：站內某台冷卻機或空調造成的 60 Hz 諧波散射光雜訊未被標成資料品質旗標，離線搜尋把它當成候選事件或拉高背景，雙站符合分析的假警報率上升，最終迫使團隊重新處理整段資料。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A chiller or air-handler at one site producing 60 Hz harmonic scattered-light noise that is not flagged for data quality lets the offline search treat it as a candidate or raises the background, the false-alarm rate of the two-site coincidence analysis climbs and the team is forced to reprocess the whole data segment.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 運行前做硬體注入：在兩站同時注入已知波形，確認離線分析管線以正確的時間差、振幅與相位回復訊號；統計一週的 BNS range、工作週期與每個資料品質旗標移除的時間比例，寫入交接紀錄並與上一次運行比較，任何退步都要有對應的工程單據。
knowledge.textEn: Before the run perform hardware injections: inject a known waveform at both sites simultaneously and confirm that the offline analysis pipelines recover it with the correct time delay, amplitude and phase; over one week tabulate the BNS range, duty cycle and the fraction of time removed by each data-quality flag, enter them in the handoff record and compare with the previous run, with an engineering ticket for every regression.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「觀測運行整備、資料品質與工程交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Run readiness, data quality and engineering handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
運行前做硬體注入：在兩站同時注入已知波形，確認離線分析管線以正確的時間差、振幅與相位回復訊號。
靈敏度曲線本身就是雜訊預算，不需要逐項分解。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.

Before the run perform hardware injections: inject a known waveform at both sites simultaneously and confirm that the offline analysis pipelines recover it with the correct time delay, amplitude and phase.
The sensitivity curve is the noise budget; no term-by-term breakdown is needed.
quiz.explanation: 運行前做硬體注入：在兩站同時注入已知波形，確認離線分析管線以正確的時間差、振幅與相位回復訊號；統計一週的 BNS range、工作週期與每個資料品質旗標移除的時間比例，寫入交接紀錄並與上一次運行比較，任何退步都要有對應的工程單據。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before the run perform hardware injections: inject a known waveform at both sites simultaneously and confirm that the offline analysis pipelines recover it with the correct time delay, amplitude and phase; over one week tabulate the BNS range, duty cycle and the fraction of time removed by each data-quality flag, enter them in the handoff record and compare with the previous run, with an engineering ticket for every regression. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 觀測運行整備、資料品質與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Run readiness, data quality and engineering handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「觀測運行交接文件與雙站符合」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Observing-run handoff record and two-site coincidence” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 站內某台冷卻機或空調造成的 60 Hz 諧波散射光雜訊未被標成資料品質旗標，離線搜尋把它當成候選事件或拉高背景，雙站符合分析的假警報率上升，最終迫使團隊重新處理整段資料。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A chiller or air-handler at one site producing 60 Hz harmonic scattered-light noise that is not flagged for data quality lets the offline search treat it as a candidate or raises the background, the false-alarm rate of the two-site coincidence analysis climbs and the team is forced to reprocess the whole data segment. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：偵測器的科學價值以雙中子星可探測距離（BNS range）與工作週期（duty cycle）量化，兩站同時運作才能壓低假警報率並做到天區定位；因此工程交接的目標不是單站的最佳靈敏度，而是網路的穩定與可重現性。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A detector's scientific value is quantified by the binary-neutron-star range and the duty cycle, and both sites must run together to suppress false alarms and localise sources on the sky; the goal of the engineering handoff is therefore not one site's best sensitivity but the stability and reproducibility of the network.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要一站靈敏度夠高，就能單獨確認重力波事件。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One sufficiently sensitive site can confirm a gravitational-wave event on its own." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 站內某台冷卻機或空調造成的 60 Hz 諧波散射光雜訊未被標成資料品質旗標，離線搜尋把它當成候選事件或拉高背景，雙站符合分析的假警報率上升，最終迫使團隊重新處理整段資料。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「觀測運行整備、資料品質與工程交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Run readiness, data quality and engineering handoff" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
重力波會讓雷射波長跟著拉伸，所以干涉儀量不到任何東西。
站內某台冷卻機或空調造成的 60 Hz 諧波散射光雜訊未被標成資料品質旗標，離線搜尋把它當成候選事件或拉高背景，雙站符合分析的假警報率上升，最終迫使團隊重新處理整段資料。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
A gravitational wave stretches the laser wavelength too, so the interferometer cannot measure anything.

A chiller or air-handler at one site producing 60 Hz harmonic scattered-light noise that is not flagged for data quality lets the offline search treat it as a candidate or raises the background, the false-alarm rate of the two-site coincidence analysis climbs and the team is forced to reprocess the whole data segment.

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: Virgo 重力波干涉儀
summary: 以義大利卡希納 EGO 的 Advanced Virgo 為對象，從 3 km 臂腔的自由光譜範圍與線寬出發，解析卡希納近海站址的地震雜訊為何需要約 9 m 高、以倒立擺預隔離的超級衰減器，42 kg 熔融石英鏡的熱透鏡如何用 CO₂ 雷射補償，牛頓雜訊、牛頓校正器與 1.2 m 真空管殘氣如何進入靈敏度預算，以及三站網路的天區定位與運行交接。
summaryEn: Using Advanced Virgo at EGO in Cascina, Italy, this course starts from the free spectral range and linewidth of 3 km arm cavities, explains why the seismic noise of the near-coastal Cascina site demands a superattenuator about 9 m tall with inverted-pendulum pre-isolation, how the thermal lens in 42 kg fused-silica mirrors is compensated with CO₂ lasers, how Newtonian noise, the Newtonian calibrator and residual gas in the 1.2 m vacuum tubes enter the sensitivity budget, and how three-detector sky localisation and run handoff are organised.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 超級衰減器隔振預算練習（教學假設）：10 Hz 的地面位移 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz。倒立擺調到 0.04 Hz，傳遞率 (0.04/10)² = 1.6×10⁻⁵；五級機械濾波器各 0.4 Hz，傳遞率 (0.4/10)¹⁰ = 1.05×10⁻¹⁴；理論總衰減 1.7×10⁻¹⁹，鏡子水平殘餘 1.7×10⁻²⁸ m/√Hz。實際上交叉耦合把衰減限制在約 10⁻¹²，殘餘 10⁻²¹ m/√Hz，對應 h = 10⁻²¹/3000 ≈ 3.3×10⁻²⁵/√Hz，仍比 10 Hz 處約 10⁻²³ 的設計目標低 30 倍。垂直方向：若垂直殘餘也為 10⁻²¹ m/√Hz，地球曲率使兩端局部鉛垂線相差 L/R_E = 3000/6.37×10⁶ ≈ 4.7×10⁻⁴ rad，加上機械失準取總耦合 1%，水平等效為 10⁻²³ m/√Hz，可忽略。結論是 10 Hz 的真正邊界不是地震而是懸吊熱雜訊、控制雜訊與牛頓雜訊。數值為教學假設。
workedExample.textEn: Superattenuator isolation-budget exercise (teaching assumptions): ground displacement at 10 Hz is 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz. The inverted pendulum tuned to 0.04 Hz transmits (0.04/10)² = 1.6×10⁻⁵; five mechanical filters at 0.4 Hz each transmit (0.4/10)¹⁰ = 1.05×10⁻¹⁴; the theoretical total attenuation is 1.7×10⁻¹⁹ and the residual horizontal mirror motion 1.7×10⁻²⁸ m/√Hz. In practice cross-couplings cap the attenuation near 10⁻¹², leaving 10⁻²¹ m/√Hz, or h = 10⁻²¹/3000 ≈ 3.3×10⁻²⁵/√Hz, still 30 times below the design target of about 10⁻²³ at 10 Hz. Vertically: if the vertical residual is also 10⁻²¹ m/√Hz, Earth curvature makes the local verticals at the two ends differ by L/R_E = 3000/6.37×10⁶ ≈ 4.7×10⁻⁴ rad, and taking 1% total coupling including mechanical misalignment gives a horizontal equivalent of 10⁻²³ m/√Hz, negligible. The conclusion is that the real boundary at 10 Hz is not seismic motion but suspension thermal, control and Newtonian noise. Values are teaching assumptions.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「3 km 臂的共振參數與應變尺度」與「地震雜訊與低頻隔振需求」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Resonance parameters and strain scale of 3 km arms" and "Seismic noise and the low-frequency isolation requirement": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 3 km 臂的共振參數與應變尺度：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Resonance parameters and strain scale of 3 km arms: mechanism and system boundary

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “3 km arm cavities and free spectral range” determines the key performance of “Virgo gravitational-wave interferometer”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: Virgo 是臂長 3 km 的功率循環 Fabry–Pérot 麥克森干涉儀，兩臂互相垂直，1064 nm 雷射在分光鏡分成兩束，臂端鏡把光送回分光鏡在輸出埠以暗紋干涉。臂腔的自由光譜範圍由臂長決定，線寬由精細度決定，腔極點則是訊號響應開始下降的頻率；臂長 3 km 而非 4 km，表示在相同精細度與功率下，對同一應變的相位訊號小 25%，因此 Virgo 的設計更倚重低頻隔振與高功率來補償。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「3 km 臂腔與自由光譜範圍」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.title: 3 km 臂的共振參數與應變尺度：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「3 km 臂腔與自由光譜範圍」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “3 km arm cavities and free spectral range” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：自由光譜範圍 FSR = c/(2L) = 3×10⁸/6000 = 50 kHz；精細度 F ≈ 450 時線寬 FSR/F ≈ 111 Hz，腔極點 f_p = c/(4LF) = 3×10⁸/(4×3000×450) ≈ 56 Hz。應變 h = 3.3×10⁻²² 對應 ΔL = h·L ≈ 1×10⁻¹⁸ m，約為質子直徑的千分之一。散粒雜訊應變正比於 1/(F·L)，故同精細度、同功率下 3 km 臂的散粒雜訊比 4 km 臂高 4/3 ≈ 1.33 倍。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Free spectral range FSR = c/(2L) = 3×10⁸/6000 = 50 kHz; with finesse F ≈ 450 the linewidth is FSR/F ≈ 111 Hz and the cavity pole f_p = c/(4LF) = 3×10⁸/(4×3000×450) ≈ 56 Hz. A strain h = 3.3×10⁻²² corresponds to ΔL = h·L ≈ 1×10⁻¹⁸ m, about one thousandth of a proton diameter. Shot-noise strain scales as 1/(F·L), so at equal finesse and power 3 km arms carry 4/3 ≈ 1.33 times the shot noise of 4 km arms. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以雷射頻率掃描臂腔，記錄透射峰的間距與寬度：峰距應為 50 kHz、峰寬約 111 Hz，由此得到實際精細度；再以已知的末端鏡驅動做掃頻，量差動臂長到輸出訊號的轉移函數，確認腔極點在 56 Hz 附近且與精細度一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Sweep the laser frequency across an arm cavity and record the spacing and width of the transmission peaks: the spacing should be 50 kHz and the width about 111 Hz, giving the actual finesse; then drive an end mirror with a swept sine and measure the transfer function from differential arm length to the output signal, confirming a cavity pole near 56 Hz consistent with the finesse.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 地震雜訊與低頻隔振需求：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Seismic noise and the low-frequency isolation requirement: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「卡希納站址地震計與海洋微震」如何決定Virgo 重力波干涉儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cascina seismometers and ocean microseism” determines the key performance of “Virgo gravitational-wave interferometer”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 卡希納位於比薩附近的平原、距海岸不遠，地面在 0.2–0.5 Hz 的海洋微震振幅達微米等級，在 10 Hz 附近約 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz，且隨天氣與人類活動變化。重力波頻帶從約 10 Hz 開始，而測試質量在 10 Hz 允許的運動只有 10⁻¹⁹ m/√Hz 等級，所以隔振系統必須提供十個數量級的衰減，並且在遠低於 10 Hz 的地方就開始生效；這就是 Virgo 從一開始便把低頻性能當作核心設計目標、發展超級衰減器的原因。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「卡希納站址地震計與海洋微震」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.observation: 量級提示：所需衰減 A = x_ground/x_allowed = 10⁻⁹/10⁻¹⁹ = 10¹⁰（10 Hz）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Required attenuation A = x_ground/x_allowed = 10⁻⁹/10⁻¹⁹ = 10¹⁰ at 10 Hz.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「地震雜訊只在地震發生時才重要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 地震雜訊與低頻隔振需求：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Seismic noise and the low-frequency isolation requirement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「卡希納站址地震計與海洋微震」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cascina seismometers and ocean microseism” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：所需衰減 A = x_ground/x_allowed = 10⁻⁹/10⁻¹⁹ = 10¹⁰（10 Hz）。單級擺在共振 f₀ 以上的傳遞率 ≈ (f₀/f)²：f₀ = 0.5 Hz 時在 10 Hz 為 2.5×10⁻³；要達到 10⁻¹⁰ 需要 n 級使 (2.5×10⁻³)ⁿ ≤ 10⁻¹⁰，即 n ≥ 10/2.6 ≈ 3.9，至少四級；六級則給出 (2.5×10⁻³)⁶ ≈ 2.4×10⁻¹⁶ 的理論餘裕。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Required attenuation A = x_ground/x_allowed = 10⁻⁹/10⁻¹⁹ = 10¹⁰ at 10 Hz. One pendulum stage transmits ≈ (f₀/f)² above its resonance: with f₀ = 0.5 Hz that is 2.5×10⁻³ at 10 Hz; reaching 10⁻¹⁰ needs n stages with (2.5×10⁻³)ⁿ ≤ 10⁻¹⁰, that is n ≥ 10/2.6 ≈ 3.9, at least four, while six stages give a theoretical margin of (2.5×10⁻³)⁶ ≈ 2.4×10⁻¹⁶. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以站址地震計記錄一年中安靜與風暴日的地面位移譜，建立 10%、50%、90% 百分位曲線；把它乘以隔振系統的量測傳遞函數，與干涉儀中測試質量的實際殘餘運動（由控制訊號反推）比較，兩者在 1–10 Hz 應一致，否則存在未建模的耦合路徑。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record ground-displacement spectra on quiet and stormy days through a year with the site seismometers and build 10th, 50th and 90th percentile curves; multiply them by the measured transfer function of the isolation system and compare with the actual residual test-mass motion inferred from control signals, which should agree between 1 and 10 Hz, otherwise an unmodelled coupling path exists.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

One pendulum stage transmits ≈ (f₀/f)² above its resonance: with f₀ = 0.5 Hz that is 2.5×10⁻³ at 10 Hz; reaching 10⁻¹⁰ needs n stages with (2.5×10⁻³)ⁿ ≤ 10⁻¹⁰, that is n ≥ 10/2.6 ≈ 3.9, at least four, while six stages give a theoretical margin of (2.5×10⁻³)⁶ ≈ 2.4×10⁻¹⁶.

steps.title: 地震雜訊與低頻隔振需求：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Seismic noise and the low-frequency isolation requirement: measurement and verification

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Cascina seismometers and ocean microseism” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以站址地震計記錄一年中安靜與風暴日的地面位移譜，建立 10%、50%、90% 百分位曲線；把它乘以隔振系統的量測傳遞函數，與干涉儀中測試質量的實際殘餘運動（由控制訊號反推）比較，兩者在 1–10 Hz 應一致，否則存在未建模的耦合路徑。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record ground-displacement spectra on quiet and stormy days through a year with the site seismometers and build 10th, 50th and 90th percentile curves; multiply them by the measured transfer function of the isolation system and compare with the actual residual test-mass motion inferred from control signals, which should agree between 1 and 10 Hz, otherwise an unmodelled coupling path exists. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：冬季風暴期間海洋微震升高十倍，若控制迴路的動態範圍是依安靜日設計，致動器飽和、干涉儀反覆失鎖，工作週期在一週內從 80% 掉到 40%，而靈敏度曲線本身看似正常。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: During winter storms the ocean microseism rises tenfold; if the control loops' dynamic range was designed for quiet days, the actuators saturate, the interferometer loses lock repeatedly and the duty cycle drops from 80% to 40% within a week while the sensitivity curve itself looks normal.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

quiz.explanation: 冬季風暴期間海洋微震升高十倍，若控制迴路的動態範圍是依安靜日設計，致動器飽和、干涉儀反覆失鎖，工作週期在一週內從 80% 掉到 40%，而靈敏度曲線本身看似正常。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: During winter storms the ocean microseism rises tenfold; if the control loops' dynamic range was designed for quiet days, the actuators saturate, the interferometer loses lock repeatedly and the duty cycle drops from 80% to 40% within a week while the sensitivity curve itself looks normal. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「超級衰減器：倒立擺與磁性反彈簧濾波器」與「鏡面、單體懸吊與熱補償」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。

steps.title: 超級衰減器：倒立擺與磁性反彈簧濾波器：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: The superattenuator: inverted pendulum and magnetic anti-spring filters: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「倒立擺與機械濾波器鏈」如何決定Virgo 重力波干涉儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Inverted pendulum and mechanical-filter chain” determines the key performance of “Virgo gravitational-wave interferometer”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 超級衰減器高約 9 m：頂端是三根彈性接頭支撐的倒立擺，把水平共振頻率調到數十毫赫茲作為預隔離並提供低頻主動控制的介面；其下串接數級機械濾波器，每級以鋼製刀口懸吊提供水平擺動隔離，並以磁性反彈簧把垂直共振壓到 0.4 Hz 以下，解決垂直振動透過地球曲率與機械耦合漏進水平方向的問題；最下方是操縱盤（marionette）、反作用質量與鏡子。整條鏈以被動方式在 10 Hz 以上提供超過十個數量級的衰減，主動控制只負責抑制共振與低頻漂移。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「倒立擺與機械濾波器鏈」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The superattenuator is about 9 m tall: at the top an inverted pendulum on three flexural joints tunes the horizontal resonance to tens of millihertz as pre-isolation and the interface for low-frequency active control; below it hang several mechanical filters, each suspended on steel blades for horizontal pendulum isolation and fitted with magnetic anti-springs that push the vertical resonance below 0.4 Hz, addressing vertical vibration that leaks into the horizontal direction through Earth curvature and mechanical coupling; at the bottom are the marionette, the reaction mass and the mirror. The whole chain provides more than ten orders of magnitude of passive attenuation above 10 Hz, while active control only damps resonances and low-frequency drift. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Inverted pendulum and mechanical-filter chain”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：倒立擺的角頻率 ω² = k/M − g/L：腿長 L = 6 m 時 g/L = 1.635 s⁻²，要得到 f = 0.03 Hz（ω² = 0.0355 s⁻²）需 k/M = 1.671 s⁻²，即彈性接頭剛度只能比重力反彈簧大 2.2%，靠配重微調。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The inverted pendulum's angular frequency obeys ω² = k/M − g/L: with leg length L = 6 m, g/L = 1.635 s⁻², and reaching f = 0.03 Hz (ω² = 0.0355 s⁻²) needs k/M = 1.671 s⁻², so the flexure stiffness may exceed the gravitational anti-spring by only 2.2%, trimmed with counterweights.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「倒立擺越高越好，因為擺越長共振頻率越低。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A taller inverted pendulum is always better because a longer pendulum has a lower resonance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「倒立擺與機械濾波器鏈」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Inverted pendulum and mechanical-filter chain”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 超級衰減器：倒立擺與磁性反彈簧濾波器：定量估算
steps.titleEn: The superattenuator: inverted pendulum and magnetic anti-spring filters: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「倒立擺與機械濾波器鏈」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Inverted pendulum and mechanical-filter chain” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：倒立擺的角頻率 ω² = k/M − g/L：腿長 L = 6 m 時 g/L = 1.635 s⁻²，要得到 f = 0.03 Hz（ω² = 0.0355 s⁻²）需 k/M = 1.671 s⁻²，即彈性接頭剛度只能比重力反彈簧大 2.2%，靠配重微調。衰減：倒立擺在 10 Hz 給 (0.03/10)² = 9×10⁻⁶，五級 0.4 Hz 濾波器給 (0.4/10)¹⁰ ≈ 1×10⁻¹⁴，理論乘積約 10⁻¹⁹；實際受交叉耦合限制在 10⁻¹² 等級。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The inverted pendulum's angular frequency obeys ω² = k/M − g/L: with leg length L = 6 m, g/L = 1.635 s⁻², and reaching f = 0.03 Hz (ω² = 0.0355 s⁻²) needs k/M = 1.671 s⁻², so the flexure stiffness may exceed the gravitational anti-spring by only 2.2%, trimmed with counterweights. Attenuation: the inverted pendulum gives (0.03/10)² = 9×10⁻⁶ at 10 Hz, five 0.4 Hz filters give (0.4/10)¹⁰ ≈ 1×10⁻¹⁴, a theoretical product near 10⁻¹⁹; in practice cross-couplings limit it to the 10⁻¹² level. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在組裝時以加速度計與位移感測器量每一級的水平與垂直傳遞函數，確認倒立擺與濾波器的共振頻率；整鏈完成後在頂端施加已知的正弦激振，在鏡子端以光學槓桿或干涉儀量殘餘運動，繪出 0.1–100 Hz 的衰減曲線並與模型比較，特別檢查垂直到水平的耦合比例。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: During assembly measure the horizontal and vertical transfer functions of each stage with accelerometers and displacement sensors, confirming the resonances of the inverted pendulum and filters; once the chain is complete apply a known sinusoidal excitation at the top, measure the residual motion at the mirror with an optical lever or the interferometer, plot the attenuation from 0.1 to 100 Hz against the model and check the vertical-to-horizontal coupling ratio in particular.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 超級衰減器：倒立擺與磁性反彈簧濾波器：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: The superattenuator: inverted pendulum and magnetic anti-spring filters: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「倒立擺與機械濾波器鏈」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Inverted pendulum and mechanical-filter chain” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在組裝時以加速度計與位移感測器量每一級的水平與垂直傳遞函數，確認倒立擺與濾波器的共振頻率；整鏈完成後在頂端施加已知的正弦激振，在鏡子端以光學槓桿或干涉儀量殘餘運動，繪出 0.1–100 Hz 的衰減曲線並與模型比較，特別檢查垂直到水平的耦合比例。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: During assembly measure the horizontal and vertical transfer functions of each stage with accelerometers and displacement sensors, confirming the resonances of the inverted pendulum and filters; once the chain is complete apply a known sinusoidal excitation at the top, measure the residual motion at the mirror with an optical lever or the interferometer, plot the attenuation from 0.1 to 100 Hz against the model and check the vertical-to-horizontal coupling ratio in particular. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：一級濾波器的磁性反彈簧因溫度變化而偏離工作點，垂直共振從 0.4 Hz 升到 1 Hz 以上，該級垂直隔離退化百倍，經耦合漏進水平方向後在 10–20 Hz 出現原本不存在的雜訊平台。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If a filter's magnetic anti-spring drifts off its working point with temperature, its vertical resonance rises from 0.4 Hz to above 1 Hz, that stage's vertical isolation degrades a hundredfold and, after coupling into the horizontal direction, a noise plateau appears between 10 and 20 Hz that was never there before.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

steps.title: 超級衰減器：倒立擺與磁性反彈簧濾波器：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: The superattenuator: inverted pendulum and magnetic anti-spring filters: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「倒立擺與機械濾波器鏈」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Inverted pendulum and mechanical-filter chain” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 一級濾波器的磁性反彈簧因溫度變化而偏離工作點，垂直共振從 0.4 Hz 升到 1 Hz 以上，該級垂直隔離退化百倍，經耦合漏進水平方向後在 10–20 Hz 出現原本不存在的雜訊平台。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If a filter's magnetic anti-spring drifts off its working point with temperature, its vertical resonance rises from 0.4 Hz to above 1 Hz, that stage's vertical isolation degrades a hundredfold and, after coupling into the horizontal direction, a noise plateau appears between 10 and 20 Hz that was never there before. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：整條鏈以被動方式在 10 Hz 以上提供超過十個數量級的衰減，主動控制只負責抑制共振與低頻漂移。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The whole chain provides more than ten orders of magnitude of passive attenuation above 10 Hz, while active control only damps resonances and low-frequency drift.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「倒立擺越高越好，因為擺越長共振頻率越低。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A taller inverted pendulum is always better because a longer pendulum has a lower resonance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 鏡面、單體懸吊與熱補償：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Mirrors, monolithic suspension and thermal compensation: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「42 kg 熔融石英鏡與 CO₂ 熱補償系統」如何決定Virgo 重力波干涉儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “42 kg fused-silica mirrors and CO₂ thermal-compensation system” determines the key performance of “Virgo gravitational-wave interferometer”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: Advanced Virgo 的測試質量是直徑 35 cm、厚 20 cm、重 42 kg 的熔融石英鏡，以熔融石英纖維從操縱盤單體懸吊，鍍膜由里昂的 LMA 完成。臂內數十到數百 kW 的功率即使只被鍍膜吸收不到 1 ppm，也會在鏡面中心形成溫度梯度，透過 dn/dT 在輸入鏡基板產生熱透鏡、並使鏡面曲率改變，破壞循環腔的模式匹配。熱補償系統用 CO₂ 雷射在補償板上投射環狀加熱圖案，並以環形加熱器微調鏡面曲率，把熱透鏡抵消到設計公差內。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「42 kg 熔融石英鏡與 CO₂ 熱補償系統」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Advanced Virgo's test masses are fused-silica mirrors 35 cm across, 20 cm thick and 42 kg, hung monolithically from the marionette by fused-silica fibres, with coatings made at LMA in Lyon. Tens to hundreds of kilowatts in the arms, even with coating absorption below 1 ppm, create a temperature gradient at the mirror centre that forms a thermal lens in the input-mirror substrate through dn/dT and changes the surface curvature, spoiling the mode matching of the recycling cavities. The thermal compensation system projects ring-shaped heating patterns from CO₂ lasers onto compensation plates and trims mirror curvature with ring heaters, cancelling the thermal lens to within the design tolerance. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “42 kg fused-silica mirrors and CO₂ thermal-compensation system”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：薄碟熱透鏡焦距近似 f_th ≈ π·κ·w²/(P_abs·dn/dT)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The thin-disk thermal-lens focal length is approximately f_th ≈ π·κ·w²/(P_abs·dn/dT).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鍍膜吸收不到 1 ppm，所以熱效應可以忽略。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With coating absorption under 1 ppm, thermal effects are negligible." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「42 kg 熔融石英鏡與 CO₂ 熱補償系統」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “42 kg fused-silica mirrors and CO₂ thermal-compensation system”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 鏡面、單體懸吊與熱補償：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Mirrors, monolithic suspension and thermal compensation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「42 kg 熔融石英鏡與 CO₂ 熱補償系統」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “42 kg fused-silica mirrors and CO₂ thermal-compensation system” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：薄碟熱透鏡焦距近似 f_th ≈ π·κ·w²/(P_abs·dn/dT)。取熔融石英 κ = 1.38 W/(m·K)、dn/dT = 1.2×10⁻⁵/K、光斑半徑 w = 5 cm、臂內 100 kW 被鍍膜吸收 0.5 ppm 得 P_abs = 50 mW：f_th ≈ π×1.38×2.5×10⁻³/(0.05×1.2×10⁻⁵) ≈ 0.0108/6×10⁻⁷ ≈ 1.8×10⁴ m。對邊際穩定的循環腔，18 km 的透鏡已足以改變腔的高斯模態，所以補償必須把等效焦距推到數百 km 以上。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The thin-disk thermal-lens focal length is approximately f_th ≈ π·κ·w²/(P_abs·dn/dT). With fused silica κ = 1.38 W/(m·K), dn/dT = 1.2×10⁻⁵/K, spot radius w = 5 cm and P_abs = 50 mW from 100 kW in the arm absorbed at 0.5 ppm by the coating: f_th ≈ π×1.38×2.5×10⁻³/(0.05×1.2×10⁻⁵) ≈ 0.0108/6×10⁻⁷ ≈ 1.8×10⁴ m. For a marginally stable recycling cavity an 18 km lens already changes the cavity's Gaussian mode, so compensation must push the effective focal length beyond several hundred kilometres. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以 Hartmann 波前感測器透過輸入鏡量熱透鏡的光程差分佈，隨功率提升記錄曲率變化；開啟熱補償後確認殘餘光程差低於數十奈米，並以循環腔的高階模態含量（由相機看模式形狀）與循環增益回升來佐證。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the optical-path-difference map of the thermal lens through the input mirror with a Hartmann wavefront sensor, logging the curvature change as power rises; after enabling thermal compensation confirm that the residual optical path is below tens of nanometres, supported by the higher-order-mode content of the recycling cavity (mode shape on a camera) and the recovery of recycling gain.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 薄碟熱透鏡焦距近似 f_th ≈ π·κ·w²/(P_abs·dn/dT)。取熔融石英 κ = 1.38 W/(m·K)、dn/dT = 1.2×10⁻⁵/K、光斑半徑 w = 5 cm、臂內 100 kW 被鍍膜吸收 0.5 ppm 得 P_abs = 50 mW：f_th ≈ π×1.38×2.5×10⁻³/(0.05×1.2×10⁻⁵) ≈ 0.0108/6×10⁻⁷ ≈ 1.8×10⁴ m。對邊際穩定的循環腔，18 km 的透鏡已足以改變腔的高斯模態，所以補償必須把等效焦距推到數百 km 以上。
knowledge.textEn: The thin-disk thermal-lens focal length is approximately f_th ≈ π·κ·w²/(P_abs·dn/dT). With fused silica κ = 1.38 W/(m·K), dn/dT = 1.2×10⁻⁵/K, spot radius w = 5 cm and P_abs = 50 mW from 100 kW in the arm absorbed at 0.5 ppm by the coating: f_th ≈ π×1.38×2.5×10⁻³/(0.05×1.2×10⁻⁵) ≈ 0.0108/6×10⁻⁷ ≈ 1.8×10⁴ m. For a marginally stable recycling cavity an 18 km lens already changes the cavity's Gaussian mode, so compensation must push the effective focal length beyond several hundred kilometres.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「鏡面、單體懸吊與熱補償」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Mirrors, monolithic suspension and thermal compensation", which statement holds?
options: 真空只是為了避免灰塵與空氣散射，對雜訊曲線沒有直接貢獻。
臂長 3 km 與 4 km 的差別只是場地大小，與靈敏度無關。
薄碟熱透鏡焦距近似 f_th ≈ π·κ·w²/(P_abs·dn/dT)。
optionsEn: Vacuum only keeps dust and air scatter away and has no direct place in the noise curve.
The difference between 3 km and 4 km arms is only site size, not sensitivity.
The thin-disk thermal-lens focal length is approximately f_th ≈ π·κ·w²/(P_abs·dn/dT).
quiz.explanation: 薄碟熱透鏡焦距近似 f_th ≈ π·κ·w²/(P_abs·dn/dT)。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The thin-disk thermal-lens focal length is approximately f_th ≈ π·κ·w²/(P_abs·dn/dT). Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鏡面、單體懸吊與熱補償：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Mirrors, monolithic suspension and thermal compensation: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「42 kg 熔融石英鏡與 CO₂ 熱補償系統」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “42 kg fused-silica mirrors and CO₂ thermal-compensation system” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以 Hartmann 波前感測器透過輸入鏡量熱透鏡的光程差分佈，隨功率提升記錄曲率變化；開啟熱補償後確認殘餘光程差低於數十奈米，並以循環腔的高階模態含量（由相機看模式形狀）與循環增益回升來佐證。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the optical-path-difference map of the thermal lens through the input mirror with a Hartmann wavefront sensor, logging the curvature change as power rises; after enabling thermal compensation confirm that the residual optical path is below tens of nanometres, supported by the higher-order-mode content of the recycling cavity (mode shape on a camera) and the recovery of recycling gain. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：一面輸入鏡的點吸收缺陷使局部吸收升高，熱透鏡不再是軸對稱，環狀 CO₂ 加熱圖案無法抵消，循環腔內出現高階模態、增益下降且控制訊號出現偏移；只有加大補償功率反而讓整體熱雜訊升高。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A point-absorber defect on one input mirror raises local absorption so the thermal lens is no longer axisymmetric; the ring-shaped CO₂ pattern cannot cancel it, higher-order modes appear in the recycling cavity, gain drops and control signals pick up offsets; simply raising the compensation power only increases overall thermal noise.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以 Hartmann 波前感測器透過輸入鏡量熱透鏡的光程差分佈，隨功率提升記錄曲率變化；開啟熱補償後確認殘餘光程差低於數十奈米，並以循環腔的高階模態含量（由相機看模式形狀）與循環增益回升來佐證。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the optical-path-difference map of the thermal lens through the input mirror with a Hartmann wavefront sensor, logging the curvature change as power rises; after enabling thermal compensation confirm that the residual optical path is below tens of nanometres, supported by the higher-order-mode content of the recycling cavity (mode shape on a camera) and the recovery of recycling gain.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鏡面、單體懸吊與熱補償」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Mirrors, monolithic suspension and thermal compensation"?
options: 以 Hartmann 波前感測器透過輸入鏡量熱透鏡的光程差分佈，隨功率提升記錄曲率變化。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
地震雜訊只在地震發生時才重要。
optionsEn: Measure the optical-path-difference map of the thermal lens through the input mirror with a Hartmann wavefront sensor, logging the curvature change as power rises.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Seismic noise only matters when an earthquake happens.
quiz.explanation: 以 Hartmann 波前感測器透過輸入鏡量熱透鏡的光程差分佈，隨功率提升記錄曲率變化；開啟熱補償後確認殘餘光程差低於數十奈米，並以循環腔的高階模態含量（由相機看模式形狀）與循環增益回升來佐證。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure the optical-path-difference map of the thermal lens through the input mirror with a Hartmann wavefront sensor, logging the curvature change as power rises; after enabling thermal compensation confirm that the residual optical path is below tens of nanometres, supported by the higher-order-mode content of the recycling cavity (mode shape on a camera) and the recovery of recycling gain. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 鏡面、單體懸吊與熱補償：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Mirrors, monolithic suspension and thermal compensation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「42 kg 熔融石英鏡與 CO₂ 熱補償系統」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “42 kg fused-silica mirrors and CO₂ thermal-compensation system” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 一面輸入鏡的點吸收缺陷使局部吸收升高，熱透鏡不再是軸對稱，環狀 CO₂ 加熱圖案無法抵消，循環腔內出現高階模態、增益下降且控制訊號出現偏移；只有加大補償功率反而讓整體熱雜訊升高。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A point-absorber defect on one input mirror raises local absorption so the thermal lens is no longer axisymmetric; the ring-shaped CO₂ pattern cannot cancel it, higher-order modes appear in the recycling cavity, gain drops and control signals pick up offsets; simply raising the compensation power only increases overall thermal noise. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：熱補償系統用 CO₂ 雷射在補償板上投射環狀加熱圖案，並以環形加熱器微調鏡面曲率，把熱透鏡抵消到設計公差內。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The thermal compensation system projects ring-shaped heating patterns from CO₂ lasers onto compensation plates and trims mirror curvature with ring heaters, cancelling the thermal lens to within the design tolerance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鍍膜吸收不到 1 ppm，所以熱效應可以忽略。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "With coating absorption under 1 ppm, thermal effects are negligible." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 一面輸入鏡的點吸收缺陷使局部吸收升高，熱透鏡不再是軸對稱，環狀 CO₂ 加熱圖案無法抵消，循環腔內出現高階模態、增益下降且控制訊號出現偏移；只有加大補償功率反而讓整體熱雜訊升高。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鏡面、單體懸吊與熱補償」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Mirrors, monolithic suspension and thermal compensation" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的零件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
一面輸入鏡的點吸收缺陷使局部吸收升高，熱透鏡不再是軸對稱，環狀 CO₂ 加熱圖案無法抵消，循環腔內出現高階模態、增益下降且控制訊號出現偏移。
只要隔振做得夠好，所有地面相關的雜訊都能消除。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive part first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A point-absorber defect on one input mirror raises local absorption so the thermal lens is no longer axisymmetric.
Good enough isolation removes every ground-related noise.
quiz.explanation: 一面輸入鏡的點吸收缺陷使局部吸收升高，熱透鏡不再是軸對稱，環狀 CO₂ 加熱圖案無法抵消，循環腔內出現高階模態、增益下降且控制訊號出現偏移；只有加大補償功率反而讓整體熱雜訊升高。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A point-absorber defect on one input mirror raises local absorption so the thermal lens is no longer axisymmetric; the ring-shaped CO₂ pattern cannot cancel it, higher-order modes appear in the recycling cavity, gain drops and control signals pick up offsets; simply raising the compensation power only increases overall thermal noise. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「牛頓雜訊、散射光與環境耦合」與「校正：光子校正器與牛頓校正器」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Newtonian noise, scattered light and environmental coupling" and "Calibration: photon calibrator and Newtonian calibrator": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 牛頓雜訊、散射光與環境耦合：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Newtonian noise, scattered light and environmental coupling: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「站址密度起伏與牛頓雜訊模型」如何決定Virgo 重力波干涉儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Site density fluctuations and the Newtonian-noise model” determines the key performance of “Virgo gravitational-wave interferometer”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 地面的地震波使附近岩土的密度分佈隨時間變化，對測試質量產生直接的重力擾動，這種牛頓雜訊無法用任何機械隔振擋住，只能靠地震計陣列估算並從資料中減除，或把偵測器建在地下。對 Virgo 而言，牛頓雜訊在 10–20 Hz 與懸吊熱雜訊、控制雜訊同為低頻的邊界；此外散射光從真空管壁或擋板回到主光束會以非線性方式注入相位雜訊，磁場起伏則透過致動器磁鐵耦合，這些環境項都要以感測器陣列監測並計算耦合係數。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「站址密度起伏與牛頓雜訊模型」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Seismic waves make the density distribution of nearby soil and rock vary in time, which perturbs the test masses gravitationally; this Newtonian noise cannot be blocked by any mechanical isolation and can only be estimated with seismometer arrays and subtracted from the data, or avoided by going underground. For Virgo, Newtonian noise at 10–20 Hz shares the low-frequency boundary with suspension thermal and control noise; in addition, light scattered from tube walls or baffles that returns into the main beam injects phase noise nonlinearly, and magnetic-field fluctuations couple through the actuator magnets, so each environmental term is monitored with sensor arrays and assigned a measured coupling coefficient. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Site density fluctuations and the Newtonian-noise model”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：表面波牛頓雜訊的量級估計 h_NN ≈ [4πGρ/(L·(2πf)²)]·ξ(f)·β，β 為量級為 1 的幾何因子。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: An order-of-magnitude surface-wave Newtonian noise is h_NN ≈ [4πGρ/(L·(2πf)²)]·ξ(f)·β, with β a geometric factor of order 1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要隔振做得夠好，所有地面相關的雜訊都能消除。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Good enough isolation removes every ground-related noise." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「站址密度起伏與牛頓雜訊模型」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Site density fluctuations and the Newtonian-noise model”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 牛頓雜訊、散射光與環境耦合
knowledge.titleEn: Newtonian noise, scattered light and environmental coupling
knowledge.text: 地面的地震波使附近岩土的密度分佈隨時間變化，對測試質量產生直接的重力擾動，這種牛頓雜訊無法用任何機械隔振擋住，只能靠地震計陣列估算並從資料中減除，或把偵測器建在地下。對 Virgo 而言，牛頓雜訊在 10–20 Hz 與懸吊熱雜訊、控制雜訊同為低頻的邊界；此外散射光從真空管壁或擋板回到主光束會以非線性方式注入相位雜訊，磁場起伏則透過致動器磁鐵耦合，這些環境項都要以感測器陣列監測並計算耦合係數。
knowledge.textEn: Seismic waves make the density distribution of nearby soil and rock vary in time, which perturbs the test masses gravitationally; this Newtonian noise cannot be blocked by any mechanical isolation and can only be estimated with seismometer arrays and subtracted from the data, or avoided by going underground. For Virgo, Newtonian noise at 10–20 Hz shares the low-frequency boundary with suspension thermal and control noise; in addition, light scattered from tube walls or baffles that returns into the main beam injects phase noise nonlinearly, and magnetic-field fluctuations couple through the actuator magnets, so each environmental term is monitored with sensor arrays and assigned a measured coupling coefficient.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要隔振做得夠好，所有地面相關的雜訊都能消除。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Good enough isolation removes every ground-related noise. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「牛頓雜訊、散射光與環境耦合」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Newtonian noise, scattered light and environmental coupling" is correct?
options: 只要隔振做得夠好，所有地面相關的雜訊都能消除。
重力太弱，不可能用它來校正干涉儀。
地面的地震波使附近岩土的密度分佈隨時間變化，對測試質量產生直接的重力擾動，這種牛頓雜訊無法用任何機械隔振擋住，只能靠地震計陣列估算並從資料中減除，或把偵測器建在地下。
optionsEn: Good enough isolation removes every ground-related noise.
Gravity is far too weak to calibrate an interferometer with.
Seismic waves make the density distribution of nearby soil and rock vary in time, which perturbs the test masses gravitationally.
quiz.explanation: 地面的地震波使附近岩土的密度分佈隨時間變化，對測試質量產生直接的重力擾動，這種牛頓雜訊無法用任何機械隔振擋住，只能靠地震計陣列估算並從資料中減除，或把偵測器建在地下。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Seismic waves make the density distribution of nearby soil and rock vary in time, which perturbs the test masses gravitationally; this Newtonian noise cannot be blocked by any mechanical isolation and can only be estimated with seismometer arrays and subtracted from the data, or avoided by going underground. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 牛頓雜訊、散射光與環境耦合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Newtonian noise, scattered light and environmental coupling: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「站址密度起伏與牛頓雜訊模型」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Site density fluctuations and the Newtonian-noise model” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：表面波牛頓雜訊的量級估計 h_NN ≈ [4πGρ/(L·(2πf)²)]·ξ(f)·β，β 為量級為 1 的幾何因子。取 ρ = 1800 kg/m³、G = 6.67×10⁻¹¹ 得 4πGρ ≈ 1.5×10⁻⁶ s⁻²；f = 10 Hz 時 (2πf)² ≈ 3950，地面位移 ξ = 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz：h_NN ≈ 1.5×10⁻⁶/3950×10⁻⁹/3000 ≈ 1.3×10⁻²²/√Hz；f = 20 Hz、ξ = 3×10⁻¹⁰ 時約 1×10⁻²³/√Hz。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: An order-of-magnitude surface-wave Newtonian noise is h_NN ≈ [4πGρ/(L·(2πf)²)]·ξ(f)·β, with β a geometric factor of order 1. With ρ = 1800 kg/m³ and G = 6.67×10⁻¹¹, 4πGρ ≈ 1.5×10⁻⁶ s⁻²; at f = 10 Hz, (2πf)² ≈ 3950 and ground displacement ξ = 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz give h_NN ≈ 1.5×10⁻⁶/3950×10⁻⁹/3000 ≈ 1.3×10⁻²²/√Hz; at f = 20 Hz with ξ = 3×10⁻¹⁰ it is about 1×10⁻²³/√Hz. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在末端站周圍布設數十台地震計，量地震波的相干長度與傳播方向，用維納濾波從應變資料中估算可減除的牛頓雜訊比例；散射光則以人為搖晃擋板或真空管區段的方式注入，觀察應變譜中出現的拱形特徵並算出耦合係數。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Deploy tens of seismometers around the end stations, measure the coherence length and propagation direction of seismic waves and use Wiener filtering to estimate the fraction of Newtonian noise that can be subtracted from the strain data; for scattered light, shake a baffle or a tube section deliberately, watch the arch-shaped features that appear in the strain spectrum and compute the coupling coefficient.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 表面波牛頓雜訊的量級估計 h_NN ≈ [4πGρ/(L·(2πf)²)]·ξ(f)·β，β 為量級為 1 的幾何因子。取 ρ = 1800 kg/m³、G = 6.67×10⁻¹¹ 得 4πGρ ≈ 1.5×10⁻⁶ s⁻²；f = 10 Hz 時 (2πf)² ≈ 3950，地面位移 ξ = 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz：h_NN ≈ 1.5×10⁻⁶/3950×10⁻⁹/3000 ≈ 1.3×10⁻²²/√Hz；f = 20 Hz、ξ = 3×10⁻¹⁰ 時約 1×10⁻²³/√Hz。
knowledge.textEn: An order-of-magnitude surface-wave Newtonian noise is h_NN ≈ [4πGρ/(L·(2πf)²)]·ξ(f)·β, with β a geometric factor of order 1. With ρ = 1800 kg/m³ and G = 6.67×10⁻¹¹, 4πGρ ≈ 1.5×10⁻⁶ s⁻²; at f = 10 Hz, (2πf)² ≈ 3950 and ground displacement ξ = 10⁻⁹ m/√Hz give h_NN ≈ 1.5×10⁻⁶/3950×10⁻⁹/3000 ≈ 1.3×10⁻²²/√Hz; at f = 20 Hz with ξ = 3×10⁻¹⁰ it is about 1×10⁻²³/√Hz.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「牛頓雜訊、散射光與環境耦合」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Newtonian noise, scattered light and environmental coupling", which statement holds?
options: 表面波牛頓雜訊的量級估計 h_NN ≈ [4πGρ/(L·(2πf)²)]·ξ(f)·β，β 為量級為 1 的幾何因子。
三站的靈敏度加總才是重點，定位只是附帶的好處。
地震雜訊只在地震發生時才重要。
optionsEn: An order-of-magnitude surface-wave Newtonian noise is h_NN ≈ [4πGρ/(L·(2πf)²)]·ξ(f)·β, with β a geometric factor of order 1.
What matters is the summed sensitivity of three sites; localisation is just a side benefit.
Seismic noise only matters when an earthquake happens.
quiz.explanation: 表面波牛頓雜訊的量級估計 h_NN ≈ [4πGρ/(L·(2πf)²)]·ξ(f)·β，β 為量級為 1 的幾何因子。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: An order-of-magnitude surface-wave Newtonian noise is h_NN ≈ [4πGρ/(L·(2πf)²)]·ξ(f)·β, with β a geometric factor of order 1. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 牛頓雜訊、散射光與環境耦合：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Newtonian noise, scattered light and environmental coupling: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「站址密度起伏與牛頓雜訊模型」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Site density fluctuations and the Newtonian-noise model” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在末端站周圍布設數十台地震計，量地震波的相干長度與傳播方向，用維納濾波從應變資料中估算可減除的牛頓雜訊比例；散射光則以人為搖晃擋板或真空管區段的方式注入，觀察應變譜中出現的拱形特徵並算出耦合係數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Deploy tens of seismometers around the end stations, measure the coherence length and propagation direction of seismic waves and use Wiener filtering to estimate the fraction of Newtonian noise that can be subtracted from the strain data; for scattered light, shake a baffle or a tube section deliberately, watch the arch-shaped features that appear in the strain spectrum and compute the coupling coefficient. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：末端站附近的機房風扇或鄰近道路產生 10–20 Hz 的地面振動，透過牛頓耦合與散射光同時進入資料，而且兩者耦合係數隨鏡子位置變化；若只依賴單一地震計做減除，剩餘的非穩態雜訊會產生假的短暫訊號。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Fans in an equipment room or traffic on a nearby road produce 10–20 Hz ground vibration that enters the data through Newtonian coupling and scattered light at once, with coupling coefficients that change with mirror position; relying on a single seismometer for subtraction leaves non-stationary residuals that mimic short transient signals.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在末端站周圍布設數十台地震計，量地震波的相干長度與傳播方向，用維納濾波從應變資料中估算可減除的牛頓雜訊比例；散射光則以人為搖晃擋板或真空管區段的方式注入，觀察應變譜中出現的拱形特徵並算出耦合係數。
knowledge.textEn: Deploy tens of seismometers around the end stations, measure the coherence length and propagation direction of seismic waves and use Wiener filtering to estimate the fraction of Newtonian noise that can be subtracted from the strain data; for scattered light, shake a baffle or a tube section deliberately, watch the arch-shaped features that appear in the strain spectrum and compute the coupling coefficient.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「牛頓雜訊、散射光與環境耦合」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.

steps.title: 牛頓雜訊、散射光與環境耦合：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Newtonian noise, scattered light and environmental coupling: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「站址密度起伏與牛頓雜訊模型」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Site density fluctuations and the Newtonian-noise model” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 末端站附近的機房風扇或鄰近道路產生 10–20 Hz 的地面振動，透過牛頓耦合與散射光同時進入資料，而且兩者耦合係數隨鏡子位置變化；若只依賴單一地震計做減除，剩餘的非穩態雜訊會產生假的短暫訊號。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Fans in an equipment room or traffic on a nearby road produce 10–20 Hz ground vibration that enters the data through Newtonian coupling and scattered light at once, with coupling coefficients that change with mirror position; relying on a single seismometer for subtraction leaves non-stationary residuals that mimic short transient signals. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：對 Virgo 而言，牛頓雜訊在 10–20 Hz 與懸吊熱雜訊、控制雜訊同為低頻的邊界；此外散射光從真空管壁或擋板回到主光束會以非線性方式注入相位雜訊，磁場起伏則透過致動器磁鐵耦合，這些環境項都要以感測器陣列監測並計算耦合係數。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: For Virgo, Newtonian noise at 10–20 Hz shares the low-frequency boundary with suspension thermal and control noise; in addition, light scattered from tube walls or baffles that returns into the main beam injects phase noise nonlinearly, and magnetic-field fluctuations couple through the actuator magnets, so each environmental term is monitored with sensor arrays and assigned a measured coupling coefficient.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要隔振做得夠好，所有地面相關的雜訊都能消除。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Good enough isolation removes every ground-related noise." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

steps.title: 校正：光子校正器與牛頓校正器：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Calibration: photon calibrator and Newtonian calibrator: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「牛頓校正器轉子」如何決定Virgo 重力波干涉儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Newtonian-calibrator rotor” determines the key performance of “Virgo gravitational-wave interferometer”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: Virgo 除了以輻射壓推動末端鏡的光子校正器，還發展牛頓校正器（NCal）：在末端鏡外數公尺處放置內含偏心質量的轉子，以穩定轉速旋轉，對鏡子產生頻率為轉速兩倍的重力作用力，其大小只由質量、幾何與萬有引力常數決定，不經過任何光學或電子鏈路，是與光子校正器完全獨立的絕對刻度。兩種校正器注入不同頻率的連續校正線，離線分析用它們追蹤讀出鏈增益並給出應變資料的振幅、相位與時間不確定度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「牛頓校正器轉子」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Besides a photon calibrator that pushes the end mirror with radiation pressure, Virgo developed the Newtonian calibrator (NCal): a rotor containing eccentric masses placed a few metres from the end mirror spins at a stable rate and exerts on the mirror a gravitational force at twice the rotation frequency, whose magnitude depends only on mass, geometry and the gravitational constant and passes through no optical or electronic chain, giving an absolute scale fully independent of the photon calibrator. The two calibrators inject continuous lines at different frequencies, which offline analysis uses to track readout gain and to state the amplitude, phase and timing uncertainty of the strain data. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Newtonian-calibrator rotor”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：量級估計：兩個質量 m 在半徑 r 旋轉、距離鏡心 d 的轉子，對質量 M 的鏡子產生二倍頻力 F ≈ 3GMm·r²/d⁴。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Order of magnitude: a rotor with two masses m at radius r, a distance d from the mirror centre, exerts on a mirror of mass M a force at twice the rotation frequency of F ≈ 3GMm·r²/d⁴.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「重力太弱，不可能用它來校正干涉儀。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Gravity is far too weak to calibrate an interferometer with." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「牛頓校正器轉子」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Newtonian-calibrator rotor”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

The two calibrators inject continuous lines at different frequencies, which offline analysis uses to track readout gain and to state the amplitude, phase and timing uncertainty of the strain data.

steps.title: 校正：光子校正器與牛頓校正器：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Calibration: photon calibrator and Newtonian calibrator: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「牛頓校正器轉子」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Newtonian-calibrator rotor” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：量級估計：兩個質量 m 在半徑 r 旋轉、距離鏡心 d 的轉子，對質量 M 的鏡子產生二倍頻力 F ≈ 3GMm·r²/d⁴。取 M = 42 kg、m = 1 kg、r = 0.1 m、d = 1.7 m：F ≈ 3×6.67×10⁻¹¹×42×0.01/8.35 ≈ 1.0×10⁻¹¹ N。轉速 18 Hz 時力的頻率 36 Hz，鏡子位移 x = F/(M(2πf)²) = 1.0×10⁻¹¹/(42×5.1×10⁴) ≈ 4.7×10⁻¹⁸ m，應變 h = x/L ≈ 1.6×10⁻²¹，比 36 Hz 處的雜訊高一個數量級以上，可做為清楚的校正線。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Order of magnitude: a rotor with two masses m at radius r, a distance d from the mirror centre, exerts on a mirror of mass M a force at twice the rotation frequency of F ≈ 3GMm·r²/d⁴. With M = 42 kg, m = 1 kg, r = 0.1 m and d = 1.7 m: F ≈ 3×6.67×10⁻¹¹×42×0.01/8.35 ≈ 1.0×10⁻¹¹ N. At 18 Hz rotation the force is at 36 Hz, the mirror moves x = F/(M(2πf)²) = 1.0×10⁻¹¹/(42×5.1×10⁴) ≈ 4.7×10⁻¹⁸ m and the strain is h = x/L ≈ 1.6×10⁻²¹, more than an order of magnitude above the noise at 36 Hz, a clear calibration line. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時以光子校正器與牛頓校正器在相近頻率注入，比較兩者推得的應變振幅，差異應在 2% 內；改變轉子到鏡子的距離 d 並確認訊號按 d⁻⁴ 變化，再以多個轉速驗證頻率響應與自由質量模型一致，最後把兩套校正的不確定度寫入校正報告。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Inject with the photon and Newtonian calibrators at nearby frequencies at the same time and compare the strain amplitudes each implies, which should agree within 2%; change the rotor-to-mirror distance d and confirm the signal scales as d⁻⁴, then verify at several rotation speeds that the frequency response follows the free-mass model, and record the uncertainties of both calibrations in the calibration report.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 校正：光子校正器與牛頓校正器：量測與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「牛頓校正器轉子」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Newtonian-calibrator rotor” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 同時以光子校正器與牛頓校正器在相近頻率注入，比較兩者推得的應變振幅，差異應在 2% 內；改變轉子到鏡子的距離 d 並確認訊號按 d⁻⁴ 變化，再以多個轉速驗證頻率響應與自由質量模型一致，最後把兩套校正的不確定度寫入校正報告。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Inject with the photon and Newtonian calibrators at nearby frequencies at the same time and compare the strain amplitudes each implies, which should agree within 2%; change the rotor-to-mirror distance d and confirm the signal scales as d⁻⁴, then verify at several rotation speeds that the frequency response follows the free-mass model, and record the uncertainties of both calibrations in the calibration report. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：轉子安裝位置量錯 2 cm（d 從 1.70 m 變成 1.72 m）會讓預期力偏差約 5%，若無人復核幾何量測，整個運行的應變刻度帶有同樣的系統誤差，事件的光度距離估計跟著偏差。

steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「超高真空、殘氣相位雜訊與基礎設施」與「網路觀測、天區定位與工程交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ultra-high vacuum, residual-gas phase noise and infrastructure" and "Network observing, sky localisation and engineering handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 超高真空、殘氣相位雜訊與基礎設施：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Ultra-high vacuum, residual-gas phase noise and infrastructure: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「1.2 m 真空管與 150 °C 烘烤」如何決定Virgo 重力波干涉儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “1.2 m vacuum tubes and 150 °C bake-out” determines the key performance of “Virgo gravitational-wave interferometer”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: Virgo 的兩條 3 km 真空管直徑 1.2 m，總體積約數千立方公尺，是歐洲最大的超高真空系統之一；管壁經過約 150 °C 的烘烤以釋出氫氣，再由渦輪分子泵、離子泵與管端的低溫捕集器維持 10⁻⁹ mbar 等級的壓力。殘留分子以熱速度穿越光束時，其極化率使局部折射率隨機起伏，造成與分子數密度平方根成正比的相位雜訊；壓力每升高百倍，此雜訊升高十倍，因此真空是靈敏度的直接組成部分，而非只是避免散射的附帶條件。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「1.2 m 真空管與 150 °C 烘烤」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Virgo's two 3 km vacuum tubes are 1.2 m in diameter with a total volume of several thousand cubic metres, one of the largest ultra-high-vacuum systems in Europe; the walls were baked at about 150 °C to release hydrogen, and turbomolecular pumps, ion pumps and cryogenic traps at the tube ends hold pressures at the 10⁻⁹ mbar level. Residual molecules crossing the beam at thermal speed carry a polarisability that makes the local refractive index fluctuate randomly, producing phase noise proportional to the square root of the number density; every hundredfold rise in pressure raises this noise tenfold, so the vacuum is a direct component of sensitivity rather than a mere precaution against scatter. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “1.2 m vacuum tubes and 150 °C bake-out”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：殘氣相位雜訊的近似式 S_x ≈ 4(2πα)²·n·L/(v₀·w)，α 為分子極化率體積、n 為數密度、v₀ 為熱速度、w 為光束半徑。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: An approximate residual-gas phase noise is S_x ≈ 4(2πα)²·n·L/(v₀·w), with α the molecular polarisability volume, n the number density, v₀ the thermal speed and w the beam radius.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「真空只是為了避免灰塵與空氣散射，對雜訊曲線沒有直接貢獻。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Vacuum only keeps dust and air scatter away and has no direct place in the noise curve." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「1.2 m 真空管與 150 °C 烘烤」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “1.2 m vacuum tubes and 150 °C bake-out”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Residual molecules crossing the beam at thermal speed carry a polarisability that makes the local refractive index fluctuate randomly, producing phase noise proportional to the square root of the number density; every hundredfold rise in pressure raises this noise tenfold, so the vacuum is a direct component of sensitivity rather than a mere precaution against scatter.

steps.title: 超高真空、殘氣相位雜訊與基礎設施：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ultra-high vacuum, residual-gas phase noise and infrastructure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「1.2 m 真空管與 150 °C 烘烤」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “1.2 m vacuum tubes and 150 °C bake-out” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：殘氣相位雜訊的近似式 S_x ≈ 4(2πα)²·n·L/(v₀·w)，α 為分子極化率體積、n 為數密度、v₀ 為熱速度、w 為光束半徑。H₂ 在 10⁻⁹ mbar（10⁻⁷ Pa、295 K）時 n = p/(kT) ≈ 2.5×10¹³ m⁻³，α ≈ 8×10⁻³¹ m³，v₀ ≈ 1.6×10³ m/s，w = 0.05 m，L = 3000 m：S_x ≈ 4×(5×10⁻³⁰)²×2.5×10¹³×3000/(1.6×10³×0.05) ≈ 1×10⁻⁴³ m²/Hz，√S_x ≈ 3×10⁻²² m/√Hz，h ≈ 1×10⁻²⁵/√Hz；若壓力升到 10⁻⁶ mbar 則乘以 √1000 ≈ 32，達 3×10⁻²⁴，已與設計靈敏度同量級。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: An approximate residual-gas phase noise is S_x ≈ 4(2πα)²·n·L/(v₀·w), with α the molecular polarisability volume, n the number density, v₀ the thermal speed and w the beam radius. For H₂ at 10⁻⁹ mbar (10⁻⁷ Pa, 295 K), n = p/(kT) ≈ 2.5×10¹³ m⁻³, α ≈ 8×10⁻³¹ m³, v₀ ≈ 1.6×10³ m/s, w = 0.05 m and L = 3000 m: S_x ≈ 4×(5×10⁻³⁰)²×2.5×10¹³×3000/(1.6×10³×0.05) ≈ 1×10⁻⁴³ m²/Hz, so √S_x ≈ 3×10⁻²² m/√Hz and h ≈ 1×10⁻²⁵/√Hz; at 10⁻⁶ mbar multiply by √1000 ≈ 32 to reach 3×10⁻²⁴, already comparable with the design sensitivity. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以殘氣分析儀（RGA）量各管段的氣體組成，確認 H₂ 為主而碳氫化合物極低；記錄烘烤前後的出氣率與壓力曲線，並在觀測期間監測壓力與應變雜訊的相關性，例如刻意暫停一台泵使壓力升高十倍，應變譜在高頻應上升約 √10 ≈ 3.2 倍。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the gas composition of each tube section with a residual-gas analyser, confirming hydrogen dominance and very low hydrocarbons; log outgassing rates and pressure curves before and after bake-out, and during observation monitor the correlation between pressure and strain noise, for example by pausing one pump so pressure rises tenfold, when the high-frequency strain spectrum should rise by about √10 ≈ 3.2.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.
