For H₂ at 10⁻⁹ mbar (10⁻⁷ Pa, 295 K), n = p/(kT) ≈ 2.5×10¹³ m⁻³, α ≈ 8×10⁻³¹ m³, v₀ ≈ 1.6×10³ m/s, w = 0.05 m and L = 3000 m: S_x ≈ 4×(5×10⁻³⁰)²×2.5×10¹³×3000/(1.6×10³×0.05) ≈ 1×10⁻⁴³ m²/Hz, so √S_x ≈ 3×10⁻²² m/√Hz and h ≈ 1×10⁻²⁵/√Hz; at 10⁻⁶ mbar multiply by √1000 ≈ 32 to reach 3×10⁻²⁴, already comparable with the design sensitivity.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「超高真空、殘氣相位雜訊與基礎設施」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ultra-high vacuum, residual-gas phase noise and infrastructure", which statement holds?
options: 地震雜訊只在地震發生時才重要。
鍍膜吸收不到 1 ppm，所以熱效應可以忽略。
殘氣相位雜訊的近似式 S_x ≈ 4(2πα)²·n·L/(v₀·w)，α 為分子極化率體積、n 為數密度、v₀ 為熱速度、w 為光束半徑。
optionsEn: Seismic noise only matters when an earthquake happens.
With coating absorption under 1 ppm, thermal effects are negligible.
An approximate residual-gas phase noise is S_x ≈ 4(2πα)²·n·L/(v₀·w), with α the molecular polarisability volume, n the number density, v₀ the thermal speed and w the beam radius.
quiz.explanation: 殘氣相位雜訊的近似式 S_x ≈ 4(2πα)²·n·L/(v₀·w)，α 為分子極化率體積、n 為數密度、v₀ 為熱速度、w 為光束半徑。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: An approximate residual-gas phase noise is S_x ≈ 4(2πα)²·n·L/(v₀·w), with α the molecular polarisability volume, n the number density, v₀ the thermal speed and w the beam radius. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 超高真空、殘氣相位雜訊與基礎設施：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ultra-high vacuum, residual-gas phase noise and infrastructure: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「1.2 m 真空管與 150 °C 烘烤」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “1.2 m vacuum tubes and 150 °C bake-out” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以殘氣分析儀（RGA）量各管段的氣體組成，確認 H₂ 為主而碳氫化合物極低；記錄烘烤前後的出氣率與壓力曲線，並在觀測期間監測壓力與應變雜訊的相關性，例如刻意暫停一台泵使壓力升高十倍，應變譜在高頻應上升約 √10 ≈ 3.2 倍。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the gas composition of each tube section with a residual-gas analyser, confirming hydrogen dominance and very low hydrocarbons; log outgassing rates and pressure curves before and after bake-out, and during observation monitor the correlation between pressure and strain noise, for example by pausing one pump so pressure rises tenfold, when the high-frequency strain spectrum should rise by about √10 ≈ 3.2. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：一個閥門墊圈的微漏讓空氣進入某段真空管，壓力從 10⁻⁹ 升到 10⁻⁷ mbar，殘氣雜訊升高十倍並在高頻形成平台，同時水氣沉積到鏡面提高散射；若監測只看總壓而不看組成，漏氣與出氣會被混淆而延誤修復。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A micro-leak at a valve gasket lets air into one tube section and the pressure rises from 10⁻⁹ to 10⁻⁷ mbar; residual-gas noise grows tenfold and forms a high-frequency plateau while water deposits on the mirrors and raises scatter.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以殘氣分析儀（RGA）量各管段的氣體組成，確認 H₂ 為主而碳氫化合物極低；記錄烘烤前後的出氣率與壓力曲線，並在觀測期間監測壓力與應變雜訊的相關性，例如刻意暫停一台泵使壓力升高十倍，應變譜在高頻應上升約 √10 ≈ 3.2 倍。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the gas composition of each tube section with a residual-gas analyser, confirming hydrogen dominance and very low hydrocarbons; log outgassing rates and pressure curves before and after bake-out, and during observation monitor the correlation between pressure and strain noise, for example by pausing one pump so pressure rises tenfold, when the high-frequency strain spectrum should rise by about √10 ≈ 3.2.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「超高真空、殘氣相位雜訊與基礎設施」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ultra-high vacuum, residual-gas phase noise and infrastructure"?
options: 以殘氣分析儀（RGA）量各管段的氣體組成，確認 H₂ 為主而碳氫化合物極低。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要隔振做得夠好，所有地面相關的雜訊都能消除。
optionsEn: Measure the gas composition of each tube section with a residual-gas analyser, confirming hydrogen dominance and very low hydrocarbons.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Good enough isolation removes every ground-related noise.
quiz.explanation: 以殘氣分析儀（RGA）量各管段的氣體組成，確認 H₂ 為主而碳氫化合物極低；記錄烘烤前後的出氣率與壓力曲線，並在觀測期間監測壓力與應變雜訊的相關性，例如刻意暫停一台泵使壓力升高十倍，應變譜在高頻應上升約 √10 ≈ 3.2 倍。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure the gas composition of each tube section with a residual-gas analyser, confirming hydrogen dominance and very low hydrocarbons; log outgassing rates and pressure curves before and after bake-out, and during observation monitor the correlation between pressure and strain noise, for example by pausing one pump so pressure rises tenfold, when the high-frequency strain spectrum should rise by about √10 ≈ 3.2. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 超高真空、殘氣相位雜訊與基礎設施：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ultra-high vacuum, residual-gas phase noise and infrastructure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「1.2 m 真空管與 150 °C 烘烤」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “1.2 m vacuum tubes and 150 °C bake-out” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 一個閥門墊圈的微漏讓空氣進入某段真空管，壓力從 10⁻⁹ 升到 10⁻⁷ mbar，殘氣雜訊升高十倍並在高頻形成平台，同時水氣沉積到鏡面提高散射；若監測只看總壓而不看組成，漏氣與出氣會被混淆而延誤修復。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A micro-leak at a valve gasket lets air into one tube section and the pressure rises from 10⁻⁹ to 10⁻⁷ mbar; residual-gas noise grows tenfold and forms a high-frequency plateau while water deposits on the mirrors and raises scatter. Monitoring only total pressure rather than composition confuses a leak with outgassing and delays the repair. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：殘留分子以熱速度穿越光束時，其極化率使局部折射率隨機起伏，造成與分子數密度平方根成正比的相位雜訊；壓力每升高百倍，此雜訊升高十倍，因此真空是靈敏度的直接組成部分，而非只是避免散射的附帶條件。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Residual molecules crossing the beam at thermal speed carry a polarisability that makes the local refractive index fluctuate randomly, producing phase noise proportional to the square root of the number density; every hundredfold rise in pressure raises this noise tenfold, so the vacuum is a direct component of sensitivity rather than a mere precaution against scatter.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「真空只是為了避免灰塵與空氣散射，對雜訊曲線沒有直接貢獻。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Vacuum only keeps dust and air scatter away and has no direct place in the noise curve." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 一個閥門墊圈的微漏讓空氣進入某段真空管，壓力從 10⁻⁹ 升到 10⁻⁷ mbar，殘氣雜訊升高十倍並在高頻形成平台，同時水氣沉積到鏡面提高散射；若監測只看總壓而不看組成，漏氣與出氣會被混淆而延誤修復。
knowledge.textEn: A micro-leak at a valve gasket lets air into one tube section and the pressure rises from 10⁻⁹ to 10⁻⁷ mbar; residual-gas noise grows tenfold and forms a high-frequency plateau while water deposits on the mirrors and raises scatter. Monitoring only total pressure rather than composition confuses a leak with outgassing and delays the repair.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「超高真空、殘氣相位雜訊與基礎設施」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ultra-high vacuum, residual-gas phase noise and infrastructure" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
一個閥門墊圈的微漏讓空氣進入某段真空管，壓力從 10⁻⁹ 升到 10⁻⁷ mbar，殘氣雜訊升高十倍並在高頻形成平台，同時水氣沉積到鏡面提高散射。
三站的靈敏度加總才是重點，定位只是附帶的好處。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
A micro-leak at a valve gasket lets air into one tube section and the pressure rises from 10⁻⁹ to 10⁻⁷ mbar.
What matters is the summed sensitivity of three sites; localisation is just a side benefit.
quiz.explanation: 一個閥門墊圈的微漏讓空氣進入某段真空管，壓力從 10⁻⁹ 升到 10⁻⁷ mbar，殘氣雜訊升高十倍並在高頻形成平台，同時水氣沉積到鏡面提高散射；若監測只看總壓而不看組成，漏氣與出氣會被混淆而延誤修復。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A micro-leak at a valve gasket lets air into one tube section and the pressure rises from 10⁻⁹ to 10⁻⁷ mbar; residual-gas noise grows tenfold and forms a high-frequency plateau while water deposits on the mirrors and raises scatter. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 網路觀測、天區定位與工程交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Network observing, sky localisation and engineering handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「三站網路時間延遲與運行交接」如何決定Virgo 重力波干涉儀的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Three-detector time delays and run handoff” determines the key performance of “Virgo gravitational-wave interferometer”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: Virgo 的科學價值很大一部分來自與兩座 LIGO 組成的三站網路：訊號到達三站的時間差決定波源在天上的位置，三站的振幅比與相位差再縮小區域並給出極化資訊。2017 年 8 月的雙中子星事件 GW170817 正是因為加入 Virgo 才把定位縮到約 30 平方度，使光學望遠鏡能找到對應的電磁訊號。運行交接因此包含與其他站共享的校正模型、GPS 對時、資料品質旗標與低延遲警報鏈，而不僅是本站的靈敏度紀錄。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「三站網路時間延遲與運行交接」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Much of Virgo's scientific value comes from forming a three-detector network with the two LIGO sites: the arrival-time differences fix the source position on the sky, and the amplitude ratios and phase differences between sites shrink the region further and give polarisation information. The binary-neutron-star event GW170817 in August 2017 was localised to about 30 square degrees only because Virgo was part of the network, which let optical telescopes find its electromagnetic counterpart. Run handoff therefore includes the calibration model shared with the other sites, GPS timing, data-quality flags and the low-latency alert chain, not only the local sensitivity record. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Three-detector time delays and run handoff”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：到達時間的量測精度 σ_t ≈ 1/(2π·SNR·σ_f)，σ_f 為訊號的有效頻寬：SNR = 10、σ_f = 100 Hz 時 σ_t ≈ 1.6×10⁻⁴ s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Arrival-time precision is σ_t ≈ 1/(2π·SNR·σ_f), with σ_f the effective signal bandwidth: for SNR = 10 and σ_f = 100 Hz, σ_t ≈ 1.6×10⁻⁴ s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「三站的靈敏度加總才是重點，定位只是附帶的好處。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "What matters is the summed sensitivity of three sites; localisation is just a side benefit." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「三站網路時間延遲與運行交接」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Three-detector time delays and run handoff”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 網路觀測、天區定位與工程交接
knowledge.titleEn: Network observing, sky localisation and engineering handoff
knowledge.text: Virgo 的科學價值很大一部分來自與兩座 LIGO 組成的三站網路：訊號到達三站的時間差決定波源在天上的位置，三站的振幅比與相位差再縮小區域並給出極化資訊。2017 年 8 月的雙中子星事件 GW170817 正是因為加入 Virgo 才把定位縮到約 30 平方度，使光學望遠鏡能找到對應的電磁訊號。
knowledge.textEn: Much of Virgo's scientific value comes from forming a three-detector network with the two LIGO sites: the arrival-time differences fix the source position on the sky, and the amplitude ratios and phase differences between sites shrink the region further and give polarisation information. The binary-neutron-star event GW170817 in August 2017 was localised to about 30 square degrees only because Virgo was part of the network, which let optical telescopes find its electromagnetic counterpart.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：三站的靈敏度加總才是重點，定位只是附帶的好處。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: What matters is the summed sensitivity of three sites; localisation is just a side benefit. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「網路觀測、天區定位與工程交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Network observing, sky localisation and engineering handoff" is correct?
options: 三站的靈敏度加總才是重點，定位只是附帶的好處。
臂長 3 km 與 4 km 的差別只是場地大小，與靈敏度無關。
Virgo 的科學價值很大一部分來自與兩座 LIGO 組成的三站網路：訊號到達三站的時間差決定波源在天上的位置，三站的振幅比與相位差再縮小區域並給出極化資訊。
optionsEn: What matters is the summed sensitivity of three sites; localisation is just a side benefit.
The difference between 3 km and 4 km arms is only site size, not sensitivity.

Much of Virgo's scientific value comes from forming a three-detector network with the two LIGO sites: the arrival-time differences fix the source position on the sky, and the amplitude ratios and phase differences between sites shrink the region further and give polarisation information.
quiz.explanation: Virgo 的科學價值很大一部分來自與兩座 LIGO 組成的三站網路：訊號到達三站的時間差決定波源在天上的位置，三站的振幅比與相位差再縮小區域並給出極化資訊。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Much of Virgo's scientific value comes from forming a three-detector network with the two LIGO sites: the arrival-time differences fix the source position on the sky, and the amplitude ratios and phase differences between sites shrink the region further and give polarisation information. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 網路觀測、天區定位與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Network observing, sky localisation and engineering handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「三站網路時間延遲與運行交接」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Three-detector time delays and run handoff” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：到達時間的量測精度 σ_t ≈ 1/(2π·SNR·σ_f)，σ_f 為訊號的有效頻寬：SNR = 10、σ_f = 100 Hz 時 σ_t ≈ 1.6×10⁻⁴ s。Virgo 與漢福德相距約 8000 km（光程約 27 ms），角度精度 σ_θ ≈ c·σ_t/D ≈ 3×10⁸×1.6×10⁻⁴/8×10⁶ ≈ 6×10⁻³ rad ≈ 0.34°；兩條獨立基線使定位區域縮到數平方度到數十平方度，若只有兩站則退化為跨越數百平方度的環帶。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Arrival-time precision is σ_t ≈ 1/(2π·SNR·σ_f), with σ_f the effective signal bandwidth: for SNR = 10 and σ_f = 100 Hz, σ_t ≈ 1.6×10⁻⁴ s. Virgo and Hanford are about 8000 km apart (a light-travel time of about 27 ms), so the angular precision is σ_θ ≈ c·σ_t/D ≈ 3×10⁸×1.6×10⁻⁴/8×10⁶ ≈ 6×10⁻³ rad ≈ 0.34°; two independent baselines shrink the sky region to between a few and tens of square degrees, whereas two sites alone leave a ring spanning hundreds of square degrees. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以 GPS 鎖定的時間標記做端到端時序測試：在三站注入相同波形並設定已知的時間差，確認分析管線回復的時間差誤差小於 10 µs；運行前以模擬事件演練低延遲警報，量從資料到警報發出的延遲，並把校正不確定度、時序誤差與警報延遲列入網路交接紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run an end-to-end timing test with GPS-locked time stamps: inject the same waveform at the three sites with known time offsets and confirm that the analysis pipeline recovers the offsets to better than 10 µs; before the run rehearse low-latency alerts with simulated events, measure the delay from data to alert and enter calibration uncertainty, timing error and alert latency in the network handoff record.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 到達時間的量測精度 σ_t ≈ 1/(2π·SNR·σ_f)，σ_f 為訊號的有效頻寬：SNR = 10、σ_f = 100 Hz 時 σ_t ≈ 1.6×10⁻⁴ s。Virgo 與漢福德相距約 8000 km（光程約 27 ms），角度精度 σ_θ ≈ c·σ_t/D ≈ 3×10⁸×1.6×10⁻⁴/8×10⁶ ≈ 6×10⁻³ rad ≈ 0.34°；兩條獨立基線使定位區域縮到數平方度到數十平方度，若只有兩站則退化為跨越數百平方度的環帶。
knowledge.textEn: Arrival-time precision is σ_t ≈ 1/(2π·SNR·σ_f), with σ_f the effective signal bandwidth: for SNR = 10 and σ_f = 100 Hz, σ_t ≈ 1.6×10⁻⁴ s. Virgo and Hanford are about 8000 km apart (a light-travel time of about 27 ms), so the angular precision is σ_θ ≈ c·σ_t/D ≈ 3×10⁸×1.6×10⁻⁴/8×10⁶ ≈ 6×10⁻³ rad ≈ 0.34°; two independent baselines shrink the sky region to between a few and tens of square degrees, whereas two sites alone leave a ring spanning hundreds of square degrees.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「網路觀測、天區定位與工程交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

倒立擺越高越好，因為擺越長共振頻率越低。
只要隔振做得夠好，所有地面相關的雜訊都能消除。
optionsEn: Arrival-time precision is σ_t ≈ 1/(2π·SNR·σ_f), with σ_f the effective signal bandwidth: for SNR = 10 and σ_f = 100 Hz, σ_t ≈ 1.6×10⁻⁴ s.
A taller inverted pendulum is always better because a longer pendulum has a lower resonance.
Good enough isolation removes every ground-related noise.
quiz.explanation: 到達時間的量測精度 σ_t ≈ 1/(2π·SNR·σ_f)，σ_f 為訊號的有效頻寬：SNR = 10、σ_f = 100 Hz 時 σ_t ≈ 1.6×10⁻⁴ s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Arrival-time precision is σ_t ≈ 1/(2π·SNR·σ_f), with σ_f the effective signal bandwidth: for SNR = 10 and σ_f = 100 Hz, σ_t ≈ 1.6×10⁻⁴ s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 網路觀測、天區定位與工程交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Network observing, sky localisation and engineering handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「三站網路時間延遲與運行交接」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Three-detector time delays and run handoff” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以 GPS 鎖定的時間標記做端到端時序測試：在三站注入相同波形並設定已知的時間差，確認分析管線回復的時間差誤差小於 10 µs；運行前以模擬事件演練低延遲警報，量從資料到警報發出的延遲，並把校正不確定度、時序誤差與警報延遲列入網路交接紀錄。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run an end-to-end timing test with GPS-locked time stamps: inject the same waveform at the three sites with known time offsets and confirm that the analysis pipeline recovers the offsets to better than 10 µs; before the run rehearse low-latency alerts with simulated events, measure the delay from data to alert and enter calibration uncertainty, timing error and alert latency in the network handoff record. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：某站的時間標記因 GPS 接收機韌體更新而偏移 1 ms，天區定位整體平移數度，電磁對應體的搜尋指向錯誤的天區；由於各站各自的靈敏度與校正都正常，錯誤只能靠網路層級的時序測試發現。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A 1 ms offset in one site's time stamps after a GPS-receiver firmware update shifts the sky localisation by several degrees and sends electromagnetic follow-up to the wrong region; because each site's sensitivity and calibration look normal, only a network-level timing test can reveal the error.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以 GPS 鎖定的時間標記做端到端時序測試：在三站注入相同波形並設定已知的時間差，確認分析管線回復的時間差誤差小於 10 µs；運行前以模擬事件演練低延遲警報，量從資料到警報發出的延遲，並把校正不確定度、時序誤差與警報延遲列入網路交接紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: Run an end-to-end timing test with GPS-locked time stamps: inject the same waveform at the three sites with known time offsets and confirm that the analysis pipeline recovers the offsets to better than 10 µs; before the run rehearse low-latency alerts with simulated events, measure the delay from data to alert and enter calibration uncertainty, timing error and alert latency in the network handoff record.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「網路觀測、天區定位與工程交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Network observing, sky localisation and engineering handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
以 GPS 鎖定的時間標記做端到端時序測試：在三站注入相同波形並設定已知的時間差，確認分析管線回復的時間差誤差小於 10 µs。
重力太弱，不可能用它來校正干涉儀。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.

Run an end-to-end timing test with GPS-locked time stamps: inject the same waveform at the three sites with known time offsets and confirm that the analysis pipeline recovers the offsets to better than 10 µs.
Gravity is far too weak to calibrate an interferometer with.
quiz.explanation: 以 GPS 鎖定的時間標記做端到端時序測試：在三站注入相同波形並設定已知的時間差，確認分析管線回復的時間差誤差小於 10 µs；運行前以模擬事件演練低延遲警報，量從資料到警報發出的延遲，並把校正不確定度、時序誤差與警報延遲列入網路交接紀錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Run an end-to-end timing test with GPS-locked time stamps: inject the same waveform at the three sites with known time offsets and confirm that the analysis pipeline recovers the offsets to better than 10 µs; before the run rehearse low-latency alerts with simulated events, measure the delay from data to alert and enter calibration uncertainty, timing error and alert latency in the network handoff record. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 網路觀測、天區定位與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Network observing, sky localisation and engineering handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「三站網路時間延遲與運行交接」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Three-detector time delays and run handoff” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 某站的時間標記因 GPS 接收機韌體更新而偏移 1 ms，天區定位整體平移數度，電磁對應體的搜尋指向錯誤的天區；由於各站各自的靈敏度與校正都正常，錯誤只能靠網路層級的時序測試發現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A 1 ms offset in one site's time stamps after a GPS-receiver firmware update shifts the sky localisation by several degrees and sends electromagnetic follow-up to the wrong region; because each site's sensitivity and calibration look normal, only a network-level timing test can reveal the error. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：運行交接因此包含與其他站共享的校正模型、GPS 對時、資料品質旗標與低延遲警報鏈，而不僅是本站的靈敏度紀錄。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Run handoff therefore includes the calibration model shared with the other sites, GPS timing, data-quality flags and the low-latency alert chain, not only the local sensitivity record.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「三站的靈敏度加總才是重點，定位只是附帶的好處。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "What matters is the summed sensitivity of three sites; localisation is just a side benefit." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 某站的時間標記因 GPS 接收機韌體更新而偏移 1 ms，天區定位整體平移數度，電磁對應體的搜尋指向錯誤的天區；由於各站各自的靈敏度與校正都正常，錯誤只能靠網路層級的時序測試發現。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「網路觀測、天區定位與工程交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Network observing, sky localisation and engineering handoff" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。

optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
The difference between 3 km and 4 km arms is only site size, not sensitivity.
A 1 ms offset in one site's time stamps after a GPS-receiver firmware update shifts the sky localisation by several degrees and sends electromagnetic follow-up to the wrong region.

title: KAGRA 地底低溫重力波望遠鏡
summary: 以神岡礦山地下超過 200 m 的 KAGRA 為對象，理解它如何用地底低地動與把 22.8 kg 藍寶石測試質量冷到約 20 K 兩個策略壓低雜訊，再把 3 km Fabry–Pérot 臂腔與訊號擷取、藍寶石光學、低溫懸吊導熱、熱連結振動、網路觀測與冷凝污染整合成可交接的觀測站工程。
summaryEn: Taking KAGRA, more than 200 m underground in the Kamioka mine, see how it lowers noise with two strategies, a quiet underground site and 22.8 kg sapphire test masses cooled to about 20 K, then integrate 3 km Fabry–Pérot arms with signal extraction, sapphire optics, cryogenic heat extraction, heat-link vibration, network observing and cryo-contamination into a transferable observatory engineering record.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 低溫功率預算練習：設計分光鏡功率 674 W、臂腔精細度 1550，臂內功率 ≈ 674/2 × 2×1550/π ≈ 333 kW。假設輸入測試質量基板吸收 50 ppm/cm、厚 15 cm，鍍膜吸收 0.5 ppm，吸收熱 ≈ 337 × 7.5×10⁻⁴ + 333,000 × 5×10⁻⁷ ≈ 0.25 + 0.17 = 0.42 W。四根纖維熱導 G = 4kA/L，取 k = 2000 W/(m·K)、A = 2.0×10⁻⁶ m²、L = 0.35 m，G ≈ 0.046 W/K，溫差 ≈ 9.1 K；上一級 13 K 時鏡面約 22 K。熱雜訊振幅相對室溫降為 √(22/300) ≈ 0.27。若吸收倍增到 100 ppm/cm，熱量 0.67 W、溫差 14.6 K、鏡面約 27.6 K，需把分光鏡功率降到約 420 W 才能守住 22 K，臂內功率變為約 207 kW，散粒雜訊振幅約增為 √(333/207) ≈ 1.27 倍。數值為教學假設，不代表 KAGRA 的實際運轉參數。
workedExample.textEn: Cryogenic power-budget exercise: with the design 674 W at the beam splitter and finesse 1550, arm power ≈ 674/2 × 2×1550/π ≈ 333 kW. Assuming 50 ppm/cm absorption in the 15 cm input test-mass substrate and 0.5 ppm coating absorption, absorbed heat ≈ 337 × 7.5×10⁻⁴ + 333,000 × 5×10⁻⁷ ≈ 0.25 + 0.17 = 0.42 W. The four-fibre conductance G = 4kA/L with k = 2000 W/(m·K), A = 2.0×10⁻⁶ m² and L = 0.35 m is G ≈ 0.046 W/K, giving a temperature difference of about 9.1 K, so with the stage above at 13 K the mirror sits near 22 K. Thermal-noise amplitude relative to room temperature drops to √(22/300) ≈ 0.27. If absorption doubles to 100 ppm/cm, the heat is 0.67 W, the difference 14.6 K and the mirror about 27.6 K; holding 22 K requires cutting beam-splitter power to about 420 W, arm power to about 207 kW, and shot-noise amplitude rises by about √(333/207) ≈ 1.27. Values are teaching assumptions, not KAGRA operating parameters.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「應變量測與地底加低溫的設計賭注」與「Fabry–Pérot 臂腔與共振邊帶擷取」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Strain measurement and the underground-plus-cryogenic bet" and "Fabry–Pérot arms and resonant sideband extraction": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 應變量測與地底加低溫的設計賭注：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Strain measurement and the underground-plus-cryogenic bet: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「3 km 臂與神岡地下站址」如何決定KAGRA 地底低溫重力波望遠鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “3 km arms and the Kamioka underground site” determines the key performance of “KAGRA underground cryogenic gravitational-wave telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 重力波通過時以應變 h = ΔL/L 拉伸與壓縮兩條垂直的臂，KAGRA 以兩條 3 km 臂的雷射干涉儀量測臂長差。地面干涉儀的低頻端主要受地動與重力梯度（牛頓）雜訊限制，中頻受鏡面與懸吊的熱雜訊限制。KAGRA 的兩個設計選擇正對應這兩項：把整座干涉儀建在岐阜縣神岡礦山岩層下超過 200 m 處，使 10 Hz 以上的地動比地面低約兩個數量級；並把測試質量與最末級懸吊冷到約 20 K，使熱雜訊隨溫度下降。這讓 KAGRA 成為第一座同時採用地底與低溫的公里級重力波望遠鏡，也帶來地下水、低溫振動與冷凝污染等新的工程問題。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「3 km 臂與神岡地下站址」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A passing gravitational wave stretches and squeezes two perpendicular arms with strain h = ΔL/L, and KAGRA measures the arm-length difference with a laser interferometer having two 3 km arms. Ground-based interferometers are limited at low frequency by ground motion and gravity-gradient (Newtonian) noise and at mid frequency by thermal noise of mirrors and suspensions. KAGRA's two design choices target exactly these: the whole interferometer sits more than 200 m under the rock of the Kamioka mine in Gifu Prefecture, where ground motion above 10 Hz is about two orders of magnitude lower than at the surface, and the test masses and final suspension stages are cooled to about 20 K so that thermal noise falls with temperature. This made KAGRA the first kilometre-scale detector to be both underground and cryogenic, and it introduced new engineering problems such as groundwater, cryogenic vibration and cryo-contamination. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “3 km arms and the Kamioka underground site”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：h = 1×10⁻²¹（教學假設）時 ΔL = h·L = 1×10⁻²¹ × 3000 m = 3×10⁻¹⁸ m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For h = 1×10⁻²¹ (teaching assumption) ΔL = h·L = 1×10⁻²¹ × 3000 m = 3×10⁻¹⁸ m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要放到地底，重力波干涉儀的所有雜訊都會大幅下降。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Putting an interferometer underground lowers all of its noise sources dramatically." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「3 km 臂與神岡地下站址」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “3 km arms and the Kamioka underground site”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 應變量測與地底加低溫的設計賭注
knowledge.titleEn: Strain measurement and the underground-plus-cryogenic bet
knowledge.text: 重力波通過時以應變 h = ΔL/L 拉伸與壓縮兩條垂直的臂，KAGRA 以兩條 3 km 臂的雷射干涉儀量測臂長差。地面干涉儀的低頻端主要受地動與重力梯度（牛頓）雜訊限制，中頻受鏡面與懸吊的熱雜訊限制。
knowledge.textEn: A passing gravitational wave stretches and squeezes two perpendicular arms with strain h = ΔL/L, and KAGRA measures the arm-length difference with a laser interferometer having two 3 km arms. Ground-based interferometers are limited at low frequency by ground motion and gravity-gradient (Newtonian) noise and at mid frequency by thermal noise of mirrors and suspensions.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要放到地底，重力波干涉儀的所有雜訊都會大幅下降。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Putting an interferometer underground lowers all of its noise sources dramatically. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「應變量測與地底加低溫的設計賭注」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Strain measurement and the underground-plus-cryogenic bet" is correct?
options: 只要放到地底，重力波干涉儀的所有雜訊都會大幅下降。
重力波通過時以應變 h = ΔL/L 拉伸與壓縮兩條垂直的臂，KAGRA 以兩條 3 km 臂的雷射干涉儀量測臂長差。
臂腔精細度越高，干涉儀在所有頻率都越靈敏。
optionsEn: Putting an interferometer underground lowers all of its noise sources dramatically.
A passing gravitational wave stretches and squeezes two perpendicular arms with strain h = ΔL/L, and KAGRA measures the arm-length difference with a laser interferometer having two 3 km arms.
Higher arm finesse makes the interferometer more sensitive at every frequency.
quiz.explanation: 重力波通過時以應變 h = ΔL/L 拉伸與壓縮兩條垂直的臂，KAGRA 以兩條 3 km 臂的雷射干涉儀量測臂長差。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A passing gravitational wave stretches and squeezes two perpendicular arms with strain h = ΔL/L, and KAGRA measures the arm-length difference with a laser interferometer having two 3 km arms. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 應變量測與地底加低溫的設計賭注：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Strain measurement and the underground-plus-cryogenic bet: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「3 km 臂與神岡地下站址」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “3 km arms and the Kamioka underground site” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：h = 1×10⁻²¹（教學假設）時 ΔL = h·L = 1×10⁻²¹ × 3000 m = 3×10⁻¹⁸ m。布朗熱雜訊振幅約 ∝ √(T·φ)，損耗角不變時由 300 K 冷到 20 K 約降為 1/√15 ≈ 1/3.9；地下地動降低約 100 倍，相當於隔振需求少了 40 dB。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For h = 1×10⁻²¹ (teaching assumption) ΔL = h·L = 1×10⁻²¹ × 3000 m = 3×10⁻¹⁸ m. Brownian thermal-noise amplitude scales roughly as √(T·φ), so cooling from 300 K to 20 K at fixed loss angle lowers it by 1/√15 ≈ 1/3.9; the roughly 100-fold quieter underground ground motion is worth 40 dB of isolation. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以寬頻地震儀同時記錄坑道內與地表的三軸地動，計算 1 到 100 Hz 的振幅譜密度比；以測試質量溫度計的讀值與擺的品質因子量測，估算熱雜訊並在干涉儀雜訊預算中與實測靈敏度曲線比對，確認哪一頻段由哪一項主導。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record three-axis ground motion simultaneously in the tunnel and at the surface with broadband seismometers and compute the amplitude-spectral-density ratio from 1 to 100 Hz; estimate thermal noise from test-mass thermometry and measured pendulum quality factors, and compare it in the interferometer noise budget with the measured sensitivity curve to see which term dominates each band.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

steps.title: 應變量測與地底加低溫的設計賭注：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Strain measurement and the underground-plus-cryogenic bet: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「3 km 臂與神岡地下站址」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “3 km arms and the Kamioka underground site” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以寬頻地震儀同時記錄坑道內與地表的三軸地動，計算 1 到 100 Hz 的振幅譜密度比；以測試質量溫度計的讀值與擺的品質因子量測，估算熱雜訊並在干涉儀雜訊預算中與實測靈敏度曲線比對，確認哪一頻段由哪一項主導。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record three-axis ground motion simultaneously in the tunnel and at the surface with broadband seismometers and compute the amplitude-spectral-density ratio from 1 to 100 Hz; estimate thermal noise from test-mass thermometry and measured pendulum quality factors, and compare it in the interferometer noise budget with the measured sensitivity curve to see which term dominates each band. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若只把地底當成安靜的地方，而忽略岩體內的地下水與高濕度，電子設備腐蝕、局部積水與泵浦振動會成為新的雜訊與停機來源；若冷卻不到設計溫度，熱雜訊收益會遠低於預期，靈敏度停在室溫干涉儀的水準。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Treating the underground merely as a quiet place while ignoring groundwater and high humidity in the rock lets corrosion of electronics, local flooding and pump vibration become new noise and downtime sources; if the test masses never reach design temperature, the thermal-noise gain is far smaller than planned and sensitivity stays at room-temperature levels.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「應變量測與地底加低溫的設計賭注」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

靈敏距離較短的偵測器對網路觀測沒有幫助。

Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A detector with a shorter range adds nothing to network observing.

quiz.explanationEn: Record three-axis ground motion simultaneously in the tunnel and at the surface with broadband seismometers and compute the amplitude-spectral-density ratio from 1 to 100 Hz; estimate thermal noise from test-mass thermometry and measured pendulum quality factors, and compare it in the interferometer noise budget with the measured sensitivity curve to see which term dominates each band. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 應變量測與地底加低溫的設計賭注：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Strain measurement and the underground-plus-cryogenic bet: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「3 km 臂與神岡地下站址」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “3 km arms and the Kamioka underground site” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若只把地底當成安靜的地方，而忽略岩體內的地下水與高濕度，電子設備腐蝕、局部積水與泵浦振動會成為新的雜訊與停機來源；若冷卻不到設計溫度，熱雜訊收益會遠低於預期，靈敏度停在室溫干涉儀的水準。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Treating the underground merely as a quiet place while ignoring groundwater and high humidity in the rock lets corrosion of electronics, local flooding and pump vibration become new noise and downtime sources; if the test masses never reach design temperature, the thermal-noise gain is far smaller than planned and sensitivity stays at room-temperature levels. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這讓 KAGRA 成為第一座同時採用地底與低溫的公里級重力波望遠鏡，也帶來地下水、低溫振動與冷凝污染等新的工程問題。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: This made KAGRA the first kilometre-scale detector to be both underground and cryogenic, and it introduced new engineering problems such as groundwater, cryogenic vibration and cryo-contamination.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要放到地底，重力波干涉儀的所有雜訊都會大幅下降。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Putting an interferometer underground lowers all of its noise sources dramatically." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

steps.title: Fabry–Pérot 臂腔與共振邊帶擷取：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Fabry–Pérot arms and resonant sideband extraction: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「臂腔、功率回收與訊號回收鏡」如何決定KAGRA 地底低溫重力波望遠鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Arm cavities, power and signal recycling” determines the key performance of “KAGRA underground cryogenic gravitational-wave telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: KAGRA 在每條臂放入 Fabry–Pérot 共振腔，讓光在臂內往返數百次以放大臂長變化造成的相位；設計精細度上限約 1550，室溫實測約 1300 到 1400。分光鏡前的功率回收鏡把回到雷射方向的光再送回干涉儀，實測回收增益約 11 到 12；暗埠的訊號回收鏡則形成共振邊帶擷取（RSE）結構，讓高精細度臂腔儲存大功率的同時，把重力波訊號邊帶擷取出來，加寬偵測頻寬。高精細度的另一個用意是讓分光鏡與輸入測試質量基板內的功率較低，減少低溫鏡面的吸熱。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「臂腔、功率回收與訊號回收鏡」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: KAGRA places a Fabry–Pérot cavity in each arm so that light makes hundreds of round trips and amplifies the phase produced by an arm-length change; the design finesse is capped near 1550, with about 1300 to 1400 measured at room temperature. A power-recycling mirror before the beam splitter sends light heading back to the laser into the interferometer again, with a measured recycling gain of about 11 to 12, and a signal-recycling mirror at the dark port forms a resonant-sideband-extraction (RSE) configuration that lets high-finesse arms store large power while extracting the gravitational-wave sidebands and widening the detection band. High finesse also keeps the power inside the beam splitter and input test-mass substrates low, reducing heating of the cryogenic mirrors. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Arm cavities, power and signal recycling”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：臂腔增益 ≈ 2F/π：F = 1550 時約 987，設計分光鏡功率 674 W 時每臂約 674/2 × 987 ≈ 333 kW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Arm gain ≈ 2F/π: about 987 for F = 1550, so the design 674 W at the beam splitter gives about 674/2 × 987 ≈ 333 kW per arm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「臂腔精細度越高，干涉儀在所有頻率都越靈敏。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Higher arm finesse makes the interferometer more sensitive at every frequency." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「臂腔、功率回收與訊號回收鏡」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Arm cavities, power and signal recycling”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: Fabry–Pérot arms and resonant sideband extraction
knowledge.text: KAGRA 在每條臂放入 Fabry–Pérot 共振腔，讓光在臂內往返數百次以放大臂長變化造成的相位；設計精細度上限約 1550，室溫實測約 1300 到 1400。分光鏡前的功率回收鏡把回到雷射方向的光再送回干涉儀，實測回收增益約 11 到 12；暗埠的訊號回收鏡則形成共振邊帶擷取（RSE）結構，讓高精細度臂腔儲存大功率的同時，把重力波訊號邊帶擷取出來，加寬偵測頻寬。
knowledge.textEn: KAGRA places a Fabry–Pérot cavity in each arm so that light makes hundreds of round trips and amplifies the phase produced by an arm-length change; the design finesse is capped near 1550, with about 1300 to 1400 measured at room temperature. A power-recycling mirror before the beam splitter sends light heading back to the laser into the interferometer again, with a measured recycling gain of about 11 to 12, and a signal-recycling mirror at the dark port forms a resonant-sideband-extraction (RSE) configuration that lets high-finesse arms store large power while extracting the gravitational-wave sidebands and widening the detection band.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：臂腔精細度越高，干涉儀在所有頻率都越靈敏。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Higher arm finesse makes the interferometer more sensitive at every frequency. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「Fabry–Pérot 臂腔與共振邊帶擷取」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fabry–Pérot arms and resonant sideband extraction" is correct?
options: 臂腔精細度越高，干涉儀在所有頻率都越靈敏。
熔融石英在室溫表現最好，所以低溫下也一定是最佳鏡材。
KAGRA 在每條臂放入 Fabry–Pérot 共振腔，讓光在臂內往返數百次以放大臂長變化造成的相位。
optionsEn: Higher arm finesse makes the interferometer more sensitive at every frequency.
Fused silica is best at room temperature, so it must also be best when cold.
KAGRA places a Fabry–Pérot cavity in each arm so that light makes hundreds of round trips and amplifies the phase produced by an arm-length change.
quiz.explanation: KAGRA 在每條臂放入 Fabry–Pérot 共振腔，讓光在臂內往返數百次以放大臂長變化造成的相位；設計精細度上限約 1550，室溫實測約 1300 到 1400。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: KAGRA places a Fabry–Pérot cavity in each arm so that light makes hundreds of round trips and amplifies the phase produced by an arm-length change; the design finesse is capped near 1550, with about 1300 to 1400 measured at room temperature. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: Fabry–Pérot 臂腔與共振邊帶擷取：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fabry–Pérot arms and resonant sideband extraction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「臂腔、功率回收與訊號回收鏡」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Arm cavities, power and signal recycling” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：臂腔增益 ≈ 2F/π：F = 1550 時約 987，設計分光鏡功率 674 W 時每臂約 674/2 × 987 ≈ 333 kW。腔極點 f_p = c/(4LF) ≈ 3×10⁸/(4×3000×1550) ≈ 16 Hz；RSE 的等效頻寬約 f_p·(1 + r_s)/(1 − r_s)：設計振幅反射率 r_s = 0.92 時約 390 Hz，安裝的 70% 功率反射（r_s ≈ 0.84）時約 180 Hz。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Arm gain ≈ 2F/π: about 987 for F = 1550, so the design 674 W at the beam splitter gives about 674/2 × 987 ≈ 333 kW per arm. The cavity pole is f_p = c/(4LF) ≈ 3×10⁸/(4×3000×1550) ≈ 16 Hz; RSE widens the bandwidth to about f_p·(1 + r_s)/(1 − r_s), about 390 Hz for the design amplitude reflectivity r_s = 0.92 and about 180 Hz for the installed 70% power reflectivity (r_s ≈ 0.84). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以掃頻或鎖定後的透射光衰減時間量測臂腔精細度；以功率回收腔鎖定前後的分光鏡處功率比得到回收增益；注入已知的差模長度調變並量測轉移函數，擬合出腔極點與訊號回收後的頻寬，再與設計值比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure arm finesse from cavity scans or the ring-down of transmitted light; obtain the recycling gain from the ratio of beam-splitter power with and without the power-recycling cavity locked; inject a known differential length modulation, measure the transfer function and fit the cavity pole and the signal-recycled bandwidth for comparison with design.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 臂腔增益 ≈ 2F/π：F = 1550 時約 987，設計分光鏡功率 674 W 時每臂約 674/2 × 987 ≈ 333 kW。腔極點 f_p = c/(4LF) ≈ 3×10⁸/(4×3000×1550) ≈ 16 Hz；RSE 的等效頻寬約 f_p·(1 + r_s)/(1 − r_s)：設計振幅反射率 r_s = 0.92 時約 390 Hz，安裝的 70% 功率反射（r_s ≈ 0.84）時約 180 Hz。
knowledge.textEn: Arm gain ≈ 2F/π: about 987 for F = 1550, so the design 674 W at the beam splitter gives about 674/2 × 987 ≈ 333 kW per arm. The cavity pole is f_p = c/(4LF) ≈ 3×10⁸/(4×3000×1550) ≈ 16 Hz; RSE widens the bandwidth to about f_p·(1 + r_s)/(1 − r_s), about 390 Hz for the design amplitude reflectivity r_s = 0.92 and about 180 Hz for the installed 70% power reflectivity (r_s ≈ 0.84).

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「Fabry–Pérot 臂腔與共振邊帶擷取」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Fabry–Pérot arms and resonant sideband extraction", which statement holds?
options: 臂腔增益 ≈ 2F/π：F = 1550 時約 987，設計分光鏡功率 674 W 時每臂約 674/2 × 987 ≈ 333 kW。
低溫干涉儀和室溫干涉儀一樣，提高雷射功率就一定提升靈敏度。
靈敏距離較短的偵測器對網路觀測沒有幫助。
optionsEn: Arm gain ≈ 2F/π: about 987 for F = 1550, so the design 674 W at the beam splitter gives about 674/2 × 987 ≈ 333 kW per arm.
Like a room-temperature detector, a cryogenic interferometer always gains sensitivity from more laser power.
A detector with a shorter range adds nothing to network observing.
quiz.explanation: 臂腔增益 ≈ 2F/π：F = 1550 時約 987，設計分光鏡功率 674 W 時每臂約 674/2 × 987 ≈ 333 kW。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Arm gain ≈ 2F/π: about 987 for F = 1550, so the design 674 W at the beam splitter gives about 674/2 × 987 ≈ 333 kW per arm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: Fabry–Pérot 臂腔與共振邊帶擷取：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fabry–Pérot arms and resonant sideband extraction: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「臂腔、功率回收與訊號回收鏡」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Arm cavities, power and signal recycling” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以掃頻或鎖定後的透射光衰減時間量測臂腔精細度；以功率回收腔鎖定前後的分光鏡處功率比得到回收增益；注入已知的差模長度調變並量測轉移函數，擬合出腔極點與訊號回收後的頻寬，再與設計值比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure arm finesse from cavity scans or the ring-down of transmitted light; obtain the recycling gain from the ratio of beam-splitter power with and without the power-recycling cavity locked; inject a known differential length modulation, measure the transfer function and fit the cavity pole and the signal-recycled bandwidth for comparison with design. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：鏡面低溫後若表面吸附分子層使損耗增加，精細度與回收增益同時下降，臂內功率與靈敏度一起變差；訊號回收鏡反射率或失諧相位與設計不符時，偵測頻寬偏移，雜訊預算中的散粒雜訊曲線與實測對不上。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If molecular layers adsorb on the cold mirror surfaces and raise losses, finesse and recycling gain fall together, dragging arm power and sensitivity down; if the signal-recycling reflectivity or detuning phase departs from design, the detection band shifts and the shot-noise curve in the noise budget no longer matches measurement.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以掃頻或鎖定後的透射光衰減時間量測臂腔精細度；以功率回收腔鎖定前後的分光鏡處功率比得到回收增益；注入已知的差模長度調變並量測轉移函數，擬合出腔極點與訊號回收後的頻寬，再與設計值比較。
knowledge.textEn: Measure arm finesse from cavity scans or the ring-down of transmitted light; obtain the recycling gain from the ratio of beam-splitter power with and without the power-recycling cavity locked; inject a known differential length modulation, measure the transfer function and fit the cavity pole and the signal-recycled bandwidth for comparison with design.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「Fabry–Pérot 臂腔與共振邊帶擷取」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fabry–Pérot arms and resonant sideband extraction"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
以掃頻或鎖定後的透射光衰減時間量測臂腔精細度。
高真空中的低溫鏡面不會被任何氣體污染。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.
Measure arm finesse from cavity scans or the ring-down of transmitted light.
A cryogenic mirror in high vacuum cannot be contaminated by any gas.
quiz.explanation: 以掃頻或鎖定後的透射光衰減時間量測臂腔精細度；以功率回收腔鎖定前後的分光鏡處功率比得到回收增益；注入已知的差模長度調變並量測轉移函數，擬合出腔極點與訊號回收後的頻寬，再與設計值比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure arm finesse from cavity scans or the ring-down of transmitted light; obtain the recycling gain from the ratio of beam-splitter power with and without the power-recycling cavity locked; inject a known differential length modulation, measure the transfer function and fit the cavity pole and the signal-recycled bandwidth for comparison with design. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: Fabry–Pérot 臂腔與共振邊帶擷取：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fabry–Pérot arms and resonant sideband extraction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「臂腔、功率回收與訊號回收鏡」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Arm cavities, power and signal recycling” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 鏡面低溫後若表面吸附分子層使損耗增加，精細度與回收增益同時下降，臂內功率與靈敏度一起變差；訊號回收鏡反射率或失諧相位與設計不符時，偵測頻寬偏移，雜訊預算中的散粒雜訊曲線與實測對不上。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If molecular layers adsorb on the cold mirror surfaces and raise losses, finesse and recycling gain fall together, dragging arm power and sensitivity down; if the signal-recycling reflectivity or detuning phase departs from design, the detection band shifts and the shot-noise curve in the noise budget no longer matches measurement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：高精細度的另一個用意是讓分光鏡與輸入測試質量基板內的功率較低，減少低溫鏡面的吸熱。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: High finesse also keeps the power inside the beam splitter and input test-mass substrates low, reducing heating of the cryogenic mirrors.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「臂腔精細度越高，干涉儀在所有頻率都越靈敏。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Higher arm finesse makes the interferometer more sensitive at every frequency." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 鏡面低溫後若表面吸附分子層使損耗增加，精細度與回收增益同時下降，臂內功率與靈敏度一起變差；訊號回收鏡反射率或失諧相位與設計不符時，偵測頻寬偏移，雜訊預算中的散粒雜訊曲線與實測對不上。
knowledge.textEn: If molecular layers adsorb on the cold mirror surfaces and raise losses, finesse and recycling gain fall together, dragging arm power and sensitivity down; if the signal-recycling reflectivity or detuning phase departs from design, the detection band shifts and the shot-noise curve in the noise budget no longer matches measurement.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「Fabry–Pérot 臂腔與共振邊帶擷取」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fabry–Pérot arms and resonant sideband extraction" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
熔融石英在室溫表現最好，所以低溫下也一定是最佳鏡材。
鏡面低溫後若表面吸附分子層使損耗增加，精細度與回收增益同時下降，臂內功率與靈敏度一起變差。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Fused silica is best at room temperature, so it must also be best when cold.
If molecular layers adsorb on the cold mirror surfaces and raise losses, finesse and recycling gain fall together, dragging arm power and sensitivity down.
quiz.explanation: 鏡面低溫後若表面吸附分子層使損耗增加，精細度與回收增益同時下降，臂內功率與靈敏度一起變差；訊號回收鏡反射率或失諧相位與設計不符時，偵測頻寬偏移，雜訊預算中的散粒雜訊曲線與實測對不上。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If molecular layers adsorb on the cold mirror surfaces and raise losses, finesse and recycling gain fall together, dragging arm power and sensitivity down; if the signal-recycling reflectivity or detuning phase departs from design, the detection band shifts and the shot-noise curve in the noise budget no longer matches measurement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「藍寶石測試質量：材料、雙折射與光束尺寸」與「低溫懸吊、藍寶石纖維導熱與冷卻時間」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Sapphire test masses: material, birefringence and beam size" and "Cryopayload, sapphire-fibre heat extraction and cool-down time": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 藍寶石測試質量：材料、雙折射與光束尺寸：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Sapphire test masses: material, birefringence and beam size: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「c 軸藍寶石測試質量」如何決定KAGRA 地底低溫重力波望遠鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “c-axis sapphire test mass” determines the key performance of “KAGRA underground cryogenic gravitational-wave telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: KAGRA 的測試質量是直徑 22 cm、厚 15 cm、質量 22.8 kg 的 c 軸藍寶石，前表面曲率半徑約 1.9 km。選藍寶石而非熔融石英，是因為石英在低溫下機械損耗反而上升，而藍寶石在 20 K 附近熱導率極高、機械品質因子大且熱膨脹趨近於零，熱彈性雜訊與熱透鏡效應都隨之消失。代價是藍寶石為單軸晶體，光軸必須沿 c 軸以避免雙折射；晶體內吸收分布不均、大尺寸晶體取得困難，拋光與鍍膜也比石英難。鏡面上的光束越大，平均掉的鍍膜熱雜訊越多，但需要確保邊緣繞射損耗可忽略。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「c 軸藍寶石測試質量」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: KAGRA's test masses are c-axis sapphire, 22 cm in diameter, 15 cm thick and 22.8 kg, with a front-surface radius of curvature of about 1.9 km. Sapphire was chosen over fused silica because silica's mechanical loss rises at low temperature, whereas sapphire near 20 K has very high thermal conductivity, a high mechanical quality factor and a thermal expansion that tends to zero, so thermoelastic noise and thermal lensing both vanish. The price is that sapphire is uniaxial, so the beam must travel along the c-axis to avoid birefringence; absorption is inhomogeneous within the crystal, large crystals are hard to obtain, and polishing and coating are harder than for silica. A larger beam on the mirror averages away more coating thermal noise, provided edge diffraction loss stays negligible. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “c-axis sapphire test mass”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Mass m = ρ·π·r²·t = 3980 × π × 0.11² × 0.15 ≈ 22.7 kg.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「熔融石英在室溫表現最好，所以低溫下也一定是最佳鏡材。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Fused silica is best at room temperature, so it must also be best when cold." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.

knowledge.title: 藍寶石測試質量：材料、雙折射與光束尺寸
knowledge.titleEn: Sapphire test masses: material, birefringence and beam size
knowledge.text: KAGRA 的測試質量是直徑 22 cm、厚 15 cm、質量 22.8 kg 的 c 軸藍寶石，前表面曲率半徑約 1.9 km。選藍寶石而非熔融石英，是因為石英在低溫下機械損耗反而上升，而藍寶石在 20 K 附近熱導率極高、機械品質因子大且熱膨脹趨近於零，熱彈性雜訊與熱透鏡效應都隨之消失。
knowledge.textEn: KAGRA's test masses are c-axis sapphire, 22 cm in diameter, 15 cm thick and 22.8 kg, with a front-surface radius of curvature of about 1.9 km. Sapphire was chosen over fused silica because silica's mechanical loss rises at low temperature, whereas sapphire near 20 K has very high thermal conductivity, a high mechanical quality factor and a thermal expansion that tends to zero, so thermoelastic noise and thermal lensing both vanish.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：熔融石英在室溫表現最好，所以低溫下也一定是最佳鏡材。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Fused silica is best at room temperature, so it must also be best when cold. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「藍寶石測試質量：材料、雙折射與光束尺寸」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Sapphire test masses: material, birefringence and beam size" is correct?
options: KAGRA 的測試質量是直徑 22 cm、厚 15 cm、質量 22.8 kg 的 c 軸藍寶石，前表面曲率半徑約 1.9 km。
熔融石英在室溫表現最好，所以低溫下也一定是最佳鏡材。
鏡面在真空中冷卻，只要冷凍機功率夠大就能維持低溫。
optionsEn: KAGRA's test masses are c-axis sapphire, 22 cm in diameter, 15 cm thick and 22.8 kg, with a front-surface radius of curvature of about 1.9 km.
Fused silica is best at room temperature, so it must also be best when cold.
A mirror in vacuum stays cold as long as the cryocoolers are powerful enough.
quiz.explanation: KAGRA 的測試質量是直徑 22 cm、厚 15 cm、質量 22.8 kg 的 c 軸藍寶石，前表面曲率半徑約 1.9 km。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: KAGRA's test masses are c-axis sapphire, 22 cm in diameter, 15 cm thick and 22.8 kg, with a front-surface radius of curvature of about 1.9 km. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 藍寶石測試質量：材料、雙折射與光束尺寸：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sapphire test masses: material, birefringence and beam size: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「c 軸藍寶石測試質量」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “c-axis sapphire test mass” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：質量 m = ρ·π·r²·t = 3980 × π × 0.11² × 0.15 ≈ 22.7 kg。對稱腔 L = 3000 m、R = 1900 m 時 g = 1 − L/R ≈ −0.579，鏡面光束半徑 w² = (λL/π)/√(1 − g²) 給出 λ = 1064 nm 時 w ≈ 35 mm；22 cm 鏡面的邊緣截斷損耗 exp(−2a²/w²) ≈ 4×10⁻⁹，可忽略。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Mass m = ρ·π·r²·t = 3980 × π × 0.11² × 0.15 ≈ 22.7 kg. For a symmetric cavity with L = 3000 m and R = 1900 m, g = 1 − L/R ≈ −0.579, and the mirror beam radius from w² = (λL/π)/√(1 − g²) at λ = 1064 nm is about 35 mm; the clipping loss of a 22 cm mirror, exp(−2a²/w²), is about 4×10⁻⁹ and negligible. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以偏振量測檢查基板沿光軸的雙折射與 c 軸對準誤差；以光熱共光路干涉法掃描基板的吸收分布圖；以干涉儀量測鍍膜後的面形與曲率半徑，並把實測曲率代入腔模型，預測光束半徑與高階模態間距，與腔掃描時的模態頻率比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check birefringence along the beam axis and c-axis alignment error with polarimetry; map substrate absorption with photothermal common-path interferometry; measure post-coating figure and radius of curvature interferometrically, feed the measured curvature into the cavity model to predict beam radius and higher-order-mode spacing, and compare with mode frequencies seen in cavity scans.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 質量 m = ρ·π·r²·t = 3980 × π × 0.11² × 0.15 ≈ 22.7 kg。對稱腔 L = 3000 m、R = 1900 m 時 g = 1 − L/R ≈ −0.579，鏡面光束半徑 w² = (λL/π)/√(1 − g²) 給出 λ = 1064 nm 時 w ≈ 35 mm；22 cm 鏡面的邊緣截斷損耗 exp(−2a²/w²) ≈ 4×10⁻⁹，可忽略。
knowledge.textEn: Mass m = ρ·π·r²·t = 3980 × π × 0.11² × 0.15 ≈ 22.7 kg. For a symmetric cavity with L = 3000 m and R = 1900 m, g = 1 − L/R ≈ −0.579, and the mirror beam radius from w² = (λL/π)/√(1 − g²) at λ = 1064 nm is about 35 mm; the clipping loss of a 22 cm mirror, exp(−2a²/w²), is about 4×10⁻⁹ and negligible.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「藍寶石測試質量：材料、雙折射與光束尺寸」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Sapphire test masses: material, birefringence and beam size", which statement holds?
options: 隔振鏈夠長，就不必在意任何連到鏡子的其他連線。
高真空中的低溫鏡面不會被任何氣體污染。
optionsEn: A long enough isolation chain makes other connections to the mirror irrelevant.
A cryogenic mirror in high vacuum cannot be contaminated by any gas.
quiz.explanation: 質量 m = ρ·π·r²·t = 3980 × π × 0.11² × 0.15 ≈ 22.7 kg。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Mass m = ρ·π·r²·t = 3980 × π × 0.11² × 0.15 ≈ 22.7 kg. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 藍寶石測試質量：材料、雙折射與光束尺寸：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sapphire test masses: material, birefringence and beam size: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「c 軸藍寶石測試質量」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “c-axis sapphire test mass” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以偏振量測檢查基板沿光軸的雙折射與 c 軸對準誤差；以光熱共光路干涉法掃描基板的吸收分布圖；以干涉儀量測鍍膜後的面形與曲率半徑，並把實測曲率代入腔模型，預測光束半徑與高階模態間距，與腔掃描時的模態頻率比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check birefringence along the beam axis and c-axis alignment error with polarimetry; map substrate absorption with photothermal common-path interferometry; measure post-coating figure and radius of curvature interferometrically, feed the measured curvature into the cavity model to predict beam radius and higher-order-mode spacing, and compare with mode frequencies seen in cavity scans. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若晶體 c 軸與光軸偏差數度，穿過輸入測試質量的光產生偏振轉換，部分功率變成無法共振的偏振，回收增益下降並增加暗埠雜光；吸收熱點則在低溫下集中加熱，使鏡面局部溫度偏高。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the crystal c-axis is a few degrees off the beam axis, light passing through the input test mass undergoes polarisation conversion, part of the power ends up in a non-resonant polarisation, recycling gain falls and dark-port stray light grows; absorption hot spots concentrate heating and leave the mirror locally warmer at cryogenic temperature.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以偏振量測檢查基板沿光軸的雙折射與 c 軸對準誤差；以光熱共光路干涉法掃描基板的吸收分布圖；以干涉儀量測鍍膜後的面形與曲率半徑，並把實測曲率代入腔模型，預測光束半徑與高階模態間距，與腔掃描時的模態頻率比對。
knowledge.textEn: Check birefringence along the beam axis and c-axis alignment error with polarimetry; map substrate absorption with photothermal common-path interferometry; measure post-coating figure and radius of curvature interferometrically, feed the measured curvature into the cavity model to predict beam radius and higher-order-mode spacing, and compare with mode frequencies seen in cavity scans.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「藍寶石測試質量：材料、雙折射與光束尺寸」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Sapphire test masses: material, birefringence and beam size"?
options: 只看單次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準件或重複量測。
只要放到地底，重力波干涉儀的所有雜訊都會大幅下降。
以偏振量測檢查基板沿光軸的雙折射與 c 軸對準誤差。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the result; no reference artefact or repeat measurement is needed.
Putting an interferometer underground lowers all of its noise sources dramatically.
Check birefringence along the beam axis and c-axis alignment error with polarimetry.
quiz.explanation: 以偏振量測檢查基板沿光軸的雙折射與 c 軸對準誤差；以光熱共光路干涉法掃描基板的吸收分布圖；以干涉儀量測鍍膜後的面形與曲率半徑，並把實測曲率代入腔模型，預測光束半徑與高階模態間距，與腔掃描時的模態頻率比對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check birefringence along the beam axis and c-axis alignment error with polarimetry; map substrate absorption with photothermal common-path interferometry; measure post-coating figure and radius of curvature interferometrically, feed the measured curvature into the cavity model to predict beam radius and higher-order-mode spacing, and compare with mode frequencies seen in cavity scans. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 藍寶石測試質量：材料、雙折射與光束尺寸：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sapphire test masses: material, birefringence and beam size: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「c 軸藍寶石測試質量」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “c-axis sapphire test mass” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若晶體 c 軸與光軸偏差數度，穿過輸入測試質量的光產生偏振轉換，部分功率變成無法共振的偏振，回收增益下降並增加暗埠雜光；吸收熱點則在低溫下集中加熱，使鏡面局部溫度偏高。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the crystal c-axis is a few degrees off the beam axis, light passing through the input test mass undergoes polarisation conversion, part of the power ends up in a non-resonant polarisation, recycling gain falls and dark-port stray light grows; absorption hot spots concentrate heating and leave the mirror locally warmer at cryogenic temperature. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：鏡面上的光束越大，平均掉的鍍膜熱雜訊越多，但需要確保邊緣繞射損耗可忽略。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A larger beam on the mirror averages away more coating thermal noise, provided edge diffraction loss stays negligible.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「熔融石英在室溫表現最好，所以低溫下也一定是最佳鏡材。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Fused silica is best at room temperature, so it must also be best when cold." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若晶體 c 軸與光軸偏差數度，穿過輸入測試質量的光產生偏振轉換，部分功率變成無法共振的偏振，回收增益下降並增加暗埠雜光；吸收熱點則在低溫下集中加熱，使鏡面局部溫度偏高。
knowledge.textEn: If the crystal c-axis is a few degrees off the beam axis, light passing through the input test mass undergoes polarisation conversion, part of the power ends up in a non-resonant polarisation, recycling gain falls and dark-port stray light grows; absorption hot spots concentrate heating and leave the mirror locally warmer at cryogenic temperature.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「藍寶石測試質量：材料、雙折射與光束尺寸」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Sapphire test masses: material, birefringence and beam size" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若晶體 c 軸與光軸偏差數度，穿過輸入測試質量的光產生偏振轉換，部分功率變成無法共振的偏振，回收增益下降並增加暗埠雜光。
異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
鏡面在真空中冷卻，只要冷凍機功率夠大就能維持低溫。
optionsEn: If the crystal c-axis is a few degrees off the beam axis, light passing through the input test mass undergoes polarisation conversion, part of the power ends up in a non-resonant polarisation, recycling gain falls and dark-port stray light grows.
An anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A mirror in vacuum stays cold as long as the cryocoolers are powerful enough.
quiz.explanation: 若晶體 c 軸與光軸偏差數度，穿過輸入測試質量的光產生偏振轉換，部分功率變成無法共振的偏振，回收增益下降並增加暗埠雜光；吸收熱點則在低溫下集中加熱，使鏡面局部溫度偏高。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the crystal c-axis is a few degrees off the beam axis, light passing through the input test mass undergoes polarisation conversion, part of the power ends up in a non-resonant polarisation, recycling gain falls and dark-port stray light grows; absorption hot spots concentrate heating and leave the mirror locally warmer at cryogenic temperature. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 低溫懸吊、藍寶石纖維導熱與冷卻時間：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Cryopayload, sapphire-fibre heat extraction and cool-down time: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「低溫懸吊與藍寶石纖維」如何決定KAGRA 地底低溫重力波望遠鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cryopayload and sapphire fibres” determines the key performance of “KAGRA underground cryogenic gravitational-wave telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 測試質量在真空中懸吊，熱只能經由懸吊纖維傳導或輻射散失；而在 20 K 附近輻射散熱極弱，所以吸收的雷射熱必須沿四根長 35 cm、粗 1.6 mm 的藍寶石纖維傳到上一級質量，再經純鋁熱連結傳到低溫恆溫器。每座恆溫器有四台二級脈衝管冷凍機，全站共 16 台，並以 8 K 內層與 80 K 外層輻射屏蔽包圍；長約 5 m 的導管屏蔽阻擋室溫熱輻射沿光路進入。纖維必須同時夠細以降低懸吊熱雜訊、夠粗以帶走熱，形成直接的設計取捨。2018 年首次低溫運轉時，一面端測試質量約 30 天降到 18 K。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「低溫懸吊與藍寶石纖維」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The test mass hangs in vacuum and can lose heat only by conduction along its suspension fibres or by radiation, and radiation is very weak near 20 K, so absorbed laser heat must flow through four sapphire fibres 35 cm long and 1.6 mm thick to the stage above, then through pure-aluminium heat links to the cryostat. Each cryostat has four two-stage pulse-tube cryocoolers, 16 in all, with inner 8 K and outer 80 K radiation shields, and duct shields about 5 m long stop room-temperature radiation from entering along the beam path. The fibres must be thin to reduce suspension thermal noise yet thick enough to carry the heat, a direct design trade-off. In the first cryogenic operation in 2018, an end test mass took about 30 days to reach 18 K. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Cryopayload and sapphire fibres”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：四根纖維的熱導 G = 4kA/L：假設細纖維在 20 K 的熱導率 k ≈ 2000 W/(m·K)，A = π(0.8 mm)² ≈ 2.0×10⁻⁶ m²，L = 0.35 m，G ≈ 0.046 W/K。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The conductance of four fibres is G = 4kA/L: assuming k ≈ 2000 W/(m·K) for thin fibres at 20 K, A = π(0.8 mm)² ≈ 2.0×10⁻⁶ m² and L = 0.35 m, G ≈ 0.046 W/K.

knowledge.title: 低溫懸吊、藍寶石纖維導熱與冷卻時間
knowledge.titleEn: Cryopayload, sapphire-fibre heat extraction and cool-down time
knowledge.text: 測試質量在真空中懸吊，熱只能經由懸吊纖維傳導或輻射散失；而在 20 K 附近輻射散熱極弱，所以吸收的雷射熱必須沿四根長 35 cm、粗 1.6 mm 的藍寶石纖維傳到上一級質量，再經純鋁熱連結傳到低溫恆溫器。每座恆溫器有四台二級脈衝管冷凍機，全站共 16 台，並以 8 K 內層與 80 K 外層輻射屏蔽包圍；長約 5 m 的導管屏蔽阻擋室溫熱輻射沿光路進入。
knowledge.textEn: The test mass hangs in vacuum and can lose heat only by conduction along its suspension fibres or by radiation, and radiation is very weak near 20 K, so absorbed laser heat must flow through four sapphire fibres 35 cm long and 1.6 mm thick to the stage above, then through pure-aluminium heat links to the cryostat. Each cryostat has four two-stage pulse-tube cryocoolers, 16 in all, with inner 8 K and outer 80 K radiation shields, and duct shields about 5 m long stop room-temperature radiation from entering along the beam path.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鏡面在真空中冷卻，只要冷凍機功率夠大就能維持低溫。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A mirror in vacuum stays cold as long as the cryocoolers are powerful enough. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「低溫懸吊、藍寶石纖維導熱與冷卻時間」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cryopayload, sapphire-fibre heat extraction and cool-down time" is correct?
options: 鏡面在真空中冷卻，只要冷凍機功率夠大就能維持低溫。
測試質量在真空中懸吊，熱只能經由懸吊纖維傳導或輻射散失。
低溫干涉儀和室溫干涉儀一樣，提高雷射功率就一定提升靈敏度。
optionsEn: A mirror in vacuum stays cold as long as the cryocoolers are powerful enough.

The test mass hangs in vacuum and can lose heat only by conduction along its suspension fibres or by radiation, and radiation is very weak near 20 K, so absorbed laser heat must flow through four sapphire fibres 35 cm long and 1.6 mm thick to the stage above, then through pure-aluminium heat links to the cryostat.
Like a room-temperature detector, a cryogenic interferometer always gains sensitivity from more laser power.

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 低溫懸吊、藍寶石纖維導熱與冷卻時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cryopayload, sapphire-fibre heat extraction and cool-down time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「低溫懸吊與藍寶石纖維」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cryopayload and sapphire fibres” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：四根纖維的熱導 G = 4kA/L：假設細纖維在 20 K 的熱導率 k ≈ 2000 W/(m·K)，A = π(0.8 mm)² ≈ 2.0×10⁻⁶ m²，L = 0.35 m，G ≈ 0.046 W/K。若鏡面吸收 0.42 W，鏡面比上一級高 ΔT = Q/G ≈ 9 K；上一級 13 K 時鏡面約 22 K，正是設計溫度上限。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The conductance of four fibres is G = 4kA/L: assuming k ≈ 2000 W/(m·K) for thin fibres at 20 K, A = π(0.8 mm)² ≈ 2.0×10⁻⁶ m² and L = 0.35 m, G ≈ 0.046 W/K. If the mirror absorbs 0.42 W, it runs ΔT = Q/G ≈ 9 K warmer than the stage above; with that stage at 13 K the mirror sits near 22 K, right at the design limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在各級質量與屏蔽上裝校正過的低溫溫度計，記錄冷卻曲線並以熱容與熱導模型擬合；在穩態下改變臂內功率，量測鏡面與上一級的溫差對吸收功率的斜率，反推纖維與接合面的實際熱導，再與設計值比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Mount calibrated cryogenic thermometers on every stage and shield, record the cool-down curves and fit them with heat-capacity and conductance models; in steady state vary arm power and measure the slope of the mirror-to-stage temperature difference versus absorbed power to back out the real conductance of fibres and joints, then compare with design.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.
