If the mirror absorbs 0.42 W, it runs ΔT = Q/G ≈ 9 K warmer than the stage above; with that stage at 13 K the mirror sits near 22 K, right at the design limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「低溫懸吊、藍寶石纖維導熱與冷卻時間」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cryopayload, sapphire-fibre heat extraction and cool-down time", which statement holds?
options: 靈敏距離較短的偵測器對網路觀測沒有幫助。
只要放到地底，重力波干涉儀的所有雜訊都會大幅下降。

Putting an interferometer underground lowers all of its noise sources dramatically.

quiz.explanationEn: The conductance of four fibres is G = 4kA/L: assuming k ≈ 2000 W/(m·K) for thin fibres at 20 K, A = π(0.8 mm)² ≈ 2.0×10⁻⁶ m² and L = 0.35 m, G ≈ 0.046 W/K. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 低溫懸吊、藍寶石纖維導熱與冷卻時間：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cryopayload, sapphire-fibre heat extraction and cool-down time: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「低溫懸吊與藍寶石纖維」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Cryopayload and sapphire fibres” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在各級質量與屏蔽上裝校正過的低溫溫度計，記錄冷卻曲線並以熱容與熱導模型擬合；在穩態下改變臂內功率，量測鏡面與上一級的溫差對吸收功率的斜率，反推纖維與接合面的實際熱導，再與設計值比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Mount calibrated cryogenic thermometers on every stage and shield, record the cool-down curves and fit them with heat-capacity and conductance models; in steady state vary arm power and measure the slope of the mirror-to-stage temperature difference versus absorbed power to back out the real conductance of fibres and joints, then compare with design. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：纖維與鏡體接合面（例如接合鉤）熱阻偏大時，同樣吸收功率下鏡面溫度明顯升高，熱雜訊收益消失，只能降低輸入功率而犧牲高頻散粒雜訊；熱連結若太硬，又會把恆溫器振動直接帶進鏡面。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the joint between fibre and mirror body has excess thermal resistance, the same absorbed power raises the mirror temperature markedly, the thermal-noise gain disappears and input power must be cut at the expense of high-frequency shot noise; heat links that are too stiff carry cryostat vibration straight into the mirror.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在各級質量與屏蔽上裝校正過的低溫溫度計，記錄冷卻曲線並以熱容與熱導模型擬合；在穩態下改變臂內功率，量測鏡面與上一級的溫差對吸收功率的斜率，反推纖維與接合面的實際熱導，再與設計值比較。
knowledge.textEn: Mount calibrated cryogenic thermometers on every stage and shield, record the cool-down curves and fit them with heat-capacity and conductance models; in steady state vary arm power and measure the slope of the mirror-to-stage temperature difference versus absorbed power to back out the real conductance of fibres and joints, then compare with design.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「低溫懸吊、藍寶石纖維導熱與冷卻時間」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cryopayload, sapphire-fibre heat extraction and cool-down time"?
options: 在各級質量與屏蔽上裝校正過的低溫溫度計，記錄冷卻曲線並以熱容與熱導模型擬合。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
臂腔精細度越高，干涉儀在所有頻率都越靈敏。
optionsEn: Mount calibrated cryogenic thermometers on every stage and shield, record the cool-down curves and fit them with heat-capacity and conductance models.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Higher arm finesse makes the interferometer more sensitive at every frequency.
quiz.explanation: 在各級質量與屏蔽上裝校正過的低溫溫度計，記錄冷卻曲線並以熱容與熱導模型擬合；在穩態下改變臂內功率，量測鏡面與上一級的溫差對吸收功率的斜率，反推纖維與接合面的實際熱導，再與設計值比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Mount calibrated cryogenic thermometers on every stage and shield, record the cool-down curves and fit them with heat-capacity and conductance models; in steady state vary arm power and measure the slope of the mirror-to-stage temperature difference versus absorbed power to back out the real conductance of fibres and joints, then compare with design. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 低溫懸吊、藍寶石纖維導熱與冷卻時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cryopayload, sapphire-fibre heat extraction and cool-down time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「低溫懸吊與藍寶石纖維」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Cryopayload and sapphire fibres” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 纖維與鏡體接合面（例如接合鉤）熱阻偏大時，同樣吸收功率下鏡面溫度明顯升高，熱雜訊收益消失，只能降低輸入功率而犧牲高頻散粒雜訊；熱連結若太硬，又會把恆溫器振動直接帶進鏡面。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the joint between fibre and mirror body has excess thermal resistance, the same absorbed power raises the mirror temperature markedly, the thermal-noise gain disappears and input power must be cut at the expense of high-frequency shot noise; heat links that are too stiff carry cryostat vibration straight into the mirror. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：2018 年首次低溫運轉時，一面端測試質量約 30 天降到 18 K。

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A mirror in vacuum stays cold as long as the cryocoolers are powerful enough." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.questionEn: When "Cryopayload, sapphire-fibre heat extraction and cool-down time" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「低溫鏡面的吸收熱預算與功率上限」與「隔振鏈、熱連結振動與地下雜訊預算」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Absorption heat budget and the power ceiling of cryogenic mirrors" and "Isolation chain, heat-link vibration and the underground noise budget": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 低溫鏡面的吸收熱預算與功率上限：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Absorption heat budget and the power ceiling of cryogenic mirrors: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「吸收熱預算與臂內功率」如何決定KAGRA 地底低溫重力波望遠鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Absorption heat budget and arm power” determines the key performance of “KAGRA underground cryogenic gravitational-wave telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 室溫干涉儀可以不斷提高雷射功率來壓低散粒雜訊，再以熱補償系統處理熱透鏡；KAGRA 則被低溫限制：鏡面吸收的每一瓦都必須經由細纖維帶走，因此吸收熱預算直接決定可用的臂內功率。熱源有兩部分：輸入測試質量的基板吸收（光以回收腔功率穿過 15 cm 藍寶石）與每面鏡的鍍膜吸收（以臂內數百 kW 的功率計算）。由於藍寶石在低溫下的折射率溫度係數與膨脹極小，熱透鏡幾乎不存在，問題完全變成熱量是否送得出去。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「吸收熱預算與臂內功率」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A room-temperature interferometer can keep raising laser power to suppress shot noise and treat thermal lensing with a compensation system, but KAGRA is bounded by cryogenics: every watt absorbed by a mirror must leave through thin fibres, so the absorption heat budget sets the usable arm power. There are two heat sources: substrate absorption in the input test mass, where light crosses 15 cm of sapphire at the recycling-cavity power, and coating absorption on every mirror at the arm power of hundreds of kilowatts. Because sapphire's thermo-optic coefficient and expansion are tiny when cold, thermal lensing is almost absent and the problem becomes purely whether the heat can be extracted. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Absorption heat budget and arm power”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume 50 ppm/cm substrate and 0.5 ppm coating absorption: substrate heat = 337 W × 50×10⁻⁶/cm × 15 cm ≈ 0.25 W and coating heat = 333 kW × 0.5×10⁻⁶ ≈ 0.17 W, about 0.42 W in total.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「低溫干涉儀和室溫干涉儀一樣，提高雷射功率就一定提升靈敏度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Like a room-temperature detector, a cryogenic interferometer always gains sensitivity from more laser power." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 低溫鏡面的吸收熱預算與功率上限：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Absorption heat budget and the power ceiling of cryogenic mirrors: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「吸收熱預算與臂內功率」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Absorption heat budget and arm power” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：假設基板吸收 50 ppm/cm、鍍膜吸收 0.5 ppm：基板熱 = 337 W × 50×10⁻⁶/cm × 15 cm ≈ 0.25 W，鍍膜熱 = 333 kW × 0.5×10⁻⁶ ≈ 0.17 W，合計約 0.42 W。若基板吸收不均使局部達 100 ppm/cm，合計約 0.67 W，在 G ≈ 0.046 W/K 時溫差升到約 15 K；要守住 0.42 W，分光鏡功率需降到約 674 × 0.62 ≈ 420 W。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume 50 ppm/cm substrate and 0.5 ppm coating absorption: substrate heat = 337 W × 50×10⁻⁶/cm × 15 cm ≈ 0.25 W and coating heat = 333 kW × 0.5×10⁻⁶ ≈ 0.17 W, about 0.42 W in total. If inhomogeneous sapphire reaches 100 ppm/cm the total is about 0.67 W and, with G ≈ 0.046 W/K, the temperature difference rises to about 15 K; holding 0.42 W requires cutting beam-splitter power to about 674 × 0.62 ≈ 420 W. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：安裝前以光熱法量測基板吸收分布並計算沿光束路徑的加權平均；運轉中逐步提高輸入功率，同時記錄鏡面溫度、臂內功率與回收增益，擬合溫升對臂內功率的斜率，分離基板與鍍膜兩項吸收，作為設定最大輸入功率的依據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before installation map substrate absorption photothermally and compute the beam-weighted average along the path; in operation raise input power step by step while logging mirror temperature, arm power and recycling gain, and fit the temperature rise versus arm power to separate substrate and coating absorption as the basis for the maximum input power.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

If inhomogeneous sapphire reaches 100 ppm/cm the total is about 0.67 W and, with G ≈ 0.046 W/K, the temperature difference rises to about 15 K; holding 0.42 W requires cutting beam-splitter power to about 674 × 0.62 ≈ 420 W.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。

steps.title: 低溫鏡面的吸收熱預算與功率上限：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Absorption heat budget and the power ceiling of cryogenic mirrors: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「吸收熱預算與臂內功率」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Absorption heat budget and arm power” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 安裝前以光熱法量測基板吸收分布並計算沿光束路徑的加權平均；運轉中逐步提高輸入功率，同時記錄鏡面溫度、臂內功率與回收增益，擬合溫升對臂內功率的斜率，分離基板與鍍膜兩項吸收，作為設定最大輸入功率的依據。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before installation map substrate absorption photothermally and compute the beam-weighted average along the path; in operation raise input power step by step while logging mirror temperature, arm power and recycling gain, and fit the temperature rise versus arm power to separate substrate and coating absorption as the basis for the maximum input power. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若只用晶體平均吸收值估熱，而光束恰好穿過吸收熱點，實際溫度高於預期，熱雜訊與纖維熱導同時惡化，干涉儀在升功率途中失鎖或必須退回低功率運轉。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Estimating heat from a crystal-average absorption while the beam happens to cross an absorption hot spot leaves the real temperature higher than expected, worsening thermal noise and fibre conductance together, so the interferometer loses lock during power-up or must retreat to low power.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 隔振鏈、熱連結振動與地下雜訊預算：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Isolation chain, heat-link vibration and the underground noise budget: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「Type-A 隔振塔與熱連結」如何決定KAGRA 地底低溫重力波望遠鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Type-A tower and heat links” determines the key performance of “KAGRA underground cryogenic gravitational-wave telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: KAGRA 的測試質量掛在高 13.5 m 的 Type-A 系統下：上方為倒立擺與多級幾何反彈簧濾波器組成的室溫隔振鏈，下方接入低溫恆溫器內的低溫懸吊；分光鏡與訊號回收鏡使用較短的 Type-B 系統，功率回收鏡使用 Type-Bp。低溫設計的特殊風險是熱連結：它必須接到懸吊鏈中才能導熱，等於在精心設計的隔振鏈旁開了一條振動捷徑，把冷凍機與屏蔽的振動帶入鏡面。因此熱連結要做得非常柔軟，並接在已被隔振的中間級，而不是直接接在鏡體附近。地下的低地動讓這條預算可行，但不會自動解決熱連結問題。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「Type-A 隔振塔與熱連結」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: KAGRA's test masses hang below the 13.5 m Type-A system: an inverted pendulum and multiple geometric-anti-spring filters form a room-temperature isolation chain above, which connects to the cryogenic payload inside the cryostat; the beam splitter and signal-recycling mirror use the shorter Type-B system and the power-recycling mirrors Type-Bp. The special cryogenic risk is the heat link: it must attach to the suspension chain to carry heat, which opens a vibration shortcut beside a carefully designed isolation chain and brings cryocooler and shield vibration into the mirror. The links must therefore be extremely soft and attached at already-isolated intermediate stages rather than near the mirror. Low underground ground motion makes the budget feasible but does not solve the heat-link problem by itself. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Type-A tower and heat links”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：假設地下 10 Hz 地動 1×10⁻¹¹ m/√Hz、隔振鏈 5 級各共振 0.5 Hz，傳遞 ≈ (0.5/10)¹⁰ ≈ 1×10⁻¹³，鏡面約 1×10⁻²⁴ m/√Hz。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume 1×10⁻¹¹ m/√Hz of underground motion at 10 Hz and a 5-stage chain with 0.5 Hz resonances: transmission ≈ (0.5/10)¹⁰ ≈ 1×10⁻¹³ leaves about 1×10⁻²⁴ m/√Hz at the mirror.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「隔振鏈夠長，就不必在意任何連到鏡子的其他連線。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A long enough isolation chain makes other connections to the mirror irrelevant." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「Type-A 隔振塔與熱連結」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Type-A tower and heat links”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 隔振鏈、熱連結振動與地下雜訊預算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Isolation chain, heat-link vibration and the underground noise budget: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「Type-A 隔振塔與熱連結」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Type-A tower and heat links” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：假設地下 10 Hz 地動 1×10⁻¹¹ m/√Hz、隔振鏈 5 級各共振 0.5 Hz，傳遞 ≈ (0.5/10)¹⁰ ≈ 1×10⁻¹³，鏡面約 1×10⁻²⁴ m/√Hz。若 h = 1×10⁻²²/√Hz，單面鏡容許 h·L/2 = 1.5×10⁻¹⁹ m/√Hz。但屏蔽振動 1×10⁻⁹ m/√Hz 若經熱連結只過兩級 1 Hz 濾波，殘餘 (1/10)⁴ × 10⁻⁹ = 1×10⁻¹³ m/√Hz，超標近百萬倍。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume 1×10⁻¹¹ m/√Hz of underground motion at 10 Hz and a 5-stage chain with 0.5 Hz resonances: transmission ≈ (0.5/10)¹⁰ ≈ 1×10⁻¹³ leaves about 1×10⁻²⁴ m/√Hz at the mirror. For h = 1×10⁻²²/√Hz a single mirror may move h·L/2 = 1.5×10⁻¹⁹ m/√Hz. Yet shield vibration of 1×10⁻⁹ m/√Hz reaching the mirror through a heat link past only two 1 Hz stages leaves (1/10)⁴ × 10⁻⁹ = 1×10⁻¹³ m/√Hz, nearly a million times too much. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在冷凍機運轉與暫停的條件下分別量測恆溫器屏蔽與懸吊各級的加速度譜，比較差值以找出經熱連結進入的振動；以注入式量測（在屏蔽上施加已知振動）求得屏蔽到鏡面的耦合轉移函數，並把結果放進干涉儀雜訊預算。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure acceleration spectra of cryostat shields and each suspension stage with the cryocoolers running and paused, and compare to isolate vibration entering through the heat links; inject known vibration on the shield to measure the shield-to-mirror coupling transfer function and place the result in the interferometer noise budget.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 假設地下 10 Hz 地動 1×10⁻¹¹ m/√Hz、隔振鏈 5 級各共振 0.5 Hz，傳遞 ≈ (0.5/10)¹⁰ ≈ 1×10⁻¹³，鏡面約 1×10⁻²⁴ m/√Hz。若 h = 1×10⁻²²/√Hz，單面鏡容許 h·L/2 = 1.5×10⁻¹⁹ m/√Hz。但屏蔽振動 1×10⁻⁹ m/√Hz 若經熱連結只過兩級 1 Hz 濾波，殘餘 (1/10)⁴ × 10⁻⁹ = 1×10⁻¹³ m/√Hz，超標近百萬倍。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 1×10⁻¹¹ m/√Hz of underground motion at 10 Hz and a 5-stage chain with 0.5 Hz resonances: transmission ≈ (0.5/10)¹⁰ ≈ 1×10⁻¹³ leaves about 1×10⁻²⁴ m/√Hz at the mirror. For h = 1×10⁻²²/√Hz a single mirror may move h·L/2 = 1.5×10⁻¹⁹ m/√Hz. Yet shield vibration of 1×10⁻⁹ m/√Hz reaching the mirror through a heat link past only two 1 Hz stages leaves (1/10)⁴ × 10⁻⁹ = 1×10⁻¹³ m/√Hz, nearly a million times too much.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「隔振鏈、熱連結振動與地下雜訊預算」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Isolation chain, heat-link vibration and the underground noise budget", which statement holds?
options: 只要放到地底，重力波干涉儀的所有雜訊都會大幅下降。
假設地下 10 Hz 地動 1×10⁻¹¹ m/√Hz、隔振鏈 5 級各共振 0.5 Hz，傳遞 ≈ (0.5/10)¹⁰ ≈ 1×10⁻¹³，鏡面約 1×10⁻²⁴ m/√Hz。
熔融石英在室溫表現最好，所以低溫下也一定是最佳鏡材。
optionsEn: Putting an interferometer underground lowers all of its noise sources dramatically.
Assume 1×10⁻¹¹ m/√Hz of underground motion at 10 Hz and a 5-stage chain with 0.5 Hz resonances: transmission ≈ (0.5/10)¹⁰ ≈ 1×10⁻¹³ leaves about 1×10⁻²⁴ m/√Hz at the mirror.
Fused silica is best at room temperature, so it must also be best when cold.

steps.title: 隔振鏈、熱連結振動與地下雜訊預算：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Isolation chain, heat-link vibration and the underground noise budget: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「Type-A 隔振塔與熱連結」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Type-A tower and heat links” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在冷凍機運轉與暫停的條件下分別量測恆溫器屏蔽與懸吊各級的加速度譜，比較差值以找出經熱連結進入的振動；以注入式量測（在屏蔽上施加已知振動）求得屏蔽到鏡面的耦合轉移函數，並把結果放進干涉儀雜訊預算。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure acceleration spectra of cryostat shields and each suspension stage with the cryocoolers running and paused, and compare to isolate vibration entering through the heat links; inject known vibration on the shield to measure the shield-to-mirror coupling transfer function and place the result in the interferometer noise budget. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：熱連結在冷卻收縮後變緊或碰觸屏蔽，會在靈敏度曲線上出現與冷凍機頻率及其諧波相關的尖峰與寬帶雜訊；若誤以為來自地動而加強隔振鏈，問題不會消失。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A heat link that tightens after thermal contraction or touches a shield produces peaks and broadband noise at the cryocooler frequency and its harmonics in the sensitivity curve; treating it as ground motion and strengthening the isolation chain does not make it go away.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在冷凍機運轉與暫停的條件下分別量測恆溫器屏蔽與懸吊各級的加速度譜，比較差值以找出經熱連結進入的振動；以注入式量測（在屏蔽上施加已知振動）求得屏蔽到鏡面的耦合轉移函數，並把結果放進干涉儀雜訊預算。
knowledge.textEn: Measure acceleration spectra of cryostat shields and each suspension stage with the cryocoolers running and paused, and compare to isolate vibration entering through the heat links; inject known vibration on the shield to measure the shield-to-mirror coupling transfer function and place the result in the interferometer noise budget.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「隔振鏈、熱連結振動與地下雜訊預算」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Isolation chain, heat-link vibration and the underground noise budget"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
鏡面在真空中冷卻，只要冷凍機功率夠大就能維持低溫。
在冷凍機運轉與暫停的條件下分別量測恆溫器屏蔽與懸吊各級的加速度譜，比較差值以找出經熱連結進入的振動。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
A mirror in vacuum stays cold as long as the cryocoolers are powerful enough.
Measure acceleration spectra of cryostat shields and each suspension stage with the cryocoolers running and paused, and compare to isolate vibration entering through the heat links.
quiz.explanation: 在冷凍機運轉與暫停的條件下分別量測恆溫器屏蔽與懸吊各級的加速度譜，比較差值以找出經熱連結進入的振動；以注入式量測（在屏蔽上施加已知振動）求得屏蔽到鏡面的耦合轉移函數，並把結果放進干涉儀雜訊預算。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure acceleration spectra of cryostat shields and each suspension stage with the cryocoolers running and paused, and compare to isolate vibration entering through the heat links; inject known vibration on the shield to measure the shield-to-mirror coupling transfer function and place the result in the interferometer noise budget. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 隔振鏈、熱連結振動與地下雜訊預算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Isolation chain, heat-link vibration and the underground noise budget: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「Type-A 隔振塔與熱連結」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Type-A tower and heat links” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 熱連結在冷卻收縮後變緊或碰觸屏蔽，會在靈敏度曲線上出現與冷凍機頻率及其諧波相關的尖峰與寬帶雜訊；若誤以為來自地動而加強隔振鏈，問題不會消失。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A heat link that tightens after thermal contraction or touches a shield produces peaks and broadband noise at the cryocooler frequency and its harmonics in the sensitivity curve; treating it as ground motion and strengthening the isolation chain does not make it go away. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：地下的低地動讓這條預算可行，但不會自動解決熱連結問題。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Low underground ground motion makes the budget feasible but does not solve the heat-link problem by itself.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「隔振鏈夠長，就不必在意任何連到鏡子的其他連線。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A long enough isolation chain makes other connections to the mirror irrelevant." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 熱連結在冷卻收縮後變緊或碰觸屏蔽，會在靈敏度曲線上出現與冷凍機頻率及其諧波相關的尖峰與寬帶雜訊；若誤以為來自地動而加強隔振鏈，問題不會消失。
knowledge.textEn: A heat link that tightens after thermal contraction or touches a shield produces peaks and broadband noise at the cryocooler frequency and its harmonics in the sensitivity curve; treating it as ground motion and strengthening the isolation chain does not make it go away.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「隔振鏈、熱連結振動與地下雜訊預算」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Isolation chain, heat-link vibration and the underground noise budget" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 熱連結在冷卻收縮後變緊或碰觸屏蔽，會在靈敏度曲線上出現與冷凍機頻率及其諧波相關的尖峰與寬帶雜訊；若誤以為來自地動而加強隔振鏈，問題不會消失。
只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
靈敏距離較短的偵測器對網路觀測沒有幫助。
optionsEn: A heat link that tightens after thermal contraction or touches a shield produces peaks and broadband noise at the cryocooler frequency and its harmonics in the sensitivity curve.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
A detector with a shorter range adds nothing to network observing.
quiz.explanation: 熱連結在冷卻收縮後變緊或碰觸屏蔽，會在靈敏度曲線上出現與冷凍機頻率及其諧波相關的尖峰與寬帶雜訊；若誤以為來自地動而加強隔振鏈，問題不會消失。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A heat link that tightens after thermal contraction or touches a shield produces peaks and broadband noise at the cryocooler frequency and its harmonics in the sensitivity curve; treating it as ground motion and strengthening the isolation chain does not make it go away. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「網路觀測：靈敏距離、偵測體積與定位」與「地下低溫營運：冷凝污染、地震恢復與交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Network observing: sensitive range, detection volume and localisation" and "Underground cryogenic operation: cryo-contamination, earthquake recovery and handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 網路觀測：靈敏距離、偵測體積與定位：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Network observing: sensitive range, detection volume and localisation: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「LIGO–Virgo–KAGRA 觀測網路」如何決定KAGRA 地底低溫重力波望遠鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “LIGO–Virgo–KAGRA network” determines the key performance of “KAGRA underground cryogenic gravitational-wave telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 單一干涉儀無法精確判斷重力波來源方向，多座相距數千公里的干涉儀以到達時間差、振幅比與相位比進行三角定位。KAGRA 在 2020 年 2 月開始首次觀測，同年 4 月與 GEO600 聯合觀測時中子星雙星靈敏距離約 1 Mpc；2023 年 5 月加入第四輪觀測 O4，2024 年 1 月能登半島地震後進行設施檢查與修復，2025 年 6 月與 LIGO、Virgo 協調恢復 O4，直到 2025 年 11 月 O4 完成。KAGRA 的方位與緯度不同，天線響應圖案與其他偵測器互補，即使靈敏距離較短，也能改善網路的定位與偏振量測。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「LIGO–Virgo–KAGRA 觀測網路」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A single interferometer cannot locate a gravitational-wave source precisely, so detectors thousands of kilometres apart triangulate using arrival-time differences, amplitude ratios and phase ratios. KAGRA began its first observing run in February 2020 and reached a binary-neutron-star range of about 1 Mpc during joint observation with GEO600 that April; it joined the fourth observing run O4 in May 2023, underwent facility inspection and repair after the January 2024 Noto Peninsula earthquake, resumed O4 in coordination with LIGO and Virgo in June 2025, and remained until O4 ended in November 2025. Its different orientation and latitude give an antenna pattern that complements the other detectors, improving network localisation and polarisation measurement even with a shorter range. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “LIGO–Virgo–KAGRA network”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：偵測體積 ∝ 靈敏距離³：由 1 Mpc 提升到 10 Mpc，體積增加 10³ = 1000 倍。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Detection volume scales as range³: going from 1 Mpc to 10 Mpc increases it 10³ = 1000 times.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「靈敏距離較短的偵測器對網路觀測沒有幫助。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A detector with a shorter range adds nothing to network observing." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「LIGO–Virgo–KAGRA 觀測網路」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “LIGO–Virgo–KAGRA network”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 網路觀測：靈敏距離、偵測體積與定位
knowledge.titleEn: Network observing: sensitive range, detection volume and localisation
knowledge.text: 單一干涉儀無法精確判斷重力波來源方向，多座相距數千公里的干涉儀以到達時間差、振幅比與相位比進行三角定位。KAGRA 在 2020 年 2 月開始首次觀測，同年 4 月與 GEO600 聯合觀測時中子星雙星靈敏距離約 1 Mpc；2023 年 5 月加入第四輪觀測 O4，2024 年 1 月能登半島地震後進行設施檢查與修復，2025 年 6 月與 LIGO、Virgo 協調恢復 O4，直到 2025 年 11 月 O4 完成。
knowledge.textEn: A single interferometer cannot locate a gravitational-wave source precisely, so detectors thousands of kilometres apart triangulate using arrival-time differences, amplitude ratios and phase ratios. KAGRA began its first observing run in February 2020 and reached a binary-neutron-star range of about 1 Mpc during joint observation with GEO600 that April; it joined the fourth observing run O4 in May 2023, underwent facility inspection and repair after the January 2024 Noto Peninsula earthquake, resumed O4 in coordination with LIGO and Virgo in June 2025, and remained until O4 ended in November 2025.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：靈敏距離較短的偵測器對網路觀測沒有幫助。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A detector with a shorter range adds nothing to network observing. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「網路觀測：靈敏距離、偵測體積與定位」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Network observing: sensitive range, detection volume and localisation" is correct?
options: 靈敏距離較短的偵測器對網路觀測沒有幫助。
單一干涉儀無法精確判斷重力波來源方向，多座相距數千公里的干涉儀以到達時間差、振幅比與相位比進行三角定位。
高真空中的低溫鏡面不會被任何氣體污染。
optionsEn: A detector with a shorter range adds nothing to network observing.
A single interferometer cannot locate a gravitational-wave source precisely, so detectors thousands of kilometres apart triangulate using arrival-time differences, amplitude ratios and phase ratios.
A cryogenic mirror in high vacuum cannot be contaminated by any gas.
quiz.explanation: 單一干涉儀無法精確判斷重力波來源方向，多座相距數千公里的干涉儀以到達時間差、振幅比與相位比進行三角定位。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A single interferometer cannot locate a gravitational-wave source precisely, so detectors thousands of kilometres apart triangulate using arrival-time differences, amplitude ratios and phase ratios. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 網路觀測：靈敏距離、偵測體積與定位：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Network observing: sensitive range, detection volume and localisation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「LIGO–Virgo–KAGRA 觀測網路」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “LIGO–Virgo–KAGRA network” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：偵測體積 ∝ 靈敏距離³：由 1 Mpc 提升到 10 Mpc，體積增加 10³ = 1000 倍。若另一偵測器的距離為 160 Mpc（假設），10 Mpc 的 KAGRA 偵測體積只有 (10/160)³ ≈ 2.4×10⁻⁴，所以 KAGRA 早期的主要貢獻是為其他偵測器觸發的事件提供額外基線，而非獨立發現事件。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Detection volume scales as range³: going from 1 Mpc to 10 Mpc increases it 10³ = 1000 times. If another detector has a 160 Mpc range (assumption), a 10 Mpc KAGRA covers only (10/160)³ ≈ 2.4×10⁻⁴ of its volume, so KAGRA's early contribution is an extra baseline for events triggered by other detectors rather than independent discoveries. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以光子校正器（1047 nm 雷射推動測試質量）產生已知位移，建立應變校正與時間戳準確度；以 GPS 同步的時間系統比對各站資料，並以網路分析中注入的模擬訊號檢查定位面積隨 KAGRA 加入與否的變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Generate known displacements with the photon calibrator, a 1047 nm laser pushing the test mass, to establish strain calibration and timestamp accuracy; compare data across sites with GPS-synchronised timing, and check how localisation area changes with and without KAGRA using simulated signals injected into network analysis.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 偵測體積 ∝ 靈敏距離³：由 1 Mpc 提升到 10 Mpc，體積增加 10³ = 1000 倍。若另一偵測器的距離為 160 Mpc（假設），10 Mpc 的 KAGRA 偵測體積只有 (10/160)³ ≈ 2.4×10⁻⁴，所以 KAGRA 早期的主要貢獻是為其他偵測器觸發的事件提供額外基線，而非獨立發現事件。
knowledge.textEn: Detection volume scales as range³: going from 1 Mpc to 10 Mpc increases it 10³ = 1000 times. If another detector has a 160 Mpc range (assumption), a 10 Mpc KAGRA covers only (10/160)³ ≈ 2.4×10⁻⁴ of its volume, so KAGRA's early contribution is an extra baseline for events triggered by other detectors rather than independent discoveries.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「網路觀測：靈敏距離、偵測體積與定位」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Network observing: sensitive range, detection volume and localisation", which statement holds?
options: 臂腔精細度越高，干涉儀在所有頻率都越靈敏。
鏡面在真空中冷卻，只要冷凍機功率夠大就能維持低溫。
偵測體積 ∝ 靈敏距離³：由 1 Mpc 提升到 10 Mpc，體積增加 10³ = 1000 倍。
optionsEn: Higher arm finesse makes the interferometer more sensitive at every frequency.
A mirror in vacuum stays cold as long as the cryocoolers are powerful enough.
Detection volume scales as range³: going from 1 Mpc to 10 Mpc increases it 10³ = 1000 times.
quiz.explanation: 偵測體積 ∝ 靈敏距離³：由 1 Mpc 提升到 10 Mpc，體積增加 10³ = 1000 倍。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Detection volume scales as range³: going from 1 Mpc to 10 Mpc increases it 10³ = 1000 times. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 網路觀測：靈敏距離、偵測體積與定位：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Network observing: sensitive range, detection volume and localisation: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「LIGO–Virgo–KAGRA 觀測網路」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “LIGO–Virgo–KAGRA network” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以光子校正器（1047 nm 雷射推動測試質量）產生已知位移，建立應變校正與時間戳準確度；以 GPS 同步的時間系統比對各站資料，並以網路分析中注入的模擬訊號檢查定位面積隨 KAGRA 加入與否的變化。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Generate known displacements with the photon calibrator, a 1047 nm laser pushing the test mass, to establish strain calibration and timestamp accuracy; compare data across sites with GPS-synchronised timing, and check how localisation area changes with and without KAGRA using simulated signals injected into network analysis. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若時間戳或校正相位有毫秒級或數度的系統誤差，KAGRA 的資料在三角定位中會把天區推向錯誤位置，反而降低網路定位品質；觀測期間若鎖定時間比例低，網路中同時運轉的偵測器組合減少。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A millisecond timestamp error or a few degrees of calibration phase error makes KAGRA data push the sky location to the wrong place in triangulation, degrading rather than improving network localisation; a low lock duty factor during a run reduces the number of times all detectors observe together.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以光子校正器（1047 nm 雷射推動測試質量）產生已知位移，建立應變校正與時間戳準確度；以 GPS 同步的時間系統比對各站資料，並以網路分析中注入的模擬訊號檢查定位面積隨 KAGRA 加入與否的變化。
knowledge.textEn: Generate known displacements with the photon calibrator, a 1047 nm laser pushing the test mass, to establish strain calibration and timestamp accuracy; compare data across sites with GPS-synchronised timing, and check how localisation area changes with and without KAGRA using simulated signals injected into network analysis.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「網路觀測：靈敏距離、偵測體積與定位」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Network observing: sensitive range, detection volume and localisation"?
options: 以光子校正器（1047 nm 雷射推動測試質量）產生已知位移，建立應變校正與時間戳準確度。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
低溫干涉儀和室溫干涉儀一樣，提高雷射功率就一定提升靈敏度。
optionsEn: Generate known displacements with the photon calibrator, a 1047 nm laser pushing the test mass, to establish strain calibration and timestamp accuracy.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Like a room-temperature detector, a cryogenic interferometer always gains sensitivity from more laser power.
quiz.explanation: 以光子校正器（1047 nm 雷射推動測試質量）產生已知位移，建立應變校正與時間戳準確度；以 GPS 同步的時間系統比對各站資料，並以網路分析中注入的模擬訊號檢查定位面積隨 KAGRA 加入與否的變化。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Generate known displacements with the photon calibrator, a 1047 nm laser pushing the test mass, to establish strain calibration and timestamp accuracy; compare data across sites with GPS-synchronised timing, and check how localisation area changes with and without KAGRA using simulated signals injected into network analysis. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 網路觀測：靈敏距離、偵測體積與定位：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Network observing: sensitive range, detection volume and localisation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「LIGO–Virgo–KAGRA 觀測網路」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “LIGO–Virgo–KAGRA network” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若時間戳或校正相位有毫秒級或數度的系統誤差，KAGRA 的資料在三角定位中會把天區推向錯誤位置，反而降低網路定位品質；觀測期間若鎖定時間比例低，網路中同時運轉的偵測器組合減少。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A millisecond timestamp error or a few degrees of calibration phase error makes KAGRA data push the sky location to the wrong place in triangulation, degrading rather than improving network localisation; a low lock duty factor during a run reduces the number of times all detectors observe together. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：KAGRA 的方位與緯度不同，天線響應圖案與其他偵測器互補，即使靈敏距離較短，也能改善網路的定位與偏振量測。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Its different orientation and latitude give an antenna pattern that complements the other detectors, improving network localisation and polarisation measurement even with a shorter range.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「靈敏距離較短的偵測器對網路觀測沒有幫助。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A detector with a shorter range adds nothing to network observing." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若時間戳或校正相位有毫秒級或數度的系統誤差，KAGRA 的資料在三角定位中會把天區推向錯誤位置，反而降低網路定位品質；觀測期間若鎖定時間比例低，網路中同時運轉的偵測器組合減少。
knowledge.textEn: A millisecond timestamp error or a few degrees of calibration phase error makes KAGRA data push the sky location to the wrong place in triangulation, degrading rather than improving network localisation; a low lock duty factor during a run reduces the number of times all detectors observe together.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「網路觀測：靈敏距離、偵測體積與定位」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Network observing: sensitive range, detection volume and localisation" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
若時間戳或校正相位有毫秒級或數度的系統誤差，KAGRA 的資料在三角定位中會把天區推向錯誤位置，反而降低網路定位品質。
高真空中的低溫鏡面不會被任何氣體污染。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.

A cryogenic mirror in high vacuum cannot be contaminated by any gas.

steps.title: 地下低溫營運：冷凝污染、地震恢復與交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Underground cryogenic operation: cryo-contamination, earthquake recovery and handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「冷鏡面分子吸附與回溫」如何決定KAGRA 地底低溫重力波望遠鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cold-mirror adsorption and warm-up” determines the key performance of “KAGRA underground cryogenic gravitational-wave telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 低溫鏡面本身就是一個冷凝泵：真空中殘留的水分子一碰到 20 K 的鏡面就會吸附，逐漸形成分子層，改變鍍膜的反射率並增加吸收與散射。KAGRA 以長導管屏蔽限制殘氣進入的立體角，但吸附無法完全避免，必要時需回溫讓分子脫附，而每次回溫與再冷卻都要數週時間。地下設施另有地下水、濕度與地震等風險，2024 年能登半島地震後就需要逐項檢查懸吊、真空與光學對準。交接紀錄應包含各鏡面溫度歷史、精細度與回收增益趨勢、冷凍機與真空狀態，以及每次回溫的原因與結果。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「冷鏡面分子吸附與回溫」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A cryogenic mirror is itself a cryopump: residual water molecules in the vacuum that strike the 20 K surface stick and slowly build a molecular layer that changes coating reflectance and adds absorption and scatter. KAGRA uses long duct shields to restrict the solid angle through which residual gas can arrive, but adsorption cannot be avoided completely, so the mirrors must sometimes be warmed to desorb the layer, and every warm-up and re-cooling takes weeks. The underground facility also faces groundwater, humidity and earthquakes; after the 2024 Noto Peninsula earthquake, suspensions, vacuum and optical alignment all had to be checked item by item. The handoff record should hold each mirror's temperature history, finesse and recycling-gain trends, cryocooler and vacuum status, and the reason and outcome of every warm-up. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Cold-mirror adsorption and warm-up”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The water impingement rate is Φ = P/√(2πmkT): for P = 1×10⁻⁷ Pa, T = 300 K and m = 18 u, Φ ≈ 3.6×10¹⁵ m⁻²s⁻¹.

steps.title: 地下低溫營運：冷凝污染、地震恢復與交接：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「冷鏡面分子吸附與回溫」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cold-mirror adsorption and warm-up” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：水分子撞擊率 Φ = P/√(2πmkT)：P = 1×10⁻⁷ Pa、T = 300 K、m = 18 u 時 Φ ≈ 3.6×10¹⁵ m⁻²s⁻¹。以冰密度 930 kg/m³ 換算，無遮蔽時成長約 1.2×10⁻¹³ m/s ≈ 10 nm/天；導管屏蔽若把可見立體角降為 10⁻³（假設），約 3.6 nm/年。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The water impingement rate is Φ = P/√(2πmkT): for P = 1×10⁻⁷ Pa, T = 300 K and m = 18 u, Φ ≈ 3.6×10¹⁵ m⁻²s⁻¹. Converting with an ice density of 930 kg/m³, an unshielded mirror grows a layer at about 1.2×10⁻¹³ m/s ≈ 10 nm per day; duct shields that cut the visible solid angle to 10⁻³ (assumption) bring it to about 3.6 nm per year. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以殘氣分析儀監測各真空段的水分壓；定期量測臂腔精細度與鏡面反射率的變化趨勢，並以鏡面散射光相機追蹤散射增加；回溫後重測精細度，確認損耗是否回到基準，以此區分可逆的分子吸附與不可逆的鍍膜損傷。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Monitor water partial pressure in each vacuum section with residual-gas analysers; track trends of arm finesse and mirror reflectance periodically and follow scatter growth with mirror-scatter cameras; after a warm-up remeasure finesse to see whether losses return to baseline, separating reversible adsorption from irreversible coating damage.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 地下低溫營運：冷凝污染、地震恢復與交接：量測與驗證

steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

quiz.question: 在「地下低溫營運：冷凝污染、地震恢復與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

quiz.explanation: 若冷卻前真空烘烤不足或導管屏蔽溫度過高，分子層在數週內就讓精細度明顯下降，被誤判為鍍膜劣化而考慮更換鏡面；地震後若只檢查真空而未重新量測懸吊共振頻率與對準，偵測器會帶著隱藏的摩擦或碰觸問題重新加入觀測。 需以量測區分可能原因。

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: HI 星系偵測練習：在 ζ = 20° 追蹤一個 50 Mpc 外的星系，A_e = 0.63 × π × 150² = 44 532 m²，G = 16.1 K/Jy，T_sys = 24 K，SEFD = 1.49 Jy。通道寬 7.63 kHz 在 1420.4 MHz 相當 1.61 km/s；雙偏振積分 600 s，σ = 1.49/√(2 × 7630 × 600) ≈ 0.49 mJy。200 km/s 的譜線涵蓋 124 個通道，積分流量雜訊 0.49 × 1.61 × √124 ≈ 8.8 mJy·km/s，5σ 門檻 0.044 Jy·km/s，對應 M_HI = 2.36×10⁵ × 50² × 0.044 ≈ 2.6×10⁷ 太陽質量。若同一目標只能在 ζ = 40° 觀測，幾何面積比 0.80 使 G 降到 12.9 K/Jy，溢出讓 T_sys 升到 28 K，SEFD 變 2.17 Jy，達到相同 σ 需要 (2.17/1.49)² ≈ 2.1 倍時間，約 1280 s。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。
workedExample.textEn: HI galaxy detection exercise: track a galaxy at 50 Mpc at ζ = 20°, with A_e = 0.63 × π × 150² = 44 532 m², G = 16.1 K/Jy, T_sys = 24 K and SEFD = 1.49 Jy. A 7.63 kHz channel at 1420.4 MHz is 1.61 km/s; integrating 600 s in two polarisations gives σ = 1.49/√(2 × 7630 × 600) ≈ 0.49 mJy. A 200 km/s line spans 124 channels, so the integrated-flux noise is 0.49 × 1.61 × √124 ≈ 8.8 mJy·km/s and the 5σ threshold is 0.044 Jy·km/s, corresponding to M_HI = 2.36×10⁵ × 50² × 0.044 ≈ 2.6×10⁷ solar masses. If the same target can only be observed at ζ = 40°, the geometric area fraction 0.80 lowers G to 12.9 K/Jy, spillover raises T_sys to 28 K and SEFD becomes 2.17 Jy, so reaching the same σ takes (2.17/1.49)² ≈ 2.1 times longer, about 1280 s. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「球面球差與主動拋物面成形」與「天頂角極限與有效接收面積」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Spherical aberration and active paraboloid forming" and "Zenith-angle limit and effective collecting area": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 球面球差與主動拋物面成形：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Spherical aberration and active paraboloid forming: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「500 m 球面與 300 m 照明口徑」如何決定FAST 五百公尺口徑球面電波望遠鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “500 m sphere and 300 m illuminated aperture” determines the key performance of “FAST Five-hundred-meter Aperture Spherical Telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: FAST 的反射面是半徑 R = 300 m、口徑 500 m 的球冠，安置在貴州平塘大窩凼的喀斯特窪地中。球面沒有特定光軸，只要移動饋源就能指向不同方向，但球面有球差：不同高度入射的平行光在軸上交於不同位置，單點饋源無法同相收集。Arecibo 用線饋源與格里高利副鏡修正；FAST 則用索網節點下方的促動器，把以源方向為軸、直徑 300 m 的一塊球面即時拉成 f/D = 0.4665 的拋物面，追蹤時讓這塊拋物面在球面上「移動」，饋源艙則沿焦面跟隨，其餘部分保持球面。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「500 m 球面與 300 m 照明口徑」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: FAST's reflector is a spherical cap of radius R = 300 m and aperture 500 m set into the Dawodang karst depression in Pingtang, Guizhou. A sphere has no preferred axis, so pointing only requires moving the feed, but it suffers spherical aberration: parallel rays at different heights cross the axis at different points and a point feed cannot collect them in phase. Arecibo corrected this with line feeds and a Gregorian subreflector; FAST instead uses actuators under the cable-net nodes to pull a 300 m-diameter patch, centred on the source direction, into a paraboloid with f/D = 0.4665, and tracks by moving that paraboloid across the sphere while the feed cabin follows along the focal surface and the rest of the dish stays spherical. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “500 m sphere and 300 m illuminated aperture”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：球差估算：近軸焦點在頂點上方 R/2 = 150 m；r = 150 m 的邊緣光（入射角 θ = 30°）交軸於距球心 R/(2cosθ) = 173.2 m，即頂點上方 126.8 m，縱向球差 23.2 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Aberration estimate: the paraxial focus is R/2 = 150 m above the vertex; the marginal ray at r = 150 m (incidence θ = 30°) crosses the axis R/(2cosθ) = 173.2 m from the centre, 126.8 m above the vertex, a longitudinal spherical aberration of 23.2 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「FAST 觀測時會把整個 500 m 反射面變成一個拋物面。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "FAST deforms its whole 500 m dish into a single paraboloid when observing." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「500 m 球面與 300 m 照明口徑」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “500 m sphere and 300 m illuminated aperture”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 球面球差與主動拋物面成形：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Spherical aberration and active paraboloid forming: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「500 m 球面與 300 m 照明口徑」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “500 m sphere and 300 m illuminated aperture” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：球差估算：近軸焦點在頂點上方 R/2 = 150 m；r = 150 m 的邊緣光（入射角 θ = 30°）交軸於距球心 R/(2cosθ) = 173.2 m，即頂點上方 126.8 m，縱向球差 23.2 m。拋物面焦距 F = 0.4665 × 300 = 139.95 m；若令拋物面在 r = 150 m 處與球面重合（兩者矢高都是 40.19 m），最大軸向偏離 0.72 m 出現在 r ≈ 106 m，換成法向約 0.72 × cos20.7° ≈ 0.67 m，促動器行程必須涵蓋此值再加裕度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Aberration estimate: the paraxial focus is R/2 = 150 m above the vertex; the marginal ray at r = 150 m (incidence θ = 30°) crosses the axis R/(2cosθ) = 173.2 m from the centre, 126.8 m above the vertex, a longitudinal spherical aberration of 23.2 m. The paraboloid focal length is F = 0.4665 × 300 = 139.95 m; if it meets the sphere at r = 150 m (both sags 40.19 m), the largest axial departure is 0.72 m at r ≈ 106 m, about 0.72 × cos20.7° ≈ 0.67 m along the normal, which the actuator stroke must cover with margin. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以球心座標系計算目標拋物面對球面的偏離圖，核對下達給各節點的位移指令峰值約 0.67 m 且不超過促動器行程；成形後用全站儀量所有節點，對殘差擬合拋物面的頂點、焦點與軸向，確認擬合焦距接近 139.95 m、焦點與饋源艙位置一致；最後對強校準源做饋源軸向掃焦，增益最大值應落在幾何焦點附近。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compute the departure map of the target paraboloid from the sphere in sphere-centred coordinates and check that the commanded node displacements peak near 0.67 m within actuator stroke; after forming, survey every node with total stations and fit vertex, focus and axis to the residuals, confirming a fitted focal length near 139.95 m and a focus coincident with the feed cabin; finally run an axial focus scan of the feed on a strong calibrator, whose gain maximum should fall near the geometric focus.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 球面球差與主動拋物面成形：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Spherical aberration and active paraboloid forming: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「500 m 球面與 300 m 照明口徑」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “500 m sphere and 300 m illuminated aperture” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以球心座標系計算目標拋物面對球面的偏離圖，核對下達給各節點的位移指令峰值約 0.67 m 且不超過促動器行程；成形後用全站儀量所有節點，對殘差擬合拋物面的頂點、焦點與軸向，確認擬合焦距接近 139.95 m、焦點與饋源艙位置一致；最後對強校準源做饋源軸向掃焦，增益最大值應落在幾何焦點附近。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compute the departure map of the target paraboloid from the sphere in sphere-centred coordinates and check that the commanded node displacements peak near 0.67 m within actuator stroke; after forming, survey every node with total stations and fit vertex, focus and axis to the residuals, confirming a fitted focal length near 139.95 m and a focus coincident with the feed cabin; finally run an axial focus scan of the feed on a strong calibrator, whose gain maximum should fall near the geometric focus. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若焦距參數或拋物面軸向與源方向不同步，饋源不在真正焦點，主波束變寬、旁瓣升高、增益下降；若某區促動器在 0.67 m 峰值處飽和，會留下一圈仍是球面的環帶，形成環狀相位誤差，波束圖出現不對稱的彗形旁瓣。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the focal-length parameter or paraboloid axis falls out of step with the source direction, the feed is not at the true focus, so the main beam broadens, sidelobes rise and gain drops; if actuators saturate near the 0.67 m peak zone, a ring of residual sphere remains, producing an annular phase error and asymmetric coma-like sidelobes in the beam map.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.
