knowledge.text: 以球心座標系計算目標拋物面對球面的偏離圖，核對下達給各節點的位移指令峰值約 0.67 m 且不超過促動器行程；成形後用全站儀量所有節點，對殘差擬合拋物面的頂點、焦點與軸向，確認擬合焦距接近 139.95 m、焦點與饋源艙位置一致；最後對強校準源做饋源軸向掃焦，增益最大值應落在幾何焦點附近。
knowledge.textEn: Compute the departure map of the target paraboloid from the sphere in sphere-centred coordinates and check that the commanded node displacements peak near 0.67 m within actuator stroke; after forming, survey every node with total stations and fit vertex, focus and axis to the residuals, confirming a fitted focal length near 139.95 m and a focus coincident with the feed cabin; finally run an axial focus scan of the feed on a strong calibrator, whose gain maximum should fall near the geometric focus.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「球面球差與主動拋物面成形」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Spherical aberration and active paraboloid forming"?
options: 以球心座標系計算目標拋物面對球面的偏離圖，核對下達給各節點的位移指令峰值約 0.67 m 且不超過促動器行程。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
頻譜基線漣波只來自接收機電子，與望遠鏡幾何無關。
optionsEn: Compute the departure map of the target paraboloid from the sphere in sphere-centred coordinates and check that the commanded node displacements peak near 0.67 m within actuator stroke.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Spectral baseline ripple comes only from receiver electronics, not telescope geometry.
quiz.explanation: 以球心座標系計算目標拋物面對球面的偏離圖，核對下達給各節點的位移指令峰值約 0.67 m 且不超過促動器行程；成形後用全站儀量所有節點，對殘差擬合拋物面的頂點、焦點與軸向，確認擬合焦距接近 139.95 m、焦點與饋源艙位置一致；最後對強校準源做饋源軸向掃焦，增益最大值應落在幾何焦點附近。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compute the departure map of the target paraboloid from the sphere in sphere-centred coordinates and check that the commanded node displacements peak near 0.67 m within actuator stroke; after forming, survey every node with total stations and fit vertex, focus and axis to the residuals, confirming a fitted focal length near 139.95 m and a focus coincident with the feed cabin; finally run an axial focus scan of the feed on a strong calibrator, whose gain maximum should fall near the geometric focus. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 球面球差與主動拋物面成形：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Spherical aberration and active paraboloid forming: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「500 m 球面與 300 m 照明口徑」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “500 m sphere and 300 m illuminated aperture” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若焦距參數或拋物面軸向與源方向不同步，饋源不在真正焦點，主波束變寬、旁瓣升高、增益下降；若某區促動器在 0.67 m 峰值處飽和，會留下一圈仍是球面的環帶，形成環狀相位誤差，波束圖出現不對稱的彗形旁瓣。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the focal-length parameter or paraboloid axis falls out of step with the source direction, the feed is not at the true focus, so the main beam broadens, sidelobes rise and gain drops; if actuators saturate near the 0.67 m peak zone, a ring of residual sphere remains, producing an annular phase error and asymmetric coma-like sidelobes in the beam map. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：Arecibo 用線饋源與格里高利副鏡修正；FAST 則用索網節點下方的促動器，把以源方向為軸、直徑 300 m 的一塊球面即時拉成 f/D = 0.4665 的拋物面，追蹤時讓這塊拋物面在球面上「移動」，饋源艙則沿焦面跟隨，其餘部分保持球面。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Arecibo corrected this with line feeds and a Gregorian subreflector; FAST instead uses actuators under the cable-net nodes to pull a 300 m-diameter patch, centred on the source direction, into a paraboloid with f/D = 0.4665, and tracks by moving that paraboloid across the sphere while the feed cabin follows along the focal surface and the rest of the dish stays spherical.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「FAST 觀測時會把整個 500 m 反射面變成一個拋物面。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "FAST deforms its whole 500 m dish into a single paraboloid when observing." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若焦距參數或拋物面軸向與源方向不同步，饋源不在真正焦點，主波束變寬、旁瓣升高、增益下降；若某區促動器在 0.67 m 峰值處飽和，會留下一圈仍是球面的環帶，形成環狀相位誤差，波束圖出現不對稱的彗形旁瓣。
knowledge.textEn: If the focal-length parameter or paraboloid axis falls out of step with the source direction, the feed is not at the true focus, so the main beam broadens, sidelobes rise and gain drops; if actuators saturate near the 0.67 m peak zone, a ring of residual sphere remains, producing an annular phase error and asymmetric coma-like sidelobes in the beam map.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「球面球差與主動拋物面成形」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Spherical aberration and active paraboloid forming" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
若焦距參數或拋物面軸向與源方向不同步，饋源不在真正焦點，主波束變寬、旁瓣升高、增益下降。
FAST 反射面固定不動，所以增益與天頂角無關。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
If the focal-length parameter or paraboloid axis falls out of step with the source direction, the feed is not at the true focus, so the main beam broadens, sidelobes rise and gain drops.
Because FAST's dish never moves, its gain does not depend on zenith angle.
quiz.explanation: 若焦距參數或拋物面軸向與源方向不同步，饋源不在真正焦點，主波束變寬、旁瓣升高、增益下降；若某區促動器在 0.67 m 峰值處飽和，會留下一圈仍是球面的環帶，形成環狀相位誤差，波束圖出現不對稱的彗形旁瓣。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the focal-length parameter or paraboloid axis falls out of step with the source direction, the feed is not at the true focus, so the main beam broadens, sidelobes rise and gain drops; if actuators saturate near the 0.67 m peak zone, a ring of residual sphere remains, producing an annular phase error and asymmetric coma-like sidelobes in the beam map. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 天頂角極限與有效接收面積：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Zenith-angle limit and effective collecting area: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「天頂角與照明區位置」如何決定FAST 五百公尺口徑球面電波望遠鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Zenith angle and illuminated patch” determines the key performance of “FAST Five-hundred-meter Aperture Spherical Telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 從球心看，300 m 照明口徑對應距波束軸 30° 以內的球冠，而 500 m 邊緣位於距鉛垂 56.4° 處（張角 112.9°）。源在天上移動時，照明區在球面上遊走；只要天頂角 ζ ≤ 56.4° − 30° = 26.4°，整個 300 m 口徑都留在反射面上。超過此角度，部分照明口徑落到邊緣之外，饋源開始看見地面，有效面積下降、溢出雜訊使系統溫度上升。設計上限 ζ = 40°，配合約 25.6°N 的緯度，可觀測赤緯約 −14° 到 +66°。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「天頂角與照明區位置」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Seen from the sphere centre, the 300 m illuminated aperture is the cap within 30° of the beam axis, while the 500 m rim lies 56.4° from the vertical, an opening angle of 112.9°. As a source moves the illuminated patch walks across the sphere, and as long as the zenith angle ζ ≤ 56.4° − 30° = 26.4° the full 300 m aperture stays on the reflector. Beyond that part of the illuminated aperture falls off the rim, the feed begins to see the ground, effective area drops and spillover noise raises the system temperature. The design limit is ζ = 40°, which at about 25.6°N latitude gives declinations from about −14° to +66°. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Zenith angle and illuminated patch”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For ζ ≤ 26.4°, A_e = η·π(150 m)² = 0.63 × 70 686 = 44 532 m², gain G = A_e/(2k) ≈ 16.1 K/Jy and SEFD = T_sys/G = 24/16.1 ≈ 1.49 Jy.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「FAST 反射面固定不動，所以增益與天頂角無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Because FAST's dish never moves, its gain does not depend on zenith angle." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「天頂角與照明區位置」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Zenith angle and illuminated patch”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 天頂角極限與有效接收面積
knowledge.titleEn: Zenith-angle limit and effective collecting area
knowledge.text: 從球心看，300 m 照明口徑對應距波束軸 30° 以內的球冠，而 500 m 邊緣位於距鉛垂 56.4° 處（張角 112.9°）。源在天上移動時，照明區在球面上遊走；只要天頂角 ζ ≤ 56.4° − 30° = 26.4°，整個 300 m 口徑都留在反射面上。
knowledge.textEn: Seen from the sphere centre, the 300 m illuminated aperture is the cap within 30° of the beam axis, while the 500 m rim lies 56.4° from the vertical, an opening angle of 112.9°. As a source moves the illuminated patch walks across the sphere, and as long as the zenith angle ζ ≤ 56.4° − 30° = 26.4° the full 300 m aperture stays on the reflector.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：FAST 反射面固定不動，所以增益與天頂角無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Because FAST's dish never moves, its gain does not depend on zenith angle. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「天頂角極限與有效接收面積」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Zenith-angle limit and effective collecting area" is correct?
options: FAST 反射面固定不動，所以增益與天頂角無關。
索網只承受靜態重量，不必考慮疲勞壽命。
從球心看，300 m 照明口徑對應距波束軸 30° 以內的球冠，而 500 m 邊緣位於距鉛垂 56.4° 處（張角 112.9°）。
optionsEn: Because FAST's dish never moves, its gain does not depend on zenith angle.
The cable net carries only static weight, so fatigue life can be ignored.
Seen from the sphere centre, the 300 m illuminated aperture is the cap within 30° of the beam axis, while the 500 m rim lies 56.4° from the vertical, an opening angle of 112.9°.
quiz.explanation: 從球心看，300 m 照明口徑對應距波束軸 30° 以內的球冠，而 500 m 邊緣位於距鉛垂 56.4° 處（張角 112.9°）。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Seen from the sphere centre, the 300 m illuminated aperture is the cap within 30° of the beam axis, while the 500 m rim lies 56.4° from the vertical, an opening angle of 112.9°. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 天頂角極限與有效接收面積：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Zenith-angle limit and effective collecting area: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「天頂角與照明區位置」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Zenith angle and illuminated patch” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：ζ ≤ 26.4° 時，A_e = η·π(150 m)² = 0.63 × 70 686 = 44 532 m²，增益 G = A_e/(2k) ≈ 16.1 K/Jy，SEFD = T_sys/G = 24/16.1 ≈ 1.49 Jy。幾何估算 300 m 口徑仍留在反射面上的比例：ζ = 30° 為 0.97、35° 為 0.90、40° 為 0.80（均勻照明）；若以 −10 dB 邊緣錐度加權，40° 時約 0.89。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For ζ ≤ 26.4°, A_e = η·π(150 m)² = 0.63 × 70 686 = 44 532 m², gain G = A_e/(2k) ≈ 16.1 K/Jy and SEFD = T_sys/G = 24/16.1 ≈ 1.49 Jy. A geometric estimate of the fraction of the 300 m aperture still on the dish is 0.97 at ζ = 30°, 0.90 at 35° and 0.80 at 40° for uniform illumination, or about 0.89 at 40° when weighted by a −10 dB edge taper. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：建立增益曲線：在多個天頂角對 3C286 等流量已知的校準源做十字掃描，取峰值天線溫度除以目錄流量得到 K/Jy，畫出對 ζ 的曲線並確認轉折出現在 26.4° 附近；同一時間用雜訊二極體量各 ζ 的 T_sys，把面積下降與溢出升溫兩個效應分開記錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build the gain curve: cross-scan a calibrator of known flux such as 3C286 at several zenith angles, divide peak antenna temperature by catalogue flux to obtain K/Jy, plot against ζ and confirm the knee near 26.4°; at the same time measure T_sys with the noise diode at each ζ so that area loss and spillover heating are recorded separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: For ζ ≤ 26.4°, A_e = η·π(150 m)² = 0.63 × 70 686 = 44 532 m², gain G = A_e/(2k) ≈ 16.1 K/Jy and SEFD = T_sys/G = 24/16.1 ≈ 1.49 Jy. A geometric estimate of the fraction of the 300 m aperture still on the dish is 0.97 at ζ = 30°, 0.90 at 35° and 0.80 at 40° for uniform illumination, or about 0.89 at 40° when weighted by a −10 dB edge taper.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「天頂角極限與有效接收面積」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Zenith-angle limit and effective collecting area", which statement holds?
options: 5 mm 的面形精度在 500 MHz 與 3 GHz 一樣好。
頻譜基線漣波只來自接收機電子，與望遠鏡幾何無關。
optionsEn: A 5 mm surface performs equally well at 500 MHz and 3 GHz.
Spectral baseline ripple comes only from receiver electronics, not telescope geometry.
quiz.explanationEn: For ζ ≤ 26.4°, A_e = η·π(150 m)² = 0.63 × 70 686 = 44 532 m², gain G = A_e/(2k) ≈ 16.1 K/Jy and SEFD = T_sys/G = 24/16.1 ≈ 1.49 Jy. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 天頂角極限與有效接收面積：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Zenith-angle limit and effective collecting area: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「天頂角與照明區位置」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Zenith angle and illuminated patch” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 建立增益曲線：在多個天頂角對 3C286 等流量已知的校準源做十字掃描，取峰值天線溫度除以目錄流量得到 K/Jy，畫出對 ζ 的曲線並確認轉折出現在 26.4° 附近；同一時間用雜訊二極體量各 ζ 的 T_sys，把面積下降與溢出升溫兩個效應分開記錄。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build the gain curve: cross-scan a calibrator of known flux such as 3C286 at several zenith angles, divide peak antenna temperature by catalogue flux to obtain K/Jy, plot against ζ and confirm the knee near 26.4°; at the same time measure T_sys with the noise diode at each ζ so that area loss and spillover heating are recorded separately. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：對 ζ = 35° 到 40° 的觀測仍套用天頂增益，流量密度與 HI 質量會被低估 10% 到 20%；長時間追蹤跨越 26.4° 時，源看起來在「變亮變暗」，其實只是幾何遮蔽造成的假變光。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Applying the zenith gain to observations at ζ = 35° to 40° underestimates flux densities and HI masses by 10% to 20%; long tracks crossing 26.4° show a source apparently brightening and fading when the variation is purely geometric vignetting.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 建立增益曲線：在多個天頂角對 3C286 等流量已知的校準源做十字掃描，取峰值天線溫度除以目錄流量得到 K/Jy，畫出對 ζ 的曲線並確認轉折出現在 26.4° 附近；同一時間用雜訊二極體量各 ζ 的 T_sys，把面積下降與溢出升溫兩個效應分開記錄。
knowledge.textEn: Build the gain curve: cross-scan a calibrator of known flux such as 3C286 at several zenith angles, divide peak antenna temperature by catalogue flux to obtain K/Jy, plot against ζ and confirm the knee near 26.4°; at the same time measure T_sys with the noise diode at each ζ so that area loss and spillover heating are recorded separately.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「天頂角極限與有效接收面積」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Zenith-angle limit and effective collecting area"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。
建立增益曲線：在多個天頂角對 3C286 等流量已知的校準源做十字掃描，取峰值天線溫度除以目錄流量得到 K/Jy，畫出對 ζ 的曲線並確認轉折出現在 26.4° 附近。
電波寧靜區可以擋掉所有干擾，包括衛星訊號。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.

Build the gain curve: cross-scan a calibrator of known flux such as 3C286 at several zenith angles, divide peak antenna temperature by catalogue flux to obtain K/Jy, plot against ζ and confirm the knee near 26.4°.
A radio quiet zone blocks all interference, satellite signals included.
quiz.explanation: 建立增益曲線：在多個天頂角對 3C286 等流量已知的校準源做十字掃描，取峰值天線溫度除以目錄流量得到 K/Jy，畫出對 ζ 的曲線並確認轉折出現在 26.4° 附近；同一時間用雜訊二極體量各 ζ 的 T_sys，把面積下降與溢出升溫兩個效應分開記錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Build the gain curve: cross-scan a calibrator of known flux such as 3C286 at several zenith angles, divide peak antenna temperature by catalogue flux to obtain K/Jy, plot against ζ and confirm the knee near 26.4°; at the same time measure T_sys with the noise diode at each ζ so that area loss and spillover heating are recorded separately. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 天頂角極限與有效接收面積：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Zenith-angle limit and effective collecting area: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「天頂角與照明區位置」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Zenith angle and illuminated patch” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 對 ζ = 35° 到 40° 的觀測仍套用天頂增益，流量密度與 HI 質量會被低估 10% 到 20%；長時間追蹤跨越 26.4° 時，源看起來在「變亮變暗」，其實只是幾何遮蔽造成的假變光。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Applying the zenith gain to observations at ζ = 35° to 40° underestimates flux densities and HI masses by 10% to 20%; long tracks crossing 26.4° show a source apparently brightening and fading when the variation is purely geometric vignetting. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：設計上限 ζ = 40°，配合約 25.6°N 的緯度，可觀測赤緯約 −14° 到 +66°。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The design limit is ζ = 40°, which at about 25.6°N latitude gives declinations from about −14° to +66°.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「FAST 反射面固定不動，所以增益與天頂角無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Because FAST's dish never moves, its gain does not depend on zenith angle." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 對 ζ = 35° 到 40° 的觀測仍套用天頂增益，流量密度與 HI 質量會被低估 10% 到 20%；長時間追蹤跨越 26.4° 時，源看起來在「變亮變暗」，其實只是幾何遮蔽造成的假變光。
knowledge.textEn: Applying the zenith gain to observations at ζ = 35° to 40° underestimates flux densities and HI masses by 10% to 20%; long tracks crossing 26.4° show a source apparently brightening and fading when the variation is purely geometric vignetting.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「天頂角極限與有效接收面積」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Zenith-angle limit and effective collecting area" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
索網只承受靜態重量，不必考慮疲勞壽命。
對 ζ = 35° 到 40° 的觀測仍套用天頂增益，流量密度與 HI 質量會被低估 10% 到 20%。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
The cable net carries only static weight, so fatigue life can be ignored.
Applying the zenith gain to observations at ζ = 35° to 40° underestimates flux densities and HI masses by 10% to 20%.
quiz.explanation: 對 ζ = 35° 到 40° 的觀測仍套用天頂增益，流量密度與 HI 質量會被低估 10% 到 20%；長時間追蹤跨越 26.4° 時，源看起來在「變亮變暗」，其實只是幾何遮蔽造成的假變光。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Applying the zenith gain to observations at ζ = 35° to 40° underestimates flux densities and HI masses by 10% to 20%; long tracks crossing 26.4° show a source apparently brightening and fading when the variation is purely geometric vignetting. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 元件、材料與製造
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「面板、索網與抗疲勞鋼索」與「索驅饋源艙的粗精兩級定位」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Panels, cable net and fatigue-resistant cables" and "Two-stage positioning of the cable-driven feed cabin": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 面板、索網與抗疲勞鋼索：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Panels, cable net and fatigue-resistant cables: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「三角面板、索網節點與促動器」如何決定FAST 五百公尺口徑球面電波望遠鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Triangular panels, cable-net nodes and actuators” determines the key performance of “FAST Five-hundred-meter Aperture Spherical Telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 反射面由約 4450 塊邊長約 11 m 的三角形穿孔鋁面板組成，鋪在約 6670 根主索構成的索網上，索網懸掛於 500 m 圈樑；約 2225 個節點各以下拉索連到地面促動器。面板做成半徑 318.5 m 的球面，是折衷值：拋物面的局部曲率半徑在頂點為 280 m，到邊緣弧矢方向約 318 m、子午方向約 409 m。每次換源都改變拋物面位置，索網反覆承受應力循環；公開資料指出 FAST 的鋼索需承受約 500 MPa 應力幅、兩百萬次循環，約為一般規範的兩倍，因此必須開發新的鋼絞線與錨固工藝。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「三角面板、索網節點與促動器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The surface consists of about 4450 triangular perforated aluminium panels roughly 11 m on a side, laid on a cable net of about 6670 main cables hung from a 500 m ring beam, and about 2225 nodes each tied by a down-tie cable to a ground actuator. Panels are spherical with radius 318.5 m as a compromise, because the paraboloid's local radius of curvature is 280 m at the vertex and about 318 m sagittally and 409 m meridionally at the edge. Every change of source moves the paraboloid, so the net sees repeated stress cycles; public reports state that FAST's cables had to survive about 500 MPa stress amplitude for two million cycles, roughly twice the usual code value, which required new steel-strand and anchorage technology. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Triangular panels, cable-net nodes and actuators”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：應力循環量級估算：球面上節點法向位移 δ 使面內長度改變約 δ/R，Δσ ≈ E·δ/R = 200 GPa × 0.47 m / 300 m ≈ 313 MPa；在 0.67 m 峰值處約 447 MPa，已接近 500 MPa 的疲勞要求。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Order-of-magnitude stress cycle: a normal node displacement δ on the sphere changes in-surface length by about δ/R, so Δσ ≈ E·δ/R = 200 GPa × 0.47 m / 300 m ≈ 313 MPa, and about 447 MPa at the 0.67 m peak, close to the 500 MPa fatigue requirement.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「索網只承受靜態重量，不必考慮疲勞壽命。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The cable net carries only static weight, so fatigue life can be ignored." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「三角面板、索網節點與促動器」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Triangular panels, cable-net nodes and actuators”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 面板、索網與抗疲勞鋼索
knowledge.titleEn: Panels, cable net and fatigue-resistant cables

Panels are spherical with radius 318.5 m as a compromise, because the paraboloid's local radius of curvature is 280 m at the vertex and about 318 m sagittally and 409 m meridionally at the edge.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The cable net carries only static weight, so fatigue life can be ignored. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「面板、索網與抗疲勞鋼索」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Panels, cable net and fatigue-resistant cables" is correct?
options: 反射面由約 4450 塊邊長約 11 m 的三角形穿孔鋁面板組成，鋪在約 6670 根主索構成的索網上，索網懸掛於 500 m 圈樑。
索網只承受靜態重量，不必考慮疲勞壽命。
只要控制六根鋼索長度，饋源艙就能直接達到毫米級定位。
optionsEn: The surface consists of about 4450 triangular perforated aluminium panels roughly 11 m on a side, laid on a cable net of about 6670 main cables hung from a 500 m ring beam, and about 2225 nodes each tied by a down-tie cable to a ground actuator.

Controlling the six cable lengths alone puts the feed cabin to millimetre accuracy.

quiz.explanationEn: The surface consists of about 4450 triangular perforated aluminium panels roughly 11 m on a side, laid on a cable net of about 6670 main cables hung from a 500 m ring beam, and about 2225 nodes each tied by a down-tie cable to a ground actuator. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 面板、索網與抗疲勞鋼索：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Panels, cable net and fatigue-resistant cables: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「三角面板、索網節點與促動器」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Triangular panels, cable-net nodes and actuators” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：應力循環量級估算：球面上節點法向位移 δ 使面內長度改變約 δ/R，Δσ ≈ E·δ/R = 200 GPa × 0.47 m / 300 m ≈ 313 MPa；在 0.67 m 峰值處約 447 MPa，已接近 500 MPa 的疲勞要求。面板曲率失配：外接圓半徑 6.35 m 的面板，在 318.5 m 球面上矢高 63.3 mm、在 280 m 上 72.0 mm，頂點附近峰值差 8.7 mm，最佳擬合後約 8.7/√12 ≈ 2.5 mm rms。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Order-of-magnitude stress cycle: a normal node displacement δ on the sphere changes in-surface length by about δ/R, so Δσ ≈ E·δ/R = 200 GPa × 0.47 m / 300 m ≈ 313 MPa, and about 447 MPa at the 0.67 m peak, close to the 500 MPa fatigue requirement. Panel curvature mismatch: a panel of circumradius 6.35 m has a sag of 63.3 mm on a 318.5 m sphere and 72.0 mm on 280 m, an 8.7 mm peak difference near the vertex, about 8.7/√12 ≈ 2.5 mm rms after best fit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：安裝前抽樣對鋼索與錨具做疲勞試驗，以 500 MPa 應力幅跑滿兩百萬次並檢查斷絲與錨具裂紋；運轉中在代表性主索上裝索力感測器，對每種拋物面位置比較實測索力與有限元素模型；面板出廠前以攝影測量或雷射掃描量面形，安裝後再抽查。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Before installation fatigue-test sample cables and anchors at 500 MPa stress amplitude for the full two million cycles and inspect for broken wires and anchor cracks; in service fit force sensors to representative main cables and compare measured tension with the finite-element model for each paraboloid position; measure panel shape by photogrammetry or laser scanning at the factory and spot-check after installation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 應力循環量級估算：球面上節點法向位移 δ 使面內長度改變約 δ/R，Δσ ≈ E·δ/R = 200 GPa × 0.47 m / 300 m ≈ 313 MPa；在 0.67 m 峰值處約 447 MPa，已接近 500 MPa 的疲勞要求。面板曲率失配：外接圓半徑 6.35 m 的面板，在 318.5 m 球面上矢高 63.3 mm、在 280 m 上 72.0 mm，頂點附近峰值差 8.7 mm，最佳擬合後約 8.7/√12 ≈ 2.5 mm rms。
knowledge.textEn: Order-of-magnitude stress cycle: a normal node displacement δ on the sphere changes in-surface length by about δ/R, so Δσ ≈ E·δ/R = 200 GPa × 0.47 m / 300 m ≈ 313 MPa, and about 447 MPa at the 0.67 m peak, close to the 500 MPa fatigue requirement. Panel curvature mismatch: a panel of circumradius 6.35 m has a sag of 63.3 mm on a 318.5 m sphere and 72.0 mm on 280 m, an 8.7 mm peak difference near the vertex, about 8.7/√12 ≈ 2.5 mm rms after best fit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「面板、索網與抗疲勞鋼索」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Panels, cable net and fatigue-resistant cables", which statement holds?
options: 相對 140 m 焦距，10 mm 的饋源誤差可以忽略。
應力循環量級估算：球面上節點法向位移 δ 使面內長度改變約 δ/R，Δσ ≈ E·δ/R = 200 GPa × 0.47 m / 300 m ≈ 313 MPa。
電波寧靜區可以擋掉所有干擾，包括衛星訊號。
optionsEn: A 10 mm feed error is negligible against a 140 m focal length.

Order-of-magnitude stress cycle: a normal node displacement δ on the sphere changes in-surface length by about δ/R, so Δσ ≈ E·δ/R = 200 GPa × 0.47 m / 300 m ≈ 313 MPa, and about 447 MPa at the 0.67 m peak, close to the 500 MPa fatigue requirement.
A radio quiet zone blocks all interference, satellite signals included.
quiz.explanation: 應力循環量級估算：球面上節點法向位移 δ 使面內長度改變約 δ/R，Δσ ≈ E·δ/R = 200 GPa × 0.47 m / 300 m ≈ 313 MPa；在 0.67 m 峰值處約 447 MPa，已接近 500 MPa 的疲勞要求。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Order-of-magnitude stress cycle: a normal node displacement δ on the sphere changes in-surface length by about δ/R, so Δσ ≈ E·δ/R = 200 GPa × 0.47 m / 300 m ≈ 313 MPa, and about 447 MPa at the 0.67 m peak, close to the 500 MPa fatigue requirement. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 面板、索網與抗疲勞鋼索：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Panels, cable net and fatigue-resistant cables: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「三角面板、索網節點與促動器」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Triangular panels, cable-net nodes and actuators” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 安裝前抽樣對鋼索與錨具做疲勞試驗，以 500 MPa 應力幅跑滿兩百萬次並檢查斷絲與錨具裂紋；運轉中在代表性主索上裝索力感測器，對每種拋物面位置比較實測索力與有限元素模型；面板出廠前以攝影測量或雷射掃描量面形，安裝後再抽查。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Before installation fatigue-test sample cables and anchors at 500 MPa stress amplitude for the full two million cycles and inspect for broken wires and anchor cracks; in service fit force sensors to representative main cables and compare measured tension with the finite-element model for each paraboloid position; measure panel shape by photogrammetry or laser scanning at the factory and spot-check after installation. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：錨具處的疲勞裂紋或腐蝕使單根主索斷裂，載重重新分配，附近節點位置與面形同時偏移；晴天時鋁面板 11 m × 23 ppm/K × 20 K ≈ 5 mm 的熱伸長若因連接件卡死而無法滑動，面板翹曲，局部面形誤差遠超預算。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Fatigue cracking or corrosion at an anchor breaks a main cable, loads redistribute and nearby node positions and surface shape shift together; on sunny days an aluminium panel grows about 11 m × 23 ppm/K × 20 K ≈ 5 mm, and if seized connectors stop it sliding the panel warps and the local surface error far exceeds budget.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 安裝前抽樣對鋼索與錨具做疲勞試驗，以 500 MPa 應力幅跑滿兩百萬次並檢查斷絲與錨具裂紋；運轉中在代表性主索上裝索力感測器，對每種拋物面位置比較實測索力與有限元素模型；面板出廠前以攝影測量或雷射掃描量面形，安裝後再抽查。
knowledge.textEn: Before installation fatigue-test sample cables and anchors at 500 MPa stress amplitude for the full two million cycles and inspect for broken wires and anchor cracks; in service fit force sensors to representative main cables and compare measured tension with the finite-element model for each paraboloid position; measure panel shape by photogrammetry or laser scanning at the factory and spot-check after installation.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「面板、索網與抗疲勞鋼索」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Panels, cable net and fatigue-resistant cables"?
options: 只看單次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準件或重複量測。
FAST 觀測時會把整個 500 m 反射面變成一個拋物面。
安裝前抽樣對鋼索與錨具做疲勞試驗，以 500 MPa 應力幅跑滿兩百萬次並檢查斷絲與錨具裂紋。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the result; no reference artefact or repeat measurement is needed.
FAST deforms its whole 500 m dish into a single paraboloid when observing.
Before installation fatigue-test sample cables and anchors at 500 MPa stress amplitude for the full two million cycles and inspect for broken wires and anchor cracks.
quiz.explanation: 安裝前抽樣對鋼索與錨具做疲勞試驗，以 500 MPa 應力幅跑滿兩百萬次並檢查斷絲與錨具裂紋；運轉中在代表性主索上裝索力感測器，對每種拋物面位置比較實測索力與有限元素模型；面板出廠前以攝影測量或雷射掃描量面形，安裝後再抽查。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Before installation fatigue-test sample cables and anchors at 500 MPa stress amplitude for the full two million cycles and inspect for broken wires and anchor cracks; in service fit force sensors to representative main cables and compare measured tension with the finite-element model for each paraboloid position; measure panel shape by photogrammetry or laser scanning at the factory and spot-check after installation. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 面板、索網與抗疲勞鋼索：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Panels, cable net and fatigue-resistant cables: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「三角面板、索網節點與促動器」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Triangular panels, cable-net nodes and actuators” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 錨具處的疲勞裂紋或腐蝕使單根主索斷裂，載重重新分配，附近節點位置與面形同時偏移；晴天時鋁面板 11 m × 23 ppm/K × 20 K ≈ 5 mm 的熱伸長若因連接件卡死而無法滑動，面板翹曲，局部面形誤差遠超預算。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Fatigue cracking or corrosion at an anchor breaks a main cable, loads redistribute and nearby node positions and surface shape shift together; on sunny days an aluminium panel grows about 11 m × 23 ppm/K × 20 K ≈ 5 mm, and if seized connectors stop it sliding the panel warps and the local surface error far exceeds budget. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：每次換源都改變拋物面位置，索網反覆承受應力循環；公開資料指出 FAST 的鋼索需承受約 500 MPa 應力幅、兩百萬次循環，約為一般規範的兩倍，因此必須開發新的鋼絞線與錨固工藝。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Every change of source moves the paraboloid, so the net sees repeated stress cycles; public reports state that FAST's cables had to survive about 500 MPa stress amplitude for two million cycles, roughly twice the usual code value, which required new steel-strand and anchorage technology.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「索網只承受靜態重量，不必考慮疲勞壽命。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The cable net carries only static weight, so fatigue life can be ignored." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 錨具處的疲勞裂紋或腐蝕使單根主索斷裂，載重重新分配，附近節點位置與面形同時偏移；晴天時鋁面板 11 m × 23 ppm/K × 20 K ≈ 5 mm 的熱伸長若因連接件卡死而無法滑動，面板翹曲，局部面形誤差遠超預算。
knowledge.textEn: Fatigue cracking or corrosion at an anchor breaks a main cable, loads redistribute and nearby node positions and surface shape shift together; on sunny days an aluminium panel grows about 11 m × 23 ppm/K × 20 K ≈ 5 mm, and if seized connectors stop it sliding the panel warps and the local surface error far exceeds budget.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「面板、索網與抗疲勞鋼索」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Panels, cable net and fatigue-resistant cables" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 錨具處的疲勞裂紋或腐蝕使單根主索斷裂，載重重新分配，附近節點位置與面形同時偏移。
異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
只要控制六根鋼索長度，饋源艙就能直接達到毫米級定位。
optionsEn: Fatigue cracking or corrosion at an anchor breaks a main cable, loads redistribute and nearby node positions and surface shape shift together.
An anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Controlling the six cable lengths alone puts the feed cabin to millimetre accuracy.
quiz.explanation: 錨具處的疲勞裂紋或腐蝕使單根主索斷裂，載重重新分配，附近節點位置與面形同時偏移；晴天時鋁面板 11 m × 23 ppm/K × 20 K ≈ 5 mm 的熱伸長若因連接件卡死而無法滑動，面板翹曲，局部面形誤差遠超預算。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Fatigue cracking or corrosion at an anchor breaks a main cable, loads redistribute and nearby node positions and surface shape shift together; on sunny days an aluminium panel grows about 11 m × 23 ppm/K × 20 K ≈ 5 mm, and if seized connectors stop it sliding the panel warps and the local surface error far exceeds budget. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 索驅饋源艙的粗精兩級定位：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Two-stage positioning of the cable-driven feed cabin: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「六索饋源艙與 Stewart 平台」如何決定FAST 五百公尺口徑球面電波望遠鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Six-cable feed cabin and Stewart platform” determines the key performance of “FAST Five-hundred-meter Aperture Spherical Telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: FAST 不用 Arecibo 那種數百噸的剛性饋源平台，而是以六根鋼索經六座約 100 m 高、分布在 600 m 圓周上的塔，懸吊約 30 t 的輕型饋源艙，由絞車收放使艙體在拋物面上方約 140 m、與球面同心的焦面上移動。鋼索會下垂並隨風與索力伸縮，所以索驅並聯機構只能做粗定位（約 0.1 m）；艙內再以 AB 轉軸讓饋源朝向拋物面，並由六自由度 Stewart 平台把殘差修正到約 10 mm。接收機、冷頭與平台都在艙內，訊號經光纖傳到地面。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「六索饋源艙與 Stewart 平台」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Instead of a rigid feed platform weighing hundreds of tonnes like Arecibo's, FAST hangs a light feed cabin of about 30 t from six steel cables running over six towers about 100 m high on a 600 m circle, and winches move it over the focal surface, concentric with the sphere and about 140 m above the paraboloid. The cables sag and stretch with wind and tension, so the cable-driven parallel robot only positions coarsely, to about 0.1 m; inside the cabin an AB rotator points the feed at the paraboloid and a six-degree-of-freedom Stewart platform corrects the residual to about 10 mm. Receivers, cold heads and the platform ride in the cabin and signals reach the ground over optical fibre. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Six-cable feed cabin and Stewart platform”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：懸鏈下垂 s ≈ wL²/(8T)：取教學假設 w = 100 N/m、L = 500 m、T = 200 kN，s ≈ 100 × 250 000/(1.6×10⁶) ≈ 15.6 m；由 δs/s = −δT/T，索力只變 1% 下垂就變 0.16 m，所以單靠索長控制達不到公分級。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Catenary sag s ≈ wL²/(8T): with teaching values w = 100 N/m, L = 500 m and T = 200 kN, s ≈ 100 × 250 000/(1.6×10⁶) ≈ 15.6 m; since δs/s = −δT/T, a 1% tension change moves the sag by 0.16 m, so cable-length control alone cannot reach centimetres.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要控制六根鋼索長度，饋源艙就能直接達到毫米級定位。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Controlling the six cable lengths alone puts the feed cabin to millimetre accuracy." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「六索饋源艙與 Stewart 平台」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Six-cable feed cabin and Stewart platform”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 索驅饋源艙的粗精兩級定位
knowledge.titleEn: Two-stage positioning of the cable-driven feed cabin
knowledge.text: FAST 不用 Arecibo 那種數百噸的剛性饋源平台，而是以六根鋼索經六座約 100 m 高、分布在 600 m 圓周上的塔，懸吊約 30 t 的輕型饋源艙，由絞車收放使艙體在拋物面上方約 140 m、與球面同心的焦面上移動。鋼索會下垂並隨風與索力伸縮，所以索驅並聯機構只能做粗定位（約 0.1 m）；艙內再以 AB 轉軸讓饋源朝向拋物面，並由六自由度 Stewart 平台把殘差修正到約 10 mm。
knowledge.textEn: Instead of a rigid feed platform weighing hundreds of tonnes like Arecibo's, FAST hangs a light feed cabin of about 30 t from six steel cables running over six towers about 100 m high on a 600 m circle, and winches move it over the focal surface, concentric with the sphere and about 140 m above the paraboloid. The cables sag and stretch with wind and tension, so the cable-driven parallel robot only positions coarsely, to about 0.1 m; inside the cabin an AB rotator points the feed at the paraboloid and a six-degree-of-freedom Stewart platform corrects the residual to about 10 mm.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要控制六根鋼索長度，饋源艙就能直接達到毫米級定位。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Controlling the six cable lengths alone puts the feed cabin to millimetre accuracy. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「索驅饋源艙的粗精兩級定位」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Two-stage positioning of the cable-driven feed cabin" is correct?
options: 只要控制六根鋼索長度，饋源艙就能直接達到毫米級定位。
FAST 不用 Arecibo 那種數百噸的剛性饋源平台，而是以六根鋼索經六座約 100 m 高、分布在 600 m 圓周上的塔，懸吊約 30 t 的輕型饋源艙，由絞車收放使艙體在拋物面上方約 140 m、與球面同心的焦面上移動。
5 mm 的面形精度在 500 MHz 與 3 GHz 一樣好。
optionsEn: Controlling the six cable lengths alone puts the feed cabin to millimetre accuracy.

Instead of a rigid feed platform weighing hundreds of tonnes like Arecibo's, FAST hangs a light feed cabin of about 30 t from six steel cables running over six towers about 100 m high on a 600 m circle, and winches move it over the focal surface, concentric with the sphere and about 140 m above the paraboloid.
A 5 mm surface performs equally well at 500 MHz and 3 GHz.
quiz.explanation: FAST 不用 Arecibo 那種數百噸的剛性饋源平台，而是以六根鋼索經六座約 100 m 高、分布在 600 m 圓周上的塔，懸吊約 30 t 的輕型饋源艙，由絞車收放使艙體在拋物面上方約 140 m、與球面同心的焦面上移動。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Instead of a rigid feed platform weighing hundreds of tonnes like Arecibo's, FAST hangs a light feed cabin of about 30 t from six steel cables running over six towers about 100 m high on a 600 m circle, and winches move it over the focal surface, concentric with the sphere and about 140 m above the paraboloid. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 索驅饋源艙的粗精兩級定位：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Two-stage positioning of the cable-driven feed cabin: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「六索饋源艙與 Stewart 平台」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Six-cable feed cabin and Stewart platform” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：懸鏈下垂 s ≈ wL²/(8T)：取教學假設 w = 100 N/m、L = 500 m、T = 200 kN，s ≈ 100 × 250 000/(1.6×10⁶) ≈ 15.6 m；由 δs/s = −δT/T，索力只變 1% 下垂就變 0.16 m，所以單靠索長控制達不到公分級。兩級分工：索驅殘差 100 mm，Stewart 平台壓到 10 mm，需要 10:1 的修正比，且必須以即時量測的艙體位置做閉迴路。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Catenary sag s ≈ wL²/(8T): with teaching values w = 100 N/m, L = 500 m and T = 200 kN, s ≈ 100 × 250 000/(1.6×10⁶) ≈ 15.6 m; since δs/s = −δT/T, a 1% tension change moves the sag by 0.16 m, so cable-length control alone cannot reach centimetres. The two stages divide the work: 100 mm cable-level residual reduced to 10 mm by the Stewart platform, a 10:1 correction that must run in closed loop on measured cabin position. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以全站儀等量測系統同時追蹤艙體與 Stewart 上平台的位置，追蹤觀測時比較指令軌跡與實測軌跡，分別記錄粗級與精級的 rms 殘差及其頻譜；在無風與有風條件各測一次，找出風激低頻擺動的頻率，確認其振幅仍在 Stewart 行程與頻寬之內。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Track both the cabin and the Stewart top plate with total stations and related metrology, compare commanded and measured trajectories during tracking, and log rms residuals and spectra for the coarse and fine stages separately; repeat in calm and windy conditions, identify the frequency of wind-driven low-frequency sway and confirm that its amplitude stays within the Stewart stroke and bandwidth.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 懸鏈下垂 s ≈ wL²/(8T)：取教學假設 w = 100 N/m、L = 500 m、T = 200 kN，s ≈ 100 × 250 000/(1.6×10⁶) ≈ 15.6 m；由 δs/s = −δT/T，索力只變 1% 下垂就變 0.16 m，所以單靠索長控制達不到公分級。兩級分工：索驅殘差 100 mm，Stewart 平台壓到 10 mm，需要 10:1 的修正比，且必須以即時量測的艙體位置做閉迴路。
knowledge.textEn: Catenary sag s ≈ wL²/(8T): with teaching values w = 100 N/m, L = 500 m and T = 200 kN, s ≈ 100 × 250 000/(1.6×10⁶) ≈ 15.6 m; since δs/s = −δT/T, a 1% tension change moves the sag by 0.16 m, so cable-length control alone cannot reach centimetres. The two stages divide the work: 100 mm cable-level residual reduced to 10 mm by the Stewart platform, a 10:1 correction that must run in closed loop on measured cabin position.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「索驅饋源艙的粗精兩級定位」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Two-stage positioning of the cable-driven feed cabin", which statement holds?
options: 頻譜基線漣波只來自接收機電子，與望遠鏡幾何無關。
FAST 觀測時會把整個 500 m 反射面變成一個拋物面。
optionsEn: Spectral baseline ripple comes only from receiver electronics, not telescope geometry.
FAST deforms its whole 500 m dish into a single paraboloid when observing.
Catenary sag s ≈ wL²/(8T): with teaching values w = 100 N/m, L = 500 m and T = 200 kN, s ≈ 100 × 250 000/(1.6×10⁶) ≈ 15.6 m.
