quiz.explanationEn: Catenary sag s ≈ wL²/(8T): with teaching values w = 100 N/m, L = 500 m and T = 200 kN, s ≈ 100 × 250 000/(1.6×10⁶) ≈ 15.6 m; since δs/s = −δT/T, a 1% tension change moves the sag by 0.16 m, so cable-length control alone cannot reach centimetres. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 索驅饋源艙的粗精兩級定位：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Two-stage positioning of the cable-driven feed cabin: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「六索饋源艙與 Stewart 平台」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Six-cable feed cabin and Stewart platform” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以全站儀等量測系統同時追蹤艙體與 Stewart 上平台的位置，追蹤觀測時比較指令軌跡與實測軌跡，分別記錄粗級與精級的 rms 殘差及其頻譜；在無風與有風條件各測一次，找出風激低頻擺動的頻率，確認其振幅仍在 Stewart 行程與頻寬之內。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Track both the cabin and the Stewart top plate with total stations and related metrology, compare commanded and measured trajectories during tracking, and log rms residuals and spectra for the coarse and fine stages separately; repeat in calm and windy conditions, identify the frequency of wind-driven low-frequency sway and confirm that its amplitude stays within the Stewart stroke and bandwidth. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：強風時艙體擺幅超過 Stewart 行程，平台撞到極限後殘差突然跳升，波束在天空中游移，增益隨之調變；若六台絞車不同步，艙體傾斜，AB 轉軸與饋源朝向偏離拋物面中心，照明不對稱、溢出增加。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: In strong wind the cabin sway exceeds the Stewart stroke, the platform hits its limits and the residual jumps, so the beam wanders on the sky and the gain is modulated; if the six winches fall out of step the cabin tilts, the AB rotator and feed no longer face the paraboloid centre, illumination becomes asymmetric and spillover rises.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以全站儀等量測系統同時追蹤艙體與 Stewart 上平台的位置，追蹤觀測時比較指令軌跡與實測軌跡，分別記錄粗級與精級的 rms 殘差及其頻譜；在無風與有風條件各測一次，找出風激低頻擺動的頻率，確認其振幅仍在 Stewart 行程與頻寬之內。
knowledge.textEn: Track both the cabin and the Stewart top plate with total stations and related metrology, compare commanded and measured trajectories during tracking, and log rms residuals and spectra for the coarse and fine stages separately; repeat in calm and windy conditions, identify the frequency of wind-driven low-frequency sway and confirm that its amplitude stays within the Stewart stroke and bandwidth.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「索驅饋源艙的粗精兩級定位」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Two-stage positioning of the cable-driven feed cabin"?
options: 以全站儀等量測系統同時追蹤艙體與 Stewart 上平台的位置，追蹤觀測時比較指令軌跡與實測軌跡，分別記錄粗級與精級的 rms 殘差及其頻譜。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
FAST 反射面固定不動，所以增益與天頂角無關。
optionsEn: Track both the cabin and the Stewart top plate with total stations and related metrology, compare commanded and measured trajectories during tracking, and log rms residuals and spectra for the coarse and fine stages separately.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Because FAST's dish never moves, its gain does not depend on zenith angle.
quiz.explanation: 以全站儀等量測系統同時追蹤艙體與 Stewart 上平台的位置，追蹤觀測時比較指令軌跡與實測軌跡，分別記錄粗級與精級的 rms 殘差及其頻譜；在無風與有風條件各測一次，找出風激低頻擺動的頻率，確認其振幅仍在 Stewart 行程與頻寬之內。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Track both the cabin and the Stewart top plate with total stations and related metrology, compare commanded and measured trajectories during tracking, and log rms residuals and spectra for the coarse and fine stages separately; repeat in calm and windy conditions, identify the frequency of wind-driven low-frequency sway and confirm that its amplitude stays within the Stewart stroke and bandwidth. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 索驅饋源艙的粗精兩級定位：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Two-stage positioning of the cable-driven feed cabin: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「六索饋源艙與 Stewart 平台」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Six-cable feed cabin and Stewart platform” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 強風時艙體擺幅超過 Stewart 行程，平台撞到極限後殘差突然跳升，波束在天空中游移，增益隨之調變；若六台絞車不同步，艙體傾斜，AB 轉軸與饋源朝向偏離拋物面中心，照明不對稱、溢出增加。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: In strong wind the cabin sway exceeds the Stewart stroke, the platform hits its limits and the residual jumps, so the beam wanders on the sky and the gain is modulated; if the six winches fall out of step the cabin tilts, the AB rotator and feed no longer face the paraboloid centre, illumination becomes asymmetric and spillover rises. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：接收機、冷頭與平台都在艙內，訊號經光纖傳到地面。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Receivers, cold heads and the platform ride in the cabin and signals reach the ground over optical fibre.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要控制六根鋼索長度，饋源艙就能直接達到毫米級定位。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Controlling the six cable lengths alone puts the feed cabin to millimetre accuracy." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 強風時艙體擺幅超過 Stewart 行程，平台撞到極限後殘差突然跳升，波束在天空中游移，增益隨之調變；若六台絞車不同步，艙體傾斜，AB 轉軸與饋源朝向偏離拋物面中心，照明不對稱、溢出增加。
knowledge.textEn: In strong wind the cabin sway exceeds the Stewart stroke, the platform hits its limits and the residual jumps, so the beam wanders on the sky and the gain is modulated; if the six winches fall out of step the cabin tilts, the AB rotator and feed no longer face the paraboloid centre, illumination becomes asymmetric and spillover rises.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「索驅饋源艙的粗精兩級定位」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Two-stage positioning of the cable-driven feed cabin" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的零件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
強風時艙體擺幅超過 Stewart 行程，平台撞到極限後殘差突然跳升，波束在天空中游移，增益隨之調變。
5 mm 的面形精度在 500 MHz 與 3 GHz 一樣好。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive part first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
In strong wind the cabin sway exceeds the Stewart stroke, the platform hits its limits and the residual jumps, so the beam wanders on the sky and the gain is modulated.
A 5 mm surface performs equally well at 500 MHz and 3 GHz.
quiz.explanation: 強風時艙體擺幅超過 Stewart 行程，平台撞到極限後殘差突然跳升，波束在天空中游移，增益隨之調變；若六台絞車不同步，艙體傾斜，AB 轉軸與饋源朝向偏離拋物面中心，照明不對稱、溢出增加。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: In strong wind the cabin sway exceeds the Stewart stroke, the platform hits its limits and the residual jumps, so the beam wanders on the sky and the gain is modulated; if the six winches fall out of step the cabin tilts, the AB rotator and feed no longer face the paraboloid centre, illumination becomes asymmetric and spillover rises. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「面形量測、閉迴路控制與 Ruze 預算」與「指向校正與饋源橫向誤差」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Surface metrology, closed-loop control and the Ruze budget" and "Pointing calibration and lateral feed error": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 面形量測、閉迴路控制與 Ruze 預算：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Surface metrology, closed-loop control and the Ruze budget: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「節點靶標、基準墩與全站儀」如何決定FAST 五百公尺口徑球面電波望遠鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Node targets, base pillars and total stations” determines the key performance of “FAST Five-hundred-meter Aperture Spherical Telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 拋物面靠閉迴路維持：索網節點上的靶標由架設在基準墩網上的雷射全站儀量測，基準點相對精度約 1 mm；量到的節點位置與目標拋物面比較後修正促動器，設計面形精度 5 mm rms，節點量測與控制各約 2 mm，並要求約一分鐘內量完上千個節點。總面形誤差來自面板製造、面板曲率失配、節點定位、量測與熱和風，各項以均方根相加；Ruze 效率損失隨頻率急遽上升，所以最高頻段（3 GHz）決定整個預算。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「節點靶標、基準墩與全站儀」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The paraboloid is held in closed loop: targets on the cable-net nodes are surveyed by laser total stations on a network of base pillars with about 1 mm relative accuracy, and measured node positions are compared with the target paraboloid to correct the actuators. The design calls for 5 mm rms surface accuracy, about 2 mm each for node measurement and control, and more than a thousand nodes surveyed in about a minute. Total surface error combines panel manufacture, panel curvature mismatch, node positioning, measurement, and thermal and wind effects in root-sum-square; Ruze efficiency loss rises steeply with frequency, so the highest band, 3 GHz, drives the whole budget. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Node targets, base pillars and total stations”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學預算：面板製造 2.5 mm、曲率失配 2.0 mm、節點定位 2.0 mm、量測 1.5 mm、熱與風 1.5 mm，RSS = √18.75 = 4.33 mm < 5 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching budget: panel manufacture 2.5 mm, curvature mismatch 2.0 mm, node positioning 2.0 mm, measurement 1.5 mm, thermal and wind 1.5 mm, giving RSS = √18.75 = 4.33 mm < 5 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「5 mm 的面形精度在 500 MHz 與 3 GHz 一樣好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A 5 mm surface performs equally well at 500 MHz and 3 GHz." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「節點靶標、基準墩與全站儀」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Node targets, base pillars and total stations”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 面形量測、閉迴路控制與 Ruze 預算
knowledge.titleEn: Surface metrology, closed-loop control and the Ruze budget
knowledge.text: 拋物面靠閉迴路維持：索網節點上的靶標由架設在基準墩網上的雷射全站儀量測，基準點相對精度約 1 mm；量到的節點位置與目標拋物面比較後修正促動器，設計面形精度 5 mm rms，節點量測與控制各約 2 mm，並要求約一分鐘內量完上千個節點。總面形誤差來自面板製造、面板曲率失配、節點定位、量測與熱和風，各項以均方根相加；Ruze 效率損失隨頻率急遽上升，所以最高頻段（3 GHz）決定整個預算。
knowledge.textEn: The paraboloid is held in closed loop: targets on the cable-net nodes are surveyed by laser total stations on a network of base pillars with about 1 mm relative accuracy, and measured node positions are compared with the target paraboloid to correct the actuators. The design calls for 5 mm rms surface accuracy, about 2 mm each for node measurement and control, and more than a thousand nodes surveyed in about a minute.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：5 mm 的面形精度在 500 MHz 與 3 GHz 一樣好。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A 5 mm surface performs equally well at 500 MHz and 3 GHz. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「面形量測、閉迴路控制與 Ruze 預算」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Surface metrology, closed-loop control and the Ruze budget" is correct?
options: 5 mm 的面形精度在 500 MHz 與 3 GHz 一樣好。
相對 140 m 焦距，10 mm 的饋源誤差可以忽略。
拋物面靠閉迴路維持：索網節點上的靶標由架設在基準墩網上的雷射全站儀量測，基準點相對精度約 1 mm。
optionsEn: A 5 mm surface performs equally well at 500 MHz and 3 GHz.
A 10 mm feed error is negligible against a 140 m focal length.

The paraboloid is held in closed loop: targets on the cable-net nodes are surveyed by laser total stations on a network of base pillars with about 1 mm relative accuracy, and measured node positions are compared with the target paraboloid to correct the actuators.
quiz.explanation: 拋物面靠閉迴路維持：索網節點上的靶標由架設在基準墩網上的雷射全站儀量測，基準點相對精度約 1 mm；量到的節點位置與目標拋物面比較後修正促動器，設計面形精度 5 mm rms，節點量測與控制各約 2 mm，並要求約一分鐘內量完上千個節點。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The paraboloid is held in closed loop: targets on the cable-net nodes are surveyed by laser total stations on a network of base pillars with about 1 mm relative accuracy, and measured node positions are compared with the target paraboloid to correct the actuators. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 面形量測、閉迴路控制與 Ruze 預算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Surface metrology, closed-loop control and the Ruze budget: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「節點靶標、基準墩與全站儀」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Node targets, base pillars and total stations” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學預算：面板製造 2.5 mm、曲率失配 2.0 mm、節點定位 2.0 mm、量測 1.5 mm、熱與風 1.5 mm，RSS = √18.75 = 4.33 mm < 5 mm。Ruze η = exp[−(4πε/λ)²]：1.4 GHz（λ = 0.214 m）為 0.937、3 GHz（λ = 0.0999 m）為 0.743；若 ε 剛好 5 mm，分別為 0.917 與 0.674。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching budget: panel manufacture 2.5 mm, curvature mismatch 2.0 mm, node positioning 2.0 mm, measurement 1.5 mm, thermal and wind 1.5 mm, giving RSS = √18.75 = 4.33 mm < 5 mm. Ruze η = exp[−(4πε/λ)²] is 0.937 at 1.4 GHz (λ = 0.214 m) and 0.743 at 3 GHz (λ = 0.0999 m); at exactly ε = 5 mm they become 0.917 and 0.674. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對同一組節點重複量測，求量測重複性與閉迴路殘差分佈；以冗餘量測（不同測站看同一靶標）檢查大氣折射造成的系統偏差，白天與夜間分開統計；在電波端量不同頻率的口徑效率並擬合 Ruze 曲線，反推等效 ε 與幾何量測結果比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Re-survey the same node set to obtain measurement repeatability and the closed-loop residual distribution; use redundant sightings of one target from different stations to expose systematic bias from atmospheric refraction, with day and night statistics kept separate; at radio frequencies measure aperture efficiency across bands, fit the Ruze curve and compare the inferred effective ε with the geometric survey.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學預算：面板製造 2.5 mm、曲率失配 2.0 mm、節點定位 2.0 mm、量測 1.5 mm、熱與風 1.5 mm，RSS = √18.75 = 4.33 mm < 5 mm。Ruze η = exp[−(4πε/λ)²]：1.4 GHz（λ = 0.214 m）為 0.937、3 GHz（λ = 0.0999 m）為 0.743；若 ε 剛好 5 mm，分別為 0.917 與 0.674。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching budget: panel manufacture 2.5 mm, curvature mismatch 2.0 mm, node positioning 2.0 mm, measurement 1.5 mm, thermal and wind 1.5 mm, giving RSS = √18.75 = 4.33 mm < 5 mm. Ruze η = exp[−(4πε/λ)²] is 0.937 at 1.4 GHz (λ = 0.214 m) and 0.743 at 3 GHz (λ = 0.0999 m); at exactly ε = 5 mm they become 0.917 and 0.674.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「面形量測、閉迴路控制與 Ruze 預算」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Surface metrology, closed-loop control and the Ruze budget", which statement holds?
options: 教學預算：面板製造 2.5 mm、曲率失配 2.0 mm、節點定位 2.0 mm、量測 1.5 mm、熱與風 1.5 mm，RSS = √18.75 = 4.33 mm < 5 mm。
電波寧靜區可以擋掉所有干擾，包括衛星訊號。
FAST 反射面固定不動，所以增益與天頂角無關。
optionsEn: Teaching budget: panel manufacture 2.5 mm, curvature mismatch 2.0 mm, node positioning 2.0 mm, measurement 1.5 mm, thermal and wind 1.5 mm, giving RSS = √18.75 = 4.33 mm < 5 mm.
A radio quiet zone blocks all interference, satellite signals included.
Because FAST's dish never moves, its gain does not depend on zenith angle.
quiz.explanation: 教學預算：面板製造 2.5 mm、曲率失配 2.0 mm、節點定位 2.0 mm、量測 1.5 mm、熱與風 1.5 mm，RSS = √18.75 = 4.33 mm < 5 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching budget: panel manufacture 2.5 mm, curvature mismatch 2.0 mm, node positioning 2.0 mm, measurement 1.5 mm, thermal and wind 1.5 mm, giving RSS = √18.75 = 4.33 mm < 5 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 面形量測、閉迴路控制與 Ruze 預算：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Surface metrology, closed-loop control and the Ruze budget: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「節點靶標、基準墩與全站儀」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Node targets, base pillars and total stations” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 對同一組節點重複量測，求量測重複性與閉迴路殘差分佈；以冗餘量測（不同測站看同一靶標）檢查大氣折射造成的系統偏差，白天與夜間分開統計；在電波端量不同頻率的口徑效率並擬合 Ruze 曲線，反推等效 ε 與幾何量測結果比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Re-survey the same node set to obtain measurement repeatability and the closed-loop residual distribution; use redundant sightings of one target from different stations to expose systematic bias from atmospheric refraction, with day and night statistics kept separate; at radio frequencies measure aperture efficiency across bands, fit the Ruze curve and compare the inferred effective ε with the geometric survey. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：地表附近的溫度梯度使全站儀視線彎曲，節點高度帶有系統誤差，閉迴路反而把這個誤差「修」進面形；若多出 3 mm，ε 由 4.33 mm 升到 √(4.33² + 3²) ≈ 5.27 mm，3 GHz 效率由 0.74 掉到 0.64，損失約 13%。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Temperature gradients near the ground bend total-station sight lines so node heights carry a systematic error, and the closed loop dutifully writes it into the surface; an extra 3 mm raises ε from 4.33 mm to √(4.33² + 3²) ≈ 5.27 mm and cuts the 3 GHz efficiency from 0.74 to 0.64, a loss of about 13%.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對同一組節點重複量測，求量測重複性與閉迴路殘差分佈；以冗餘量測（不同測站看同一靶標）檢查大氣折射造成的系統偏差，白天與夜間分開統計；在電波端量不同頻率的口徑效率並擬合 Ruze 曲線，反推等效 ε 與幾何量測結果比對。
knowledge.textEn: Re-survey the same node set to obtain measurement repeatability and the closed-loop residual distribution; use redundant sightings of one target from different stations to expose systematic bias from atmospheric refraction, with day and night statistics kept separate; at radio frequencies measure aperture efficiency across bands, fit the Ruze curve and compare the inferred effective ε with the geometric survey.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「面形量測、閉迴路控制與 Ruze 預算」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Surface metrology, closed-loop control and the Ruze budget"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
對同一組節點重複量測，求量測重複性與閉迴路殘差分佈。
索網只承受靜態重量，不必考慮疲勞壽命。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Re-survey the same node set to obtain measurement repeatability and the closed-loop residual distribution.
The cable net carries only static weight, so fatigue life can be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 對同一組節點重複量測，求量測重複性與閉迴路殘差分佈；以冗餘量測（不同測站看同一靶標）檢查大氣折射造成的系統偏差，白天與夜間分開統計；在電波端量不同頻率的口徑效率並擬合 Ruze 曲線，反推等效 ε 與幾何量測結果比對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Re-survey the same node set to obtain measurement repeatability and the closed-loop residual distribution; use redundant sightings of one target from different stations to expose systematic bias from atmospheric refraction, with day and night statistics kept separate; at radio frequencies measure aperture efficiency across bands, fit the Ruze curve and compare the inferred effective ε with the geometric survey. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 面形量測、閉迴路控制與 Ruze 預算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Surface metrology, closed-loop control and the Ruze budget: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「節點靶標、基準墩與全站儀」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Node targets, base pillars and total stations” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 地表附近的溫度梯度使全站儀視線彎曲，節點高度帶有系統誤差，閉迴路反而把這個誤差「修」進面形；若多出 3 mm，ε 由 4.33 mm 升到 √(4.33² + 3²) ≈ 5.27 mm，3 GHz 效率由 0.74 掉到 0.64，損失約 13%。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Temperature gradients near the ground bend total-station sight lines so node heights carry a systematic error, and the closed loop dutifully writes it into the surface; an extra 3 mm raises ε from 4.33 mm to √(4.33² + 3²) ≈ 5.27 mm and cuts the 3 GHz efficiency from 0.74 to 0.64, a loss of about 13%. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：總面形誤差來自面板製造、面板曲率失配、節點定位、量測與熱和風，各項以均方根相加；Ruze 效率損失隨頻率急遽上升，所以最高頻段（3 GHz）決定整個預算。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Total surface error combines panel manufacture, panel curvature mismatch, node positioning, measurement, and thermal and wind effects in root-sum-square; Ruze efficiency loss rises steeply with frequency, so the highest band, 3 GHz, drives the whole budget.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「5 mm 的面形精度在 500 MHz 與 3 GHz 一樣好。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A 5 mm surface performs equally well at 500 MHz and 3 GHz." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 地表附近的溫度梯度使全站儀視線彎曲，節點高度帶有系統誤差，閉迴路反而把這個誤差「修」進面形；若多出 3 mm，ε 由 4.33 mm 升到 √(4.33² + 3²) ≈ 5.27 mm，3 GHz 效率由 0.74 掉到 0.64，損失約 13%。
knowledge.textEn: Temperature gradients near the ground bend total-station sight lines so node heights carry a systematic error, and the closed loop dutifully writes it into the surface; an extra 3 mm raises ε from 4.33 mm to √(4.33² + 3²) ≈ 5.27 mm and cuts the 3 GHz efficiency from 0.74 to 0.64, a loss of about 13%.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「面形量測、閉迴路控制與 Ruze 預算」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Surface metrology, closed-loop control and the Ruze budget" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
相對 140 m 焦距，10 mm 的饋源誤差可以忽略。
地表附近的溫度梯度使全站儀視線彎曲，節點高度帶有系統誤差，閉迴路反而把這個誤差「修」進面形。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
A 10 mm feed error is negligible against a 140 m focal length.
Temperature gradients near the ground bend total-station sight lines so node heights carry a systematic error, and the closed loop dutifully writes it into the surface.
quiz.explanation: 地表附近的溫度梯度使全站儀視線彎曲，節點高度帶有系統誤差，閉迴路反而把這個誤差「修」進面形；若多出 3 mm，ε 由 4.33 mm 升到 √(4.33² + 3²) ≈ 5.27 mm，3 GHz 效率由 0.74 掉到 0.64，損失約 13%。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Temperature gradients near the ground bend total-station sight lines so node heights carry a systematic error, and the closed loop dutifully writes it into the surface; an extra 3 mm raises ε from 4.33 mm to √(4.33² + 3²) ≈ 5.27 mm and cuts the 3 GHz efficiency from 0.74 to 0.64, a loss of about 13%. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 指向校正與饋源橫向誤差：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Pointing calibration and lateral feed error: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「指向模型與饋源位置量測」如何決定FAST 五百公尺口徑球面電波望遠鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pointing model and feed-position metrology” determines the key performance of “FAST Five-hundred-meter Aperture Spherical Telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: FAST 的波束方向由拋物面頂點與饋源相位中心的連線決定；饋源橫向偏移 Δx 會讓波束偏轉 BDF·Δx/F，其中波束偏折因子 BDF 對 f/D = 0.4665 約為 0.86。指向誤差來源包括饋源位置量測誤差、拋物面軸向誤差、接收機相位中心偏移與時間同步。校正方法是對致密校準源做十字掃描或漂移掃描，擬合高斯偏移量，建立以方位與天頂角為變數的指向模型並修正；試運行報告的指向精度為 7.9″ rms，相對 L 波段約 2.9′ 的半功率波束寬。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「指向模型與饋源位置量測」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: FAST's beam direction is set by the line from the paraboloid vertex through the feed phase centre, so a lateral feed offset Δx tilts the beam by BDF·Δx/F, where the beam deviation factor BDF is about 0.86 for f/D = 0.4665. Pointing errors come from feed-position metrology, paraboloid-axis error, receiver phase-centre offset and timing. Calibration uses cross scans or drift scans over compact calibrators, fits Gaussian offsets and builds a pointing model in azimuth and zenith angle; commissioning reported 7.9″ rms pointing against a half-power beamwidth of about 2.9′ at L band. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Pointing model and feed-position metrology”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: BDF ≈ [1 + 0.36(D/4F)²]/[1 + (D/4F)²] with D/4F = 0.536 gives BDF ≈ 0.857.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「相對 140 m 焦距，10 mm 的饋源誤差可以忽略。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A 10 mm feed error is negligible against a 140 m focal length." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「指向模型與饋源位置量測」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Pointing model and feed-position metrology”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 指向校正與饋源橫向誤差
knowledge.titleEn: Pointing calibration and lateral feed error
knowledge.text: FAST 的波束方向由拋物面頂點與饋源相位中心的連線決定；饋源橫向偏移 Δx 會讓波束偏轉 BDF·Δx/F，其中波束偏折因子 BDF 對 f/D = 0.4665 約為 0.86。指向誤差來源包括饋源位置量測誤差、拋物面軸向誤差、接收機相位中心偏移與時間同步。
knowledge.textEn: FAST's beam direction is set by the line from the paraboloid vertex through the feed phase centre, so a lateral feed offset Δx tilts the beam by BDF·Δx/F, where the beam deviation factor BDF is about 0.86 for f/D = 0.4665. Pointing errors come from feed-position metrology, paraboloid-axis error, receiver phase-centre offset and timing.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：相對 140 m 焦距，10 mm 的饋源誤差可以忽略。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A 10 mm feed error is negligible against a 140 m focal length. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「指向校正與饋源橫向誤差」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pointing calibration and lateral feed error" is correct?
options: FAST 的波束方向由拋物面頂點與饋源相位中心的連線決定。
相對 140 m 焦距，10 mm 的饋源誤差可以忽略。
頻譜基線漣波只來自接收機電子，與望遠鏡幾何無關。
optionsEn: FAST's beam direction is set by the line from the paraboloid vertex through the feed phase centre, so a lateral feed offset Δx tilts the beam by BDF·Δx/F, where the beam deviation factor BDF is about 0.86 for f/D = 0.4665.
A 10 mm feed error is negligible against a 140 m focal length.
Spectral baseline ripple comes only from receiver electronics, not telescope geometry.
quiz.explanation: FAST 的波束方向由拋物面頂點與饋源相位中心的連線決定；饋源橫向偏移 Δx 會讓波束偏轉 BDF·Δx/F，其中波束偏折因子 BDF 對 f/D = 0.4665 約為 0.86。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: FAST's beam direction is set by the line from the paraboloid vertex through the feed phase centre, so a lateral feed offset Δx tilts the beam by BDF·Δx/F, where the beam deviation factor BDF is about 0.86 for f/D = 0.4665. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 指向校正與饋源橫向誤差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pointing calibration and lateral feed error: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「指向模型與饋源位置量測」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pointing model and feed-position metrology” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：BDF ≈ [1 + 0.36(D/4F)²]/[1 + (D/4F)²]，D/4F = 0.536，BDF ≈ 0.857。Δx = 10 mm 時 Δθ = 0.857 × 0.010/139.95 = 6.1×10⁻⁵ rad = 12.6″；5 mm 為 6.3″。高斯波束增益損失 1 − exp[−4ln2·(Δθ/HPBW)²]：7.9″ 為 0.57%、12.6″ 為 1.4%、30″ 為 7.9%。若饋源項只分配 4″，橫向隨機誤差須 ≲ 3.2 mm。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: BDF ≈ [1 + 0.36(D/4F)²]/[1 + (D/4F)²] with D/4F = 0.536 gives BDF ≈ 0.857. For Δx = 10 mm, Δθ = 0.857 × 0.010/139.95 = 6.1×10⁻⁵ rad = 12.6″, and 6.3″ for 5 mm. Gaussian-beam gain loss 1 − exp[−4ln2·(Δθ/HPBW)²] is 0.57% at 7.9″, 1.4% at 12.6″ and 7.9% at 30″. If the feed term is allotted only 4″, the random lateral error must be ≲ 3.2 mm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在不同方位、天頂角、白天與夜間對校準源做十字掃描，擬合每次的偏移量並求殘差 rms；把殘差與同時刻量到的饋源位置殘差、氣溫做相關，找出可寫進模型的系統項；再用 19 個波束對同一源做映射，確認各波束的相對位置與設計幾何一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Cross-scan calibrators over azimuth, zenith angle, day and night, fit each offset and compute the residual rms; correlate residuals with simultaneously measured feed-position residuals and air temperature to find systematic terms that belong in the model; then map one source with all 19 beams and confirm their relative positions match the design geometry.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: BDF ≈ [1 + 0.36(D/4F)²]/[1 + (D/4F)²] with D/4F = 0.536 gives BDF ≈ 0.857. For Δx = 10 mm, Δθ = 0.857 × 0.010/139.95 = 6.1×10⁻⁵ rad = 12.6″, and 6.3″ for 5 mm. Gaussian-beam gain loss 1 − exp[−4ln2·(Δθ/HPBW)²] is 0.57% at 7.9″, 1.4% at 12.6″ and 7.9% at 30″. If the feed term is allotted only 4″, the random lateral error must be ≲ 3.2 mm.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「指向校正與饋源橫向誤差」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pointing calibration and lateral feed error", which statement holds?
options: FAST 觀測時會把整個 500 m 反射面變成一個拋物面。
索網只承受靜態重量，不必考慮疲勞壽命。
optionsEn: FAST deforms its whole 500 m dish into a single paraboloid when observing.
The cable net carries only static weight, so fatigue life can be ignored.
quiz.explanationEn: BDF ≈ [1 + 0.36(D/4F)²]/[1 + (D/4F)²] with D/4F = 0.536 gives BDF ≈ 0.857. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 指向校正與饋源橫向誤差：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pointing calibration and lateral feed error: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「指向模型與饋源位置量測」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Pointing model and feed-position metrology” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在不同方位、天頂角、白天與夜間對校準源做十字掃描，擬合每次的偏移量並求殘差 rms；把殘差與同時刻量到的饋源位置殘差、氣溫做相關，找出可寫進模型的系統項；再用 19 個波束對同一源做映射，確認各波束的相對位置與設計幾何一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Cross-scan calibrators over azimuth, zenith angle, day and night, fit each offset and compute the residual rms; correlate residuals with simultaneously measured feed-position residuals and air temperature to find systematic terms that belong in the model; then map one source with all 19 beams and confirm their relative positions match the design geometry. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：指向模型只在夜間建立，白天日照讓塔架與鋼索熱變形，產生數十角秒的系統偏移；若全站儀座標系與電波相位中心之間有未校正的固定偏差，HI 拼接圖錯位，脈衝星計時觀測的流量也被系統性低估。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A pointing model built only at night meets daytime solar heating of towers and cables that adds systematic offsets of tens of arcseconds; an uncorrected fixed offset between the total-station frame and the radio phase centre misregisters HI mosaics and systematically lowers the flux recorded in pulsar-timing sessions.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在不同方位、天頂角、白天與夜間對校準源做十字掃描，擬合每次的偏移量並求殘差 rms；把殘差與同時刻量到的饋源位置殘差、氣溫做相關，找出可寫進模型的系統項；再用 19 個波束對同一源做映射，確認各波束的相對位置與設計幾何一致。
knowledge.textEn: Cross-scan calibrators over azimuth, zenith angle, day and night, fit each offset and compute the residual rms; correlate residuals with simultaneously measured feed-position residuals and air temperature to find systematic terms that belong in the model; then map one source with all 19 beams and confirm their relative positions match the design geometry.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「指向校正與饋源橫向誤差」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pointing calibration and lateral feed error"?
options: 只要模擬結果看起來合理，就可以省略實體量測與校正。
只要控制六根鋼索長度，饋源艙就能直接達到毫米級定位。
在不同方位、天頂角、白天與夜間對校準源做十字掃描，擬合每次的偏移量並求殘差 rms。
optionsEn: If the simulation looks reasonable, physical measurement and calibration can be skipped.
Controlling the six cable lengths alone puts the feed cabin to millimetre accuracy.
Cross-scan calibrators over azimuth, zenith angle, day and night, fit each offset and compute the residual rms.
quiz.explanation: 在不同方位、天頂角、白天與夜間對校準源做十字掃描，擬合每次的偏移量並求殘差 rms；把殘差與同時刻量到的饋源位置殘差、氣溫做相關，找出可寫進模型的系統項；再用 19 個波束對同一源做映射，確認各波束的相對位置與設計幾何一致。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Cross-scan calibrators over azimuth, zenith angle, day and night, fit each offset and compute the residual rms; correlate residuals with simultaneously measured feed-position residuals and air temperature to find systematic terms that belong in the model; then map one source with all 19 beams and confirm their relative positions match the design geometry. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 指向校正與饋源橫向誤差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pointing calibration and lateral feed error: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「指向模型與饋源位置量測」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Pointing model and feed-position metrology” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 指向模型只在夜間建立，白天日照讓塔架與鋼索熱變形，產生數十角秒的系統偏移；若全站儀座標系與電波相位中心之間有未校正的固定偏差，HI 拼接圖錯位，脈衝星計時觀測的流量也被系統性低估。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: A pointing model built only at night meets daytime solar heating of towers and cables that adds systematic offsets of tens of arcseconds; an uncorrected fixed offset between the total-station frame and the radio phase centre misregisters HI mosaics and systematically lowers the flux recorded in pulsar-timing sessions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：校正方法是對致密校準源做十字掃描或漂移掃描，擬合高斯偏移量，建立以方位與天頂角為變數的指向模型並修正；試運行報告的指向精度為 7.9″ rms，相對 L 波段約 2.9′ 的半功率波束寬。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Calibration uses cross scans or drift scans over compact calibrators, fits Gaussian offsets and builds a pointing model in azimuth and zenith angle; commissioning reported 7.9″ rms pointing against a half-power beamwidth of about 2.9′ at L band.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「相對 140 m 焦距，10 mm 的饋源誤差可以忽略。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A 10 mm feed error is negligible against a 140 m focal length." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 指向模型只在夜間建立，白天日照讓塔架與鋼索熱變形，產生數十角秒的系統偏移；若全站儀座標系與電波相位中心之間有未校正的固定偏差，HI 拼接圖錯位，脈衝星計時觀測的流量也被系統性低估。
knowledge.textEn: A pointing model built only at night meets daytime solar heating of towers and cables that adds systematic offsets of tens of arcseconds; an uncorrected fixed offset between the total-station frame and the radio phase centre misregisters HI mosaics and systematically lowers the flux recorded in pulsar-timing sessions.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「指向校正與饋源橫向誤差」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pointing calibration and lateral feed error" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 指向模型只在夜間建立，白天日照讓塔架與鋼索熱變形，產生數十角秒的系統偏移。
只要重新開機或重設軟體，硬體失效也會一併排除。
頻譜基線漣波只來自接收機電子，與望遠鏡幾何無關。
optionsEn: A pointing model built only at night meets daytime solar heating of towers and cables that adds systematic offsets of tens of arcseconds.
Restarting or resetting the software also clears hardware failures.
Spectral baseline ripple comes only from receiver electronics, not telescope geometry.
quiz.explanation: 指向模型只在夜間建立，白天日照讓塔架與鋼索熱變形，產生數十角秒的系統偏移；若全站儀座標系與電波相位中心之間有未校正的固定偏差，HI 拼接圖錯位，脈衝星計時觀測的流量也被系統性低估。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A pointing model built only at night meets daytime solar heating of towers and cables that adds systematic offsets of tens of arcseconds; an uncorrected fixed offset between the total-station frame and the radio phase centre misregisters HI mosaics and systematically lowers the flux recorded in pulsar-timing sessions. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 系統整合、驗證與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「19 波束接收、雜訊注入與駐波基線」與「電波寧靜區、試運行驗收與交接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "19-beam reception, noise injection and standing-wave baselines" and "Radio quiet zone, commissioning acceptance and handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 19 波束接收、雜訊注入與駐波基線：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: 19-beam reception, noise injection and standing-wave baselines: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「19 波束 L 波段接收機」如何決定FAST 五百公尺口徑球面電波望遠鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “19-beam L-band receiver” determines the key performance of “FAST Five-hundred-meter Aperture Spherical Telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 焦面上以六角排列 19 個饋喇叭，涵蓋 1.05–1.45 GHz、雙線偏振，低雜訊放大器低溫冷卻，中心波束在 ζ < 26.4° 時 T_sys < 24 K；外圈波束偏離光軸，增益略低並帶彗形。強度校正靠週期性注入雜訊二極體，把計數換成溫度，再乘上 K/Jy 增益曲線。饋源與反射面相距約 140 m，兩者間的多次反射形成週期 c/2h 的駐波漣波，尺度與 HI 星系譜線寬度相當。漂移掃描利用地球自轉，多波束讓巡天速度提高約 19 倍。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「19 波束 L 波段接收機」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Nineteen feed horns in a hexagonal layout sit at the focal plane covering 1.05–1.45 GHz in dual linear polarisation with cryogenically cooled low-noise amplifiers, and the central beam reaches T_sys < 24 K for ζ < 26.4°; outer beams sit off axis with slightly lower gain and some coma. Intensity calibration injects a noise diode periodically to convert counts to kelvin and then applies the K/Jy gain curve. The feed sits about 140 m from the reflector and multiple reflections between them create a standing-wave ripple of period c/2h, on the same scale as HI galaxy line widths. Drift scans use Earth rotation, and the multibeam raises survey speed about nineteenfold. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “19-beam L-band receiver”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：駐波週期 Δν = c/(2h) = 3×10⁸/(2 × 140) ≈ 1.07 MHz；200 km/s 的 HI 線寬在 1420.4 MHz 為 0.95 MHz，兩者同量級。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Standing-wave period Δν = c/(2h) = 3×10⁸/(2 × 140) ≈ 1.07 MHz, while a 200 km/s HI line at 1420.4 MHz is 0.95 MHz wide, the same scale.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「頻譜基線漣波只來自接收機電子，與望遠鏡幾何無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Spectral baseline ripple comes only from receiver electronics, not telescope geometry." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「19 波束 L 波段接收機」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “19-beam L-band receiver”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 19 波束接收、雜訊注入與駐波基線
knowledge.titleEn: 19-beam reception, noise injection and standing-wave baselines
knowledge.text: 焦面上以六角排列 19 個饋喇叭，涵蓋 1.05–1.45 GHz、雙線偏振，低雜訊放大器低溫冷卻，中心波束在 ζ < 26.4° 時 T_sys < 24 K；外圈波束偏離光軸，增益略低並帶彗形。強度校正靠週期性注入雜訊二極體，把計數換成溫度，再乘上 K/Jy 增益曲線。
knowledge.textEn: Nineteen feed horns in a hexagonal layout sit at the focal plane covering 1.05–1.45 GHz in dual linear polarisation with cryogenically cooled low-noise amplifiers, and the central beam reaches T_sys < 24 K for ζ < 26.4°; outer beams sit off axis with slightly lower gain and some coma. Intensity calibration injects a noise diode periodically to convert counts to kelvin and then applies the K/Jy gain curve.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：頻譜基線漣波只來自接收機電子，與望遠鏡幾何無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Spectral baseline ripple comes only from receiver electronics, not telescope geometry. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「19 波束接收、雜訊注入與駐波基線」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "19-beam reception, noise injection and standing-wave baselines" is correct?
options: 頻譜基線漣波只來自接收機電子，與望遠鏡幾何無關。
焦面上以六角排列 19 個饋喇叭，涵蓋 1.05–1.45 GHz、雙線偏振，低雜訊放大器低溫冷卻，中心波束在 ζ < 26.4° 時 T_sys < 24 K。
電波寧靜區可以擋掉所有干擾，包括衛星訊號。
optionsEn: Spectral baseline ripple comes only from receiver electronics, not telescope geometry.

Nineteen feed horns in a hexagonal layout sit at the focal plane covering 1.05–1.45 GHz in dual linear polarisation with cryogenically cooled low-noise amplifiers, and the central beam reaches T_sys < 24 K for ζ < 26.4°.
A radio quiet zone blocks all interference, satellite signals included.
quiz.explanation: 焦面上以六角排列 19 個饋喇叭，涵蓋 1.05–1.45 GHz、雙線偏振，低雜訊放大器低溫冷卻，中心波束在 ζ < 26.4° 時 T_sys < 24 K；外圈波束偏離光軸，增益略低並帶彗形。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Nineteen feed horns in a hexagonal layout sit at the focal plane covering 1.05–1.45 GHz in dual linear polarisation with cryogenically cooled low-noise amplifiers, and the central beam reaches T_sys < 24 K for ζ < 26.4°; outer beams sit off axis with slightly lower gain and some coma. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 19 波束接收、雜訊注入與駐波基線：定量估算
steps.titleEn: 19-beam reception, noise injection and standing-wave baselines: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「19 波束 L 波段接收機」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “19-beam L-band receiver” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：駐波週期 Δν = c/(2h) = 3×10⁸/(2 × 140) ≈ 1.07 MHz；200 km/s 的 HI 線寬在 1420.4 MHz 為 0.95 MHz，兩者同量級。漂移：源穿越 2.9′ = 174″ 的波束需 174/(15 × cos25.65°) ≈ 12.9 s；SEFD 1.49 Jy、通道寬 500 MHz/65 536 = 7.63 kHz、雙偏振時 σ = 1.49/√(2 × 7630 × 12.9) ≈ 3.4 mJy。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Standing-wave period Δν = c/(2h) = 3×10⁸/(2 × 140) ≈ 1.07 MHz, while a 200 km/s HI line at 1420.4 MHz is 0.95 MHz wide, the same scale. Drift: a source crosses the 2.9′ = 174″ beam in 174/(15 × cos25.65°) ≈ 12.9 s; with SEFD 1.49 Jy, a 500 MHz/65 536 = 7.63 kHz channel and two polarisations, σ = 1.49/√(2 × 7630 × 12.9) ≈ 3.4 mJy per beam crossing. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以秒級週期開關雜訊二極體，從開關差值追蹤增益穩定度（試運行要求 3.5 小時內優於 1%）；逐波束量 T_sys 對頻率與 ζ 的變化；對空白天區在不同饋源軸向位置觀測，量出漣波週期與相位隨距離的變化並與 c/2h 比較；再用校準源映射確認每個波束的位置與增益。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Switch the noise diode on a seconds-scale period and track gain stability from the on-off difference, with commissioning requiring better than 1% over 3.5 hours; measure T_sys versus frequency and ζ for every beam; observe blank sky at several axial feed positions to measure ripple period and phase versus distance and compare with c/2h; then map a calibrator to confirm each beam's position and gain.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Standing-wave period Δν = c/(2h) = 3×10⁸/(2 × 140) ≈ 1.07 MHz, while a 200 km/s HI line at 1420.4 MHz is 0.95 MHz wide, the same scale. Drift: a source crosses the 2.9′ = 174″ beam in 174/(15 × cos25.65°) ≈ 12.9 s; with SEFD 1.49 Jy, a 500 MHz/65 536 = 7.63 kHz channel and two polarisations, σ = 1.49/√(2 × 7630 × 12.9) ≈ 3.4 mJy per beam crossing.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「19 波束接收、雜訊注入與駐波基線」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "19-beam reception, noise injection and standing-wave baselines", which statement holds?
options: FAST 反射面固定不動，所以增益與天頂角無關。
只要控制六根鋼索長度，饋源艙就能直接達到毫米級定位。
optionsEn: Because FAST's dish never moves, its gain does not depend on zenith angle.
Controlling the six cable lengths alone puts the feed cabin to millimetre accuracy.
Standing-wave period Δν = c/(2h) = 3×10⁸/(2 × 140) ≈ 1.07 MHz, while a 200 km/s HI line at 1420.4 MHz is 0.95 MHz wide, the same scale.
quiz.explanation: 駐波週期 Δν = c/(2h) = 3×10⁸/(2 × 140) ≈ 1.07 MHz；200 km/s 的 HI 線寬在 1420.4 MHz 為 0.95 MHz，兩者同量級。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Standing-wave period Δν = c/(2h) = 3×10⁸/(2 × 140) ≈ 1.07 MHz, while a 200 km/s HI line at 1420.4 MHz is 0.95 MHz wide, the same scale. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 19 波束接收、雜訊注入與駐波基線：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: 19-beam reception, noise injection and standing-wave baselines: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「19 波束 L 波段接收機」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “19-beam L-band receiver” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以秒級週期開關雜訊二極體，從開關差值追蹤增益穩定度（試運行要求 3.5 小時內優於 1%）；逐波束量 T_sys 對頻率與 ζ 的變化；對空白天區在不同饋源軸向位置觀測，量出漣波週期與相位隨距離的變化並與 c/2h 比較；再用校準源映射確認每個波束的位置與增益。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Switch the noise diode on a seconds-scale period and track gain stability from the on-off difference, with commissioning requiring better than 1% over 3.5 hours; measure T_sys versus frequency and ζ for every beam; observe blank sky at several axial feed positions to measure ripple period and phase versus distance and compare with c/2h; then map a calibrator to confirm each beam's position and gain. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：未扣除的駐波漣波在頻譜上出現約 1 MHz 寬的起伏，被誤認為 HI 偵測；雜訊二極體輸出隨溫度漂移時，所有流量校正帶數個百分比的系統誤差；強干擾使 ADC 飽和，整個頻帶的資料都受污染而必須剔除。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Unremoved standing-wave ripple produces 1 MHz-wide bumps in spectra that are mistaken for HI detections; a noise diode whose output drifts with temperature puts a systematic error of several percent into every flux calibration; strong interference saturates the ADC and contaminates the whole band, forcing the data to be flagged.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以秒級週期開關雜訊二極體，從開關差值追蹤增益穩定度（試運行要求 3.5 小時內優於 1%）；逐波束量 T_sys 對頻率與 ζ 的變化；對空白天區在不同饋源軸向位置觀測，量出漣波週期與相位隨距離的變化並與 c/2h 比較；再用校準源映射確認每個波束的位置與增益。
knowledge.textEn: Switch the noise diode on a seconds-scale period and track gain stability from the on-off difference, with commissioning requiring better than 1% over 3.5 hours; measure T_sys versus frequency and ζ for every beam; observe blank sky at several axial feed positions to measure ripple period and phase versus distance and compare with c/2h; then map a calibrator to confirm each beam's position and gain.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「19 波束接收、雜訊注入與駐波基線」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "19-beam reception, noise injection and standing-wave baselines"?
options: 以秒級週期開關雜訊二極體，從開關差值追蹤增益穩定度（試運行要求 3.5 小時內優於 1%）。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
5 mm 的面形精度在 500 MHz 與 3 GHz 一樣好。
optionsEn: Switch the noise diode on a seconds-scale period and track gain stability from the on-off difference, with commissioning requiring better than 1% over 3.5 hours.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A 5 mm surface performs equally well at 500 MHz and 3 GHz.
quiz.explanation: 以秒級週期開關雜訊二極體，從開關差值追蹤增益穩定度（試運行要求 3.5 小時內優於 1%）；逐波束量 T_sys 對頻率與 ζ 的變化；對空白天區在不同饋源軸向位置觀測，量出漣波週期與相位隨距離的變化並與 c/2h 比較；再用校準源映射確認每個波束的位置與增益。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Switch the noise diode on a seconds-scale period and track gain stability from the on-off difference, with commissioning requiring better than 1% over 3.5 hours; measure T_sys versus frequency and ζ for every beam; observe blank sky at several axial feed positions to measure ripple period and phase versus distance and compare with c/2h; then map a calibrator to confirm each beam's position and gain. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 19 波束接收、雜訊注入與駐波基線：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: 19-beam reception, noise injection and standing-wave baselines: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「19 波束 L 波段接收機」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “19-beam L-band receiver” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 未扣除的駐波漣波在頻譜上出現約 1 MHz 寬的起伏，被誤認為 HI 偵測；雜訊二極體輸出隨溫度漂移時，所有流量校正帶數個百分比的系統誤差；強干擾使 ADC 飽和，整個頻帶的資料都受污染而必須剔除。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Unremoved standing-wave ripple produces 1 MHz-wide bumps in spectra that are mistaken for HI detections; a noise diode whose output drifts with temperature puts a systematic error of several percent into every flux calibration; strong interference saturates the ADC and contaminates the whole band, forcing the data to be flagged. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：漂移掃描利用地球自轉，多波束讓巡天速度提高約 19 倍。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Drift scans use Earth rotation, and the multibeam raises survey speed about nineteenfold.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「頻譜基線漣波只來自接收機電子，與望遠鏡幾何無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Spectral baseline ripple comes only from receiver electronics, not telescope geometry." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 未扣除的駐波漣波在頻譜上出現約 1 MHz 寬的起伏，被誤認為 HI 偵測；雜訊二極體輸出隨溫度漂移時，所有流量校正帶數個百分比的系統誤差；強干擾使 ADC 飽和，整個頻帶的資料都受污染而必須剔除。
knowledge.textEn: Unremoved standing-wave ripple produces 1 MHz-wide bumps in spectra that are mistaken for HI detections; a noise diode whose output drifts with temperature puts a systematic error of several percent into every flux calibration; strong interference saturates the ADC and contaminates the whole band, forcing the data to be flagged.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「19 波束接收、雜訊注入與駐波基線」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "19-beam reception, noise injection and standing-wave baselines" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自操作人員失誤，系統設計不需要檢討。
未扣除的駐波漣波在頻譜上出現約 1 MHz 寬的起伏，被誤認為 HI 偵測。
電波寧靜區可以擋掉所有干擾，包括衛星訊號。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is operator error, so the system design never needs review.
Unremoved standing-wave ripple produces 1 MHz-wide bumps in spectra that are mistaken for HI detections.
A radio quiet zone blocks all interference, satellite signals included.
quiz.explanation: 未扣除的駐波漣波在頻譜上出現約 1 MHz 寬的起伏，被誤認為 HI 偵測；雜訊二極體輸出隨溫度漂移時，所有流量校正帶數個百分比的系統誤差；強干擾使 ADC 飽和，整個頻帶的資料都受污染而必須剔除。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Unremoved standing-wave ripple produces 1 MHz-wide bumps in spectra that are mistaken for HI detections; a noise diode whose output drifts with temperature puts a systematic error of several percent into every flux calibration; strong interference saturates the ADC and contaminates the whole band, forcing the data to be flagged. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 電波寧靜區、試運行驗收與交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Radio quiet zone, commissioning acceptance and handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「電波寧靜區與驗收紀錄」如何決定FAST 五百公尺口徑球面電波望遠鏡的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Radio quiet zone and acceptance record” determines the key performance of “FAST Five-hundred-meter Aperture Spherical Telescope”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 喀斯特窪地與四周山體遮擋地面干擾，貴州並劃設電波寧靜區，核心區約 5 km 內居民遷出並限制電子設備；站內電子設備放在屏蔽室，訊號以光纖傳輸，並有常駐的干擾監測站。試運行驗收把量到的性能與設計並列：口徑效率約 0.63、T_sys < 24 K（ζ < 26.4°）、指向 7.9″ rms、增益穩定度 3.5 小時內優於 1%；FAST 於 2020 年 1 月通過國家驗收。交接紀錄要包含各波束與天頂角的增益曲線、雜訊二極體校正表、指向模型版本、面形控制狀態與干擾目錄。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「電波寧靜區與驗收紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The karst depression and surrounding hills shield ground-based interference, and Guizhou designated a radio quiet zone whose core of about 5 km was cleared of residents with electronic devices restricted; on-site electronics sit in shielded rooms, signals travel over fibre, and a permanent station monitors interference. Commissioning acceptance sets measured performance beside design: aperture efficiency about 0.63, T_sys < 24 K for ζ < 26.4°, pointing 7.9″ rms and gain stability better than 1% over 3.5 hours; FAST passed national acceptance in January 2020. The handoff record must hold gain curves per beam and zenith angle, noise-diode calibration tables, the pointing-model version, surface-control status and the interference catalogue. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Radio quiet zone and acceptance record”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Free-space loss FSPL = 20log(5000) + 20log(1.4×10⁹) − 147.55 ≈ 109.4 dB.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「電波寧靜區可以擋掉所有干擾，包括衛星訊號。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A radio quiet zone blocks all interference, satellite signals included." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「電波寧靜區與驗收紀錄」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Radio quiet zone and acceptance record”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 電波寧靜區、試運行驗收與交接
knowledge.titleEn: Radio quiet zone, commissioning acceptance and handoff
knowledge.text: 喀斯特窪地與四周山體遮擋地面干擾，貴州並劃設電波寧靜區，核心區約 5 km 內居民遷出並限制電子設備；站內電子設備放在屏蔽室，訊號以光纖傳輸，並有常駐的干擾監測站。試運行驗收把量到的性能與設計並列：口徑效率約 0.63、T_sys < 24 K（ζ < 26.4°）、指向 7.9″ rms、增益穩定度 3.5 小時內優於 1%；FAST 於 2020 年 1 月通過國家驗收。
knowledge.textEn: The karst depression and surrounding hills shield ground-based interference, and Guizhou designated a radio quiet zone whose core of about 5 km was cleared of residents with electronic devices restricted; on-site electronics sit in shielded rooms, signals travel over fibre, and a permanent station monitors interference. Commissioning acceptance sets measured performance beside design: aperture efficiency about 0.63, T_sys < 24 K for ζ < 26.4°, pointing 7.9″ rms and gain stability better than 1% over 3.5 hours; FAST passed national acceptance in January 2020.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：電波寧靜區可以擋掉所有干擾，包括衛星訊號。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A radio quiet zone blocks all interference, satellite signals included. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「電波寧靜區、試運行驗收與交接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Radio quiet zone, commissioning acceptance and handoff" is correct?
options: 電波寧靜區可以擋掉所有干擾，包括衛星訊號。
FAST 觀測時會把整個 500 m 反射面變成一個拋物面。
喀斯特窪地與四周山體遮擋地面干擾，貴州並劃設電波寧靜區，核心區約 5 km 內居民遷出並限制電子設備。
optionsEn: A radio quiet zone blocks all interference, satellite signals included.
FAST deforms its whole 500 m dish into a single paraboloid when observing.

The karst depression and surrounding hills shield ground-based interference, and Guizhou designated a radio quiet zone whose core of about 5 km was cleared of residents with electronic devices restricted.
quiz.explanation: 喀斯特窪地與四周山體遮擋地面干擾，貴州並劃設電波寧靜區，核心區約 5 km 內居民遷出並限制電子設備；站內電子設備放在屏蔽室，訊號以光纖傳輸，並有常駐的干擾監測站。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The karst depression and surrounding hills shield ground-based interference, and Guizhou designated a radio quiet zone whose core of about 5 km was cleared of residents with electronic devices restricted; on-site electronics sit in shielded rooms, signals travel over fibre, and a permanent station monitors interference. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 電波寧靜區、試運行驗收與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Radio quiet zone, commissioning acceptance and handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「電波寧靜區與驗收紀錄」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Radio quiet zone and acceptance record” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：自由空間損耗 FSPL = 20log(5000) + 20log(1.4×10⁹) − 147.55 ≈ 109.4 dB。若某設備在單一 7.63 kHz 通道內洩漏 −60 dBm，經 0 dBi 旁瓣收到 −169.4 dBm；輻射計雜訊 k·T_sys·√(Δν/t) 在 1 s 為 −165.4 dBm、積分 1 小時為 −183.2 dBm，干擾高出 14 dB，足以污染長積分的譜線觀測。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Free-space loss FSPL = 20log(5000) + 20log(1.4×10⁹) − 147.55 ≈ 109.4 dB. A device leaking −60 dBm into one 7.63 kHz channel arrives at −169.4 dBm through a 0 dBi sidelobe; radiometer noise k·T_sys·√(Δν/t) is −165.4 dBm in 1 s and −183.2 dBm after 1 hour, so the interference sits 14 dB above it and spoils long spectral-line integrations. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以全向與指向天線的監測站持續掃描頻帶，統計干擾佔用率並與歷史比較；逐一開關站內子系統（促動器驅動器、艙內電子、冷頭壓縮機）找出自生干擾；最後依固定順序填寫驗收表：效率、T_sys、指向、增益穩定度與干擾統計，每項附上量測日期、ζ 範圍與允收值。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run the monitoring station with omnidirectional and directional antennas to scan the band continuously and compare occupancy statistics with history; switch on-site subsystems on and off one at a time, including actuator drivers, cabin electronics and cryocooler compressors, to find self-generated interference; finally fill the acceptance table in fixed order with efficiency, T_sys, pointing, gain stability and interference statistics, each with measurement date, ζ range and allowance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 自由空間損耗 FSPL = 20log(5000) + 20log(1.4×10⁹) − 147.55 ≈ 109.4 dB。若某設備在單一 7.63 kHz 通道內洩漏 −60 dBm，經 0 dBi 旁瓣收到 −169.4 dBm；輻射計雜訊 k·T_sys·√(Δν/t) 在 1 s 為 −165.4 dBm、積分 1 小時為 −183.2 dBm，干擾高出 14 dB，足以污染長積分的譜線觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Free-space loss FSPL = 20log(5000) + 20log(1.4×10⁹) − 147.55 ≈ 109.4 dB. A device leaking −60 dBm into one 7.63 kHz channel arrives at −169.4 dBm through a 0 dBi sidelobe; radiometer noise k·T_sys·√(Δν/t) is −165.4 dBm in 1 s and −183.2 dBm after 1 hour, so the interference sits 14 dB above it and spoils long spectral-line integrations.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「電波寧靜區、試運行驗收與交接」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Radio quiet zone, commissioning acceptance and handoff", which statement holds?
options: 索網只承受靜態重量，不必考慮疲勞壽命。
5 mm 的面形精度在 500 MHz 與 3 GHz 一樣好。
optionsEn: Free-space loss FSPL = 20log(5000) + 20log(1.4×10⁹) − 147.55 ≈ 109.4 dB.
The cable net carries only static weight, so fatigue life can be ignored.
A 5 mm surface performs equally well at 500 MHz and 3 GHz.
quiz.explanation: 自由空間損耗 FSPL = 20log(5000) + 20log(1.4×10⁹) − 147.55 ≈ 109.4 dB。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Free-space loss FSPL = 20log(5000) + 20log(1.4×10⁹) − 147.55 ≈ 109.4 dB. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 電波寧靜區、試運行驗收與交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Radio quiet zone, commissioning acceptance and handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「電波寧靜區與驗收紀錄」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Radio quiet zone and acceptance record” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以全向與指向天線的監測站持續掃描頻帶，統計干擾佔用率並與歷史比較；逐一開關站內子系統（促動器驅動器、艙內電子、冷頭壓縮機）找出自生干擾；最後依固定順序填寫驗收表：效率、T_sys、指向、增益穩定度與干擾統計，每項附上量測日期、ζ 範圍與允收值。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run the monitoring station with omnidirectional and directional antennas to scan the band continuously and compare occupancy statistics with history; switch on-site subsystems on and off one at a time, including actuator drivers, cabin electronics and cryocooler compressors, to find self-generated interference; finally fill the acceptance table in fixed order with efficiency, T_sys, pointing, gain stability and interference statistics, each with measurement date, ζ range and allowance. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：兩千多台促動器驅動器或艙內電子的寬頻雜訊若未屏蔽，望遠鏡自己污染自己；L 波段的導航衛星無法被地形與寧靜區擋住，強訊號使 ADC 飽和，該時段整個頻帶都必須剔除。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Unshielded broadband noise from the two thousand actuator drivers or cabin electronics lets the telescope pollute itself; L-band navigation satellites cannot be blocked by terrain or a quiet zone, and their strong signals saturate the ADC so the whole band must be flagged for that interval.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以全向與指向天線的監測站持續掃描頻帶，統計干擾佔用率並與歷史比較；逐一開關站內子系統（促動器驅動器、艙內電子、冷頭壓縮機）找出自生干擾；最後依固定順序填寫驗收表：效率、T_sys、指向、增益穩定度與干擾統計，每項附上量測日期、ζ 範圍與允收值。
knowledge.textEn: Run the monitoring station with omnidirectional and directional antennas to scan the band continuously and compare occupancy statistics with history; switch on-site subsystems on and off one at a time, including actuator drivers, cabin electronics and cryocooler compressors, to find self-generated interference; finally fill the acceptance table in fixed order with efficiency, T_sys, pointing, gain stability and interference statistics, each with measurement date, ζ range and allowance.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「電波寧靜區、試運行驗收與交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Radio quiet zone, commissioning acceptance and handoff"?
options: 沿用另一台設備或另一個案例的量測結果，就可視為本系統已完成驗證。

optionsEn: Reusing results from another instrument or another case counts as verifying this system.

A 10 mm feed error is negligible against a 140 m focal length.

Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 電波寧靜區、試運行驗收與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Radio quiet zone, commissioning acceptance and handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「電波寧靜區與驗收紀錄」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Radio quiet zone and acceptance record” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 兩千多台促動器驅動器或艙內電子的寬頻雜訊若未屏蔽，望遠鏡自己污染自己；L 波段的導航衛星無法被地形與寧靜區擋住，強訊號使 ADC 飽和，該時段整個頻帶都必須剔除。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Unshielded broadband noise from the two thousand actuator drivers or cabin electronics lets the telescope pollute itself; L-band navigation satellites cannot be blocked by terrain or a quiet zone, and their strong signals saturate the ADC so the whole band must be flagged for that interval. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接紀錄要包含各波束與天頂角的增益曲線、雜訊二極體校正表、指向模型版本、面形控制狀態與干擾目錄。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The handoff record must hold gain curves per beam and zenith angle, noise-diode calibration tables, the pointing-model version, surface-control status and the interference catalogue.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「電波寧靜區可以擋掉所有干擾，包括衛星訊號。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A radio quiet zone blocks all interference, satellite signals included." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 兩千多台促動器驅動器或艙內電子的寬頻雜訊若未屏蔽，望遠鏡自己污染自己；L 波段的導航衛星無法被地形與寧靜區擋住，強訊號使 ADC 飽和，該時段整個頻帶都必須剔除。
knowledge.textEn: Unshielded broadband noise from the two thousand actuator drivers or cabin electronics lets the telescope pollute itself; L-band navigation satellites cannot be blocked by terrain or a quiet zone, and their strong signals saturate the ADC so the whole band must be flagged for that interval.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測確認；只更換零件或放寬參數可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement; merely swapping parts or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「電波寧靜區、試運行驗收與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Radio quiet zone, commissioning acceptance and handoff" misbehaves, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
FAST 觀測時會把整個 500 m 反射面變成一個拋物面。
兩千多台促動器驅動器或艙內電子的寬頻雜訊若未屏蔽，望遠鏡自己污染自己。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
FAST deforms its whole 500 m dish into a single paraboloid when observing.
Unshielded broadband noise from the two thousand actuator drivers or cabin electronics lets the telescope pollute itself.

quiz.explanationEn: Unshielded broadband noise from the two thousand actuator drivers or cabin electronics lets the telescope pollute itself; L-band navigation satellites cannot be blocked by terrain or a quiet zone, and their strong signals saturate the ADC so the whole band must be flagged for that interval.
